function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ARCHER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesAssassinSprites() && ASSASSIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=BERSERKER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return BERSERKER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPriestSprites() && PRIEST_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PRIEST_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesMageSprites() && MAGE_ANIM[name]){
    const a=MAGE_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return MAGE_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPaladinSprites() && PALADIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PALADIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PALADIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  return ANIM[name]||ANIM.idle;
}
// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function updatePlayerCannonballs(){
  // Extremely small loop: move each ball toward the coordinates captured at
  // fire time. At arrival, use the game's already proven damage routine.
  for(let i=PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=PLAYER_CANNONBALLS[i];
    b.x+=b.vx;
    b.y+=b.vy;
    b.remaining-=Math.hypot(b.vx,b.vy);

    if(b.remaining<=0){
      const t=b.target;
      if(t&&t.hp>0){
        try{
          applyBasicAttackHit(t);
        }catch(_){
          const raw=Math.max(1,Math.floor(P.atk||12)-(t.def||0));
          t.hp=Math.max(0,t.hp-raw);
          t.flash=6;t.aggro=true;
        }
      }
      PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
}
function drawPlayerCannonballs(){
  const _vw=cv.width/cameraZoom(),_vh=cv.height/cameraZoom();
  for(const b of PLAYER_CANNONBALLS){
    const x=b.x-cam.x,y=b.y-cam.y;
    if(x<-24||y<-24||x>_vw+24||y>_vh+24)continue;
    cx.save();

    // Small but clearly readable cannonball on a phone screen.
    cx.fillStyle='rgba(214,125,42,.30)';
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x,y,10,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

    cx.fillStyle='#24272b';
    cx.strokeStyle='#d68a3d';
    cx.lineWidth=2;
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x,y,7,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();cx.stroke();

    cx.fillStyle='rgba(255,221,155,.75)';
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x-2,y-2,2,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

    cx.restore();
  }
}

// === V141 ARCHER BASIC ARROW ==============================================
const PLAYER_ARROWS=[];

function archerFireArrow(){
  let target=null;

  // Prefer the target already locked by Smart Attack.
  if(P.tid!=null){
    target=EN.find(function(e){
      return e&&e.id==P.tid&&e.hp>0&&targetIsValid(e);
    })||null;

    if(target){
      const range=playerBasicRange();
      if(P.scene==='clanboss1'&&target.isClanBoss){
        if(clanBossDistanceFromBody(target,P.x,P.y)>range)target=null;
      }else{
        const edge=(target.sz&&target.sz>30)?Math.max(0,(target.sz-30)*.4):0;
        if(Math.hypot(target.x-P.x,target.y-P.y)>range+edge)target=null;
      }
    }
  }

  if(!target)target=findNearBasic();
  P.tid=target?target.id:null;
  if(!target)return false;

  const dx=target.x-P.x,dy=target.y-P.y;
  const dist=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));
  const ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  const speed=12;

  P.face=dx<0?-1:1;
  P.meleeAng=ang;
  P.shootT=1;
  P.recoil=0;

  // Start near the bow hand / chest rather than from the character's feet.
  const startX=P.x+Math.cos(ang)*20;
  const startY=P.y-18+Math.sin(ang)*8;

  PLAYER_ARROWS.push({
    x:startX,y:startY,
    vx:Math.cos(ang)*speed,
    vy:Math.sin(ang)*speed,
    remaining:dist,
    target:target,
    ang:ang
  });

  // Tiny bow release read; deliberately light, no glow spam.
  PT.push({
    x:startX,y:startY,
    vx:-Math.cos(ang)*.7,vy:-Math.sin(ang)*.7,
    life:5,ml:5,sz:1.5,col:'#d8c18b'
  });
  return true;
}

function updatePlayerArrows(){
  for(let i=PLAYER_ARROWS.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const a=PLAYER_ARROWS[i];
    a.x+=a.vx;
    a.y+=a.vy;
    a.remaining-=Math.hypot(a.vx,a.vy);

    if(a.remaining<=0){
      const t=a.target;
      if(t&&t.hp>0){
        try{
          applyBasicAttackHit(t);
        }catch(_){
          const raw=Math.max(1,Math.floor(P.atk||12)-(t.def||0));
          t.hp=Math.max(0,t.hp-raw);
          t.flash=6;t.aggro=true;
        }

        // Small pixel impact only.
        for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
          PT.push({
            x:t.x+(Math.random()-.5)*5,
            y:t.y-8+(Math.random()-.5)*5,
            vx:(Math.random()-.5)*1.8,
            vy:(Math.random()-.5)*1.8,
            life:7,ml:7,sz:1.3+Math.random(),
            col:j===0?'#e9e1c6':'#8a6b42'
          });
        }
      }
      PLAYER_ARROWS.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
}

function drawPlayerArrows(){
  const _vw=cv.width/cameraZoom(),_vh=cv.height/cameraZoom();
  for(const a of PLAYER_ARROWS){
    const x=a.x-cam.x,y=a.y-cam.y;
    if(x<-28||y<-28||x>_vw+28||y>_vh+28)continue;

    cx.save();
    cx.translate(x,y);
    cx.rotate(a.ang);

    // Pixel-like wooden shaft.
    cx.fillStyle='#b98b55';
    cx.fillRect(-10,-1,16,2);

    // Pale metal arrow head.
    cx.fillStyle='#d9dde0';
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(10,0);
    cx.lineTo(5,-3);
    cx.lineTo(5,3);
    cx.closePath();
    cx.fill();

    // Small dark-green fletching matching the ranger palette.
    cx.fillStyle='#556b3b';
    cx.fillRect(-11,-3,4,2);
    cx.fillRect(-11,1,4,2);

    cx.restore();
  }
}

function ppaPlayerVisualTopScreenY(){
  var sy=P.y-cam.y;
  var _sv=P.scene==='clansiege'?CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE:1;
  var bob=Math.sin(P.bob)*(playerUsesGnomeSprites()?2.0:3)*_sv;
  var dh,dy;
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites()){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*GNOME_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(113/128)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesArcherSprites()){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*ARCHER_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(184/224)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesAssassinSprites()&&ASSASSIN_ANIM[P.anim]){
    var sc=(P.anim==='idle')?ASSASSIN_IDLE_DRAW_SCALE:(P.anim==='attack'?ASSASSIN_ATTACK_DRAW_SCALE:ASSASSIN_RUN_DRAW_SCALE);
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*sc,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(156/192)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesTankSprites()&&TANK_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*TANK_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(232/256)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites()&&BERSERKER_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*BERSERKER_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(232/256)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesPriestSprites()&&PRIEST_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*PRIEST_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(236/256)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesMageSprites()&&MAGE_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*MAGE_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(236/256)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesPaladinSprites()&&PALADIN_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*PALADIN_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(234/256)*dh;
  }else{
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*1.4,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-dh;
  }
  return sy+(bob+dy)*_sv;
}
function ppaPlayerClanName(){
  try{
    var c=(typeof CLAN_LOCAL_STATE!=='undefined'&&CLAN_LOCAL_STATE&&CLAN_LOCAL_STATE.clan)
      ?String(CLAN_LOCAL_STATE.clan.name||'').trim():'';
    return c;
  }catch(_){return ''}
}
function drawPlayerNickname(){
  var name=ppaPlayerNickname();
  if(!name)return;
  var clan=ppaPlayerClanName();
  var sx=P.x-cam.x;
  var y=ppaPlayerVisualTopScreenY()-9;

  cx.save();
  cx.textAlign='center';
  cx.textBaseline='bottom';
  cx.lineJoin='round';

  if(clan){
    var clanText='['+clan.slice(0,18)+']';
    cx.font='700 8px Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif';
    cx.lineWidth=2.4;
    cx.strokeStyle='rgba(8,12,20,.94)';
    cx.shadowColor='rgba(0,0,0,.78)';
    cx.shadowBlur=3;
    cx.strokeText(clanText,sx,y-12);
    cx.shadowBlur=0;
    cx.fillStyle='#a9cfff';
    cx.fillText(clanText,sx,y-12);
  }

  cx.font='600 10px Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif';
  cx.lineWidth=2.6;
  cx.strokeStyle='rgba(18,8,5,.92)';
  cx.shadowColor='rgba(0,0,0,.72)';
  cx.shadowBlur=3;
  cx.strokeText(name.slice(0,18),sx,y);
  cx.shadowBlur=0;
  cx.fillStyle='#f2d39a';
  cx.fillText(name.slice(0,18),sx,y);
  cx.restore();
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const sx=P.x-cam.x,sy=P.y-cam.y;
  const siegeVisualScale=P.scene==='clansiege'?CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE:1;

  // V277: only the player's 8 classes are drawn 10 px smaller.
  // No collision, camera, NPC, mob, AI or combat values are changed.
  const PLAYER_CLASS_EXTRA_REDUCTION_PX=10;
  const playerClassDrawHeight=(baseHeight)=>{
    const sc=Math.max(.01,Number(siegeVisualScale)||1);
    return Math.max(8,phoneCharacterDrawHeight(baseHeight,siegeVisualScale)-PLAYER_CLASS_EXTRA_REDUCTION_PX/sc);
  };
  const playerClassBodySize=(baseSize)=>{
    const sc=Math.max(.01,Number(siegeVisualScale)||1);
    return Math.max(8,phoneCharacterBodySize(baseSize,siegeVisualScale)-PLAYER_CLASS_EXTRA_REDUCTION_PX/sc);
  };
  const isGnome=playerUsesGnomeSprites();
  const isArcher=playerUsesArcherSprites();
  const isAssassinCustom=playerUsesAssassinSprites()&&!!ASSASSIN_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isTank=playerUsesTankSprites()&&!!TANK_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isBerserker=playerUsesBerserkerSprites()&&!!BERSERKER_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isPriest=playerUsesPriestSprites()&&!!PRIEST_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isMage=playerUsesMageSprites()&&!!MAGE_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isPaladin=playerUsesPaladinSprites()&&!!PALADIN_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isCustomDirectional=isGnome||isArcher||isAssassinCustom||isTank||isBerserker||isPriest||isMage||isPaladin;
  const phoneBodyBase=playerClassBodySize(P.sz);
  const visualBody=(isGnome?phoneBodyBase*0.72:phoneBodyBase)*siegeVisualScale;
  const bob=P.scene==='fartzone'?0:Math.sin(P.bob)*(isGnome?2.0:3);

  // Shadow follows the visible character size.
  // Fart Zone: exact feet-to-ground anchor, no visual hovering.
  const playerShadowY=P.scene==='fartzone'?sy+visualBody*0.40:sy+visualBody*0.45;
  cx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  cx.beginPath();cx.ellipse(sx,playerShadowY,visualBody*0.38,visualBody*0.14,0,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

  // Dust when running
  if((Math.abs(P.vx)>0.5||Math.abs(P.vy)>0.5)&&Math.random()<0.25)
    PT.push({x:P.x+(Math.random()-.5)*(isGnome?6:12)*siegeVisualScale,y:P.y+visualBody*0.35,
      vx:-P.vx*0.4+(Math.random()-.5),vy:-P.vy*0.2+(Math.random()-.5)*0.5,
      life:10,ml:10,sz:(isGnome?1.5:2)*siegeVisualScale,col:'rgba(120,100,70,0.4)'});

  cx.save();
  cx.translate(sx,sy+bob);
  if(P.scene==='clansiege')cx.scale(CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE,CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE);

  // Legacy lean/recoil is disabled for the dwarf because his approved
  // 4-frame attack already contains the physical movement.
  if(!isCustomDirectional){
    let lean=0;
    if(P.shootT>0)lean=P.face>0?0.12:-0.12;
    const rc=P.recoil*6*(P.face>0?-1:1);
    cx.translate(rc,0);
    cx.rotate(lean);
  }

  const cur=playerAnimDef(P.anim);

                : ASSASSIN_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir])
            : (isTank
                ? TANK_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]

                    ? BERSERKER_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]

                        ? PRIEST_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                        : (isMage
                            ? MAGE_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                            : (isPaladin
                                ? PALADIN_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                                : (cur.rows ? getDirRow() : 0))))))));
  const useFlip=isGnome
    ? GNOME_FLIP_BY_DIR[canonicalDir]
    : (isArcher
        ? ARCHER_FLIP_BY_DIR[canonicalDir]
        : ((isAssassinCustom||isTank||isBerserker||isPriest||isMage||isPaladin) ? false : (dirRow===2 && P.face>0)));
  const frameIndex=((P.animFrame%cur.frames)+cur.frames)%cur.frames;

  if(cur.img.complete && cur.img.naturalWidth > 0){
    const fh_row=cur.fh;
    const fw_frame=cur.fw;
    const footY=P.sz*0.40;
    const srcY=dirRow*fh_row;

    let dh,dw,dx,dy;
    if(isGnome){
      // Approved dwarf size stays unchanged.

      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(113/128)*dh);

      dw=dh;

      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(156/192)*dh);
    }else if(isTank){
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*TANK_DRAW_SCALE,siegeVisualScale);

function playerUsesGnomeSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='gnome';
}
function playerUsesArcherSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='archer';
}
function playerUsesAssassinSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='assassin';
}
function playerUsesTankSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='tank';
}
function playerUsesBerserkerSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='barbarian';
}
function playerUsesPriestSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='priest';
}
function playerUsesMageSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='mage';
}
function playerUsesPaladinSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='paladin';
}
function playerUsesEightDirSprites(){
  return playerUsesGnomeSprites()||playerUsesArcherSprites()||
    (playerUsesAssassinSprites()&&P.anim==='run');
}
function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ARCHER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesAssassinSprites() && ASSASSIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function ppaPlayerVisualTopScreenY(){

  var _sv=P.scene==='clansiege'?CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE:1;
  var bob=Math.sin(P.bob)*(playerUsesGnomeSprites()?2.0:3)*_sv;
  var dh,dy;
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites()){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*GNOME_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(113/128)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesArcherSprites()){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*ARCHER_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(184/224)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesAssassinSprites()&&ASSASSIN_ANIM[P.anim]){
    var sc=(P.anim==='idle')?ASSASSIN_IDLE_DRAW_SCALE:(P.anim==='attack'?ASSASSIN_ATTACK_DRAW_SCALE:ASSASSIN_RUN_DRAW_SCALE);
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*sc,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(156/192)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesTankSprites()&&TANK_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*TANK_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(232/256)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites()&&BERSERKER_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*BERSERKER_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(232/256)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesPriestSprites()&&PRIEST_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*PRIEST_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(236/256)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesMageSprites()&&MAGE_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*MAGE_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(236/256)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesPaladinSprites()&&PALADIN_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*PALADIN_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(234/256)*dh;
  }else{
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*1.4,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-dh;
  }
  return sy+(bob+dy)*_sv;
}

function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ARCHER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesAssassinSprites() && ASSASSIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=BERSERKER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return BERSERKER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPriestSprites() && PRIEST_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PRIEST_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesMageSprites() && MAGE_ANIM[name]){
    const a=MAGE_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return MAGE_ANIM.idle;

  if(playerUsesPaladinSprites() && PALADIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PALADIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PALADIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  return ANIM[name]||ANIM.idle;
}
// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ARCHER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesAssassinSprites() && ASSASSIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=BERSERKER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return BERSERKER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPriestSprites() && PRIEST_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PRIEST_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesMageSprites() && MAGE_ANIM[name]){
    const a=MAGE_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return MAGE_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPaladinSprites() && PALADIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PALADIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PALADIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  return ANIM[name]||ANIM.idle;
}
// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function ppaPlayerNickname(){
  try{
    var n=(typeof INV!=='undefined'&&INV&&String(INV.playerName||'').trim())
      ||String(window.PPA_PLAYER_NAME||'').trim();
    return n||'';
  }catch(_){return String(window.PPA_PLAYER_NAME||'').trim()}
}
function ppaPlayerVisualTopScreenY(){
  var sy=P.y-cam.y;
  var _sv=P.scene==='clansiege'?CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE:1;
  var bob=Math.sin(P.bob)*(playerUsesGnomeSprites()?2.0:3)*_sv;
  var dh,dy;
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites()){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*GNOME_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(113/128)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesArcherSprites()){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*ARCHER_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(184/224)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesAssassinSprites()&&ASSASSIN_ANIM[P.anim]){
    var sc=(P.anim==='idle')?ASSASSIN_IDLE_DRAW_SCALE:(P.anim==='attack'?ASSASSIN_ATTACK_DRAW_SCALE:ASSASSIN_RUN_DRAW_SCALE);
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*sc,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(156/192)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesTankSprites()&&TANK_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*TANK_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(232/256)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites()&&BERSERKER_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*BERSERKER_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(232/256)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesPriestSprites()&&PRIEST_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*PRIEST_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(236/256)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesMageSprites()&&MAGE_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*MAGE_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(236/256)*dh;
  }else if(playerUsesPaladinSprites()&&PALADIN_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*PALADIN_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(234/256)*dh;
  }else{
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*1.4,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-dh;
  }
  return sy+(bob+dy)*_sv;
}
function ppaPlayerClanName(){
  try{
    var c=(typeof CLAN_LOCAL_STATE!=='undefined'&&CLAN_LOCAL_STATE&&CLAN_LOCAL_STATE.clan)
      ?String(CLAN_LOCAL_STATE.clan.name||'').trim():'';
    return c;
  }catch(_){return ''}
}
function drawPlayerNickname(){
  var name=ppaPlayerNickname();
  if(!name)return;
  var clan=ppaPlayerClanName();
  var sx=P.x-cam.x;
  var y=ppaPlayerVisualTopScreenY()-9;

  cx.save();
  cx.textAlign='center';
  cx.textBaseline='bottom';
  cx.lineJoin='round';

  if(clan){
    var clanText='['+clan.slice(0,18)+']';
    cx.font='700 8px Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif';
    cx.lineWidth=2.4;
    cx.strokeStyle='rgba(8,12,20,.94)';
    cx.shadowColor='rgba(0,0,0,.78)';
    cx.shadowBlur=3;
    cx.strokeText(clanText,sx,y-12);
    cx.shadowBlur=0;
    cx.fillStyle='#a9cfff';
    cx.fillText(clanText,sx,y-12);
  }

  cx.font='600 10px Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif';
  cx.lineWidth=2.6;
  cx.strokeStyle='rgba(18,8,5,.92)';
  cx.shadowColor='rgba(0,0,0,.72)';
  cx.shadowBlur=3;
  cx.strokeText(name.slice(0,18),sx,y);
  cx.shadowBlur=0;
  cx.fillStyle='#f2d39a';
  cx.fillText(name.slice(0,18),sx,y);
  cx.restore();
}

function drawPlayer(){
  const sx=P.x-cam.x,sy=P.y-cam.y;
  const siegeVisualScale=P.scene==='clansiege'?CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE:1;

  // V277: only the player's 8 classes are drawn 10 px smaller.
  // No collision, camera, NPC, mob, AI or combat values are changed.
  const PLAYER_CLASS_EXTRA_REDUCTION_PX=10;
  const playerClassDrawHeight=(baseHeight)=>{
    const sc=Math.max(.01,Number(siegeVisualScale)||1);
    return Math.max(8,phoneCharacterDrawHeight(baseHeight,siegeVisualScale)-PLAYER_CLASS_EXTRA_REDUCTION_PX/sc);
  };
  const playerClassBodySize=(baseSize)=>{
    const sc=Math.max(.01,Number(siegeVisualScale)||1);
    return Math.max(8,phoneCharacterBodySize(baseSize,siegeVisualScale)-PLAYER_CLASS_EXTRA_REDUCTION_PX/sc);
  };
  const isGnome=playerUsesGnomeSprites();
  const isArcher=playerUsesArcherSprites();
  const isAssassinCustom=playerUsesAssassinSprites()&&!!ASSASSIN_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isTank=playerUsesTankSprites()&&!!TANK_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isBerserker=playerUsesBerserkerSprites()&&!!BERSERKER_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isPriest=playerUsesPriestSprites()&&!!PRIEST_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isMage=playerUsesMageSprites()&&!!MAGE_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isPaladin=playerUsesPaladinSprites()&&!!PALADIN_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isCustomDirectional=isGnome||isArcher||isAssassinCustom||isTank||isBerserker||isPriest||isMage||isPaladin;
  const phoneBodyBase=playerClassBodySize(P.sz);
  const visualBody=(isGnome?phoneBodyBase*0.72:phoneBodyBase)*siegeVisualScale;
  const bob=P.scene==='fartzone'?0:Math.sin(P.bob)*(isGnome?2.0:3);

  // Shadow follows the visible character size.
  // Fart Zone: exact feet-to-ground anchor, no visual hovering.

    PT.push({x:P.x+(Math.random()-.5)*(isGnome?6:12)*siegeVisualScale,y:P.y+visualBody*0.35,
      vx:-P.vx*0.4+(Math.random()-.5),vy:-P.vy*0.2+(Math.random()-.5)*0.5,
      life:10,ml:10,sz:(isGnome?1.5:2)*siegeVisualScale,col:'rgba(120,100,70,0.4)'});

  cx.save();
  cx.translate(sx,sy+bob);
  if(P.scene==='clansiege')cx.scale(CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE,CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE);

  // Legacy lean/recoil is disabled for the dwarf because his approved
  // 4-frame attack already contains the physical movement.
  if(!isCustomDirectional){
    let lean=0;
    if(P.shootT>0)lean=P.face>0?0.12:-0.12;
    const rc=P.recoil*6*(P.face>0?-1:1);
    cx.translate(rc,0);
    cx.rotate(lean);
  }

  const cur=playerAnimDef(P.anim);
  const canonicalDir=isCustomDirectional?playerDir8():0;
  const dirRow=isGnome
    ? GNOME_SOURCE_ROW[canonicalDir]
    : (isArcher
        ? ARCHER_SOURCE_ROW[canonicalDir]
        : (isAssassinCustom
            ? (P.anim==='run'
                ? ASSASSIN_RUN_SOURCE_ROW[canonicalDir]
                : ASSASSIN_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir])
            : (isTank
                ? TANK_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                : (isBerserker
                    ? BERSERKER_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                    : (isPriest
                        ? PRIEST_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                        : (isMage
                            ? MAGE_4

function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ARCHER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesAssassinSprites() && ASSASSIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=BERSERKER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return BERSERKER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPriestSprites() && PRIEST_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PRIEST_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesMageSprites() && MAGE_ANIM[name]){
    const a=MAGE_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return MAGE_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPaladinSprites() && PALADIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PALADIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PALADIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  return ANIM[name]||ANIM.idle;
}
// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ARCHER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesAssassinSprites() && ASSASSIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=BERSERKER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return BERSERKER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPriestSprites() && PRIEST_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PRIEST_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesMageSprites() && MAGE_ANIM[name]){
    const a=MAGE_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return MAGE_ANIM.idle;

    const a=PALADIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;

  return ANIM[name]||ANIM.idle;

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function worldBossDailyKey(ts){
  const d=new Date(ts==null?Date.now():ts);
  if(d.getHours()<18)d.setDate(d.getDate()-1);
  return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
}
function worldBossNextResetAt(ts){
  const now=ts==null?Date.now():Number(ts);
  const d=new Date(now);d.setHours(18,0,0,0);
  if(now>=d.getTime())d.setDate(d.getDate()+1);
  return d.getTime();
}
function worldBossDailyState(){
  if(!INV.worldBossDaily||typeof INV.worldBossDaily!=='object'){
    INV.worldBossDaily={killedCycle:'',killedAt:0};
  }
  return INV.worldBossDaily;
}
function worldBossDailyStatus(ts){
  const now=ts==null?Date.now():Number(ts),st=worldBossDailyState(),cycle=worldBossDailyKey(now);
  const available=String(st.killedCycle||'')!==cycle;
  return {
    available:available,
    killedThisCycle:!available,
    cycle:cycle,
    killedAt:Number(st.killedAt)||0,
    nextResetAt:worldBossNextResetAt(now),
    resetHour:18
  };
}
function worldBossDailyAvailable(){return worldBossDailyStatus().available}

  try{saveGame()}catch(_){}
  try{sendEventsState()}catch(_){}
  return worldBossDailyStatus(now);
}
function worldBossTimeLeftText(ms){
  let sec=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(Number(ms)||0)/1000);
  const h=Math.floor(sec/3600);sec%=3600;

  return String(h).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(ss).padStart(2,'0');
}

function titanShardShopResult(ok,msg,id){
  try{
    if(eventsMenuFrame&&eventsMenuFrame.contentWindow){
      eventsMenuFrame.contentWindow.postMessage({
        type:'titanShardShopResult',ok:!!ok,message:String(msg||''),id:id||'',
        titanShards:titanShardCount()
      },'*');
    }
  }catch(_){}
}
function titanShardExchange(id){
  id=String(id||'');
  const offer=TITAN_SHARD_OFFERS[id];
  if(!offer){titanShardShopResult(false,'Предмет обмена не найден',id);return}
  if(P.scene!=='safe'||transitioning){
    titanShardShopResult(false,'Обмен доступен только в Мирном городе',id);return;
  }

  const have=titanShardCount();
  if(have<offer.cost){
    titanShardShopResult(false,'Не хватает осколков · нужно '+offer.cost,id);return;
  }

  INV.materials[WORLD_BOSS_SHARD_NAME]=have-offer.cost;
  const out=[];

  if(id==='normalStone')worldBossAddNormalStone(3,out);
  else if(id==='hpRegen')worldBossAddPremiumHpRegen(3,out);
  else if(id==='portal')worldBossAddPortalScroll(2,out);
  else if(id==='rareMat')worldBossAddRareMaterial(1,out);
  else if(id==='premiumStone')worldBossAddPremiumStone(1,out);
  else if(id==='rune')worldBossAddRune(1,out);

  worldBossLootSync();
  if(typeof sendStorageState==='function')sendStorageState();
  if(typeof saveGame==='function')saveGame();

  const reward=out.length?out.join(' · '):offer.name;
  showPickup('💠 ОБМЕН · '+reward+' · −'+offer.cost+' оск.','#79c9ff');
  titanShardShopResult(true,'Получено: '+reward,id);
}

const WORLD_BOSS_SHARD_NAME='Осколок Кристального Титана';

const TITAN_SHARD_OFFERS={
  normalStone:{id:'normalStone',name:'Обычная заточка ×3',cost:1,icon:'◆'},
  hpRegen:{id:'hpRegen',name:'Премиум-реген HP ×3',cost:2,icon:'❤'},
  portal:{id:'portal',name:'Свиток телепорта ×2',cost:3,icon:'📜'},
  rareMat:{id:'rareMat',name:'Редкий материал ×1',cost:4,icon:'✦'},
  premiumStone:{id:'premiumStone',name:'Премиум-заточка ×1',cost:6,icon:'💎'},
  rune:{id:'rune',name:'Руна ×1',cost:12,icon:'ᚱ'}
};
function titanShardCount(){
  return Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number((INV.materials||{})[WORLD_BOSS_SHARD_NAME])||0));
}

function worldBossDailyKey(ts){
  const d=new Date(ts==null?Date.now():ts);
  if(d.getHours()<18)d.setDate(d.getDate()-1);
  return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
}
function worldBossNextResetAt(ts){
  const now=ts==null?Date.now():Number(ts);
  const d=new Date(now);d.setHours(18,0,0,0);
  if(now>=d.getTime())d.setDate(d.getDate()+1);
  return d.getTime();
}
function worldBossDailyState(){
  if(!INV.worldBossDaily||typeof INV.worldBossDaily!=='object'){
    INV.worldBossDaily={killedCycle:'',killedAt:0};
  }
  return INV.worldBossDaily;
}
function worldBossDailyStatus(ts){
  const now=ts==null?Date.now():Number(ts),st=worldBossDailyState(),cycle=worldBossDailyKey(now);
  const available=String(st.killedCycle||'')!==cycle;
  return {
    available:available,
    killedThisCycle:!available,
    cycle:cycle,
    killedAt:Number(st.killedAt)||0,
    nextResetAt:worldBossNextResetAt(now),
    resetHour:18
  };
}
function worldBossDailyAvailable(){return worldBossDailyStatus().available}
function worldBossMarkKilled(){
  const st=worldBossDailyState(),now=Date.now();
  st.killedCycle=worldBossDailyKey(now);st.killedAt=now;
  try{saveGame()}catch(_){}
  try{sendEventsState()}catch(_){}
  return worldBossDailyStatus(now);
}
function worldBossTimeLeftText(ms){
  let sec=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(Number(ms)||0)/1000);
  const h=Math.floor(sec/3600);sec%=3600;
  const m=Math.floor(sec/60),ss=sec%60;
  return String(h).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(ss).padStart(2,'0');
}
window.worldBossDailyStatus=worldBossDailyStatus;
window.worldBossDailyAvailable=worldBossDailyAvailable;

function sendEventsState(){
  try{
    if(eventsMenuFrame&&eventsMenuFrame.contentWindow){
      eventsMenuFrame.contentWindow.postMessage({
        type:'eventsState',
        titanShards:titanShardCount(),
        worldBoss:worldBossDailyStatus(),
        clanSiege:(typeof clanSiegeCycleStatus==='function'?clanSiegeCycleStatus():{ready:true,nextAt:0,remainingMs:0,text:'ОСАДА ДОСТУПНА'})
      },'*');
    }
  }catch(_){}
}
function titanShardShopResult(ok,msg,id){
  try{
    if(eventsMenuFrame&&eventsMenuFrame.contentWindow){
      eventsMenuFrame.contentWindow.postMessage({
        type:'titanShardShopResult',ok:!!ok,message:String(msg||''),id:id||'',
        titanShards:titanShardCount()
      },'*');
    }
  }catch(_){}
}
function titanShardExchange(id){
  id=String(id||'');
  const offer=TITAN_SHARD_OFFERS[id];
  if(!offer){titanShardShopResult(false,'Предмет обмена не найден',id);return}
  if(P.scene!=='safe'||transitioning){
    titanShardShopResult(false,'Обмен доступен только в Мирном городе',id);return;
  }

  const have=titanShardCount();
  if(have<offer.cost){
    titanShardShopResult(false,'Не хватает осколков · нужно '+offer.cost,id);return;
  }

  INV.materials[WORLD_BOSS_SHARD_NAME]=have-offer.cost;
  const out=[];

  if(id==='normalStone')worldBossAddNormalStone(3,out);
  else if(id==='hpRegen')worldBossAddPremiumHpRegen(3,out);
  else if(id==='portal')worldBossAddPortalScroll(2,out);
  else if(id==='rareMat')worldBossAddRareMaterial(1,out);
  else if(id==='premiumStone')worldBossAddPremiumStone(1,out);
  else if(id==='rune')worldBossAddRune(1,out);

  worldBossLootSync();
  if(typeof sendStorageState==='function')sendStorageState();
  if(typeof saveGame==='function')saveGame();

  const reward=out.length?out.join(' · '):offer.name;
  showPickup('💠 ОБМЕН · '+reward+' · −'+offer.cost+' оск.','#79c9ff');
  titanShardShopResult(true,'Получено: '+reward,id);
}

// Fart Zone guard per-kill drops.
// Percent -> probability:
// Epic gear 0.001% = 0.00001
// Epic universal rune 0.00012% = 0.0000012
// Common universal rune 10% = 0.10
// Premium sharpening rune 6% = 0.06
const FART_GUARD_EPIC_GEAR_CHANCE=0.00001;
const FART_GUARD_EPIC_RUNE_CHANCE=0.0000012;

const FART_ZONE_STATE={
  ready:false,
  mines:[],

function fartShuffle(a){
  a=a.slice();
  for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){
    const j=(Math.random()*(i+1))|0;
    const t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;
  }
  return a;
}

function fartMineTypePool(){
  // Random placement every visit, while preserving a useful mix:
  // 3 gold, 2 PPA and 8 resource mines.
  return fartShuffle([
    'gold','gold','gold',
    'ppa','ppa',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource'
  ]);
}

function fartGuardSpriteIndex(){
  // Only complete, readable, non-tiny full-body assets.
  // Excludes partial FX / eyes / weapons / tiny sprites.
  const pool=[9,10,13,15,16];
  return pool[(Math.random()*pool.length)|0];
}

function fartSpawnGuard(mine,index,forcedAngle){
  if(P.scene!=='fartzone')return null;
  const count=Math.max(3,Math.min(5,mine.guardCount||4));
  const a=(forcedAngle!==undefined?forcedAngle:(Math.PI*2*index/count))+((Math.random()-.5)*0.32);
  const r=72+Math.random()*34;
  const x=mine.x+Math.cos(a)*r;
  const y=mine.y+Math.sin(a)*r*.72;
  const spriteIndex=fartGuardSpriteIndex();
  const names=['Каменный громила','Пещерный воин','Дикий страж','Горный хищник','Рудный берсерк'];
  const e={
    id:eid++,
    type:{n:names[(Math.random()*names.length)|0]},
    x:x,y:y,hx:x,hy:y,lvl:40,
    hp:FART_GUARD_HP,mhp:FART_GUARD_HP,mp:0,mmp:0,
    sp:2.05+Math.random()*.30,sz:38,col:'#9c7150',
    dmg:43+((Math.random()*14)|0),dmgType:'physical',def:FART_GUARD_DEF,
    xp:0,gold:0,
    sprite:DUNGEON_MOB_IMAGES[spriteIndex],
    atkCD:0,flash:0,bob:Math.random()*6,aggro:false,
    edgeChase:false,edgeWait:0,
    fartMoving:false,fartWalkPhase:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,face:(Math.random()<.5?-1:1),
    isFartGuard:true,fartMineId:mine.id,fartGuardIndex:index,
    // Elite label/HP presentation; Fart Zone gets its own controlled visual scale.
    isDungeonElite:true,
    noFartReward:true
  };
  EN.push(e);
  return e;
}

function fartGuardCooldownKey(mineId,index){
  return String(mineId||'')+':'+Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(index)||0));
}

function fartGuardCooldownAt(mineId,index){
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns=(INV.fartGuardCooldowns&&typeof INV.fartGuardCooldowns==='object')?INV.fartGuardCooldowns:{};
  return Math.max(0,Number(INV.fartGuardCooldowns[fartGuardCooldownKey(mineId,index)])||0);
}

function fartSpawnGuardGroup(mine){
  mine.guardCount=3+((Math.random()*3)|0);
  const now=Date.now();
  for(let i=0;i<mine.guardCount;i++){
    const at=fartGuardCooldownAt(mine.id,i);
    if(at>now){
      FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.push({mineId:mine.id,index:i,at:at});
    }else{
      if(at){
        delete INV.fartGuardCooldowns[fartGuardCooldownKey(mine.id,i)];
      }
      fartSpawnGuard(mine,i);
    }
  }
}

function fartInitZone(){
  FART_ZONE_STATE.ready=true;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.length=0;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.activeMineId=null;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMining=false;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMineId=null;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.lastTick=Date.now();

  const types=fartMineTypePool();
  FART_ZONE_STATE.mines=FART_ZONE_MINE_SPOTS.map(function(p,i){
    const type=types[i]||'resource';
    return {
      id:'fart_mine_'+(i+1),
      x:p.x,y:p.y,type:type,
      art:type==='gold'?'gold':(type==='ppa'?'ppa':(Math.random()<.48?'ore':'blue')),
      goldCarry:0,ppaCarry:0,resMs:0,
      guardCount:0
    };
  });

  FART_ZONE_STATE.mines.forEach(fartSpawnGuardGroup);
}

function fartMineById(id){
  return FART_ZONE_STATE.mines.find(function(m){return m.id===id})||null;
}

function fartMineHasLivingGuard(mine){
  return EN.some(function(e){return e&&e.isFartGuard&&e.fartMineId===mine.id&&e.hp>0});
}

function fartQueueGuardRespawn(e){
  if(!e||!e.isFartGuard)return;
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns=(INV.fartGuardCooldowns&&typeof INV.fartGuardCooldowns==='object')?INV.fartGuardCooldowns:{};
  const idx=e.fartGuardIndex||0;
  const at=Date.now()+FART_GUARD_RESPAWN_MIN;
  const key=fartGuardCooldownKey(e.fartMineId,idx);
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns[key]=at;

  // Replace any stale duplicate queue entry for the same guard.
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns=FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.filter(function(q){
    return !(q&&q.mineId===e.fartMineId&&Number(q.index||0)===Number(idx));
  });
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.push({mineId:e.fartMineId,index:idx,at:at});
  try{saveGame()}catch(_){}
}

function fartPushUniversalRune(e,rarity){
  const types=Object.keys(RUNE_TYPES||{});
  if(!types.length)return false;
  const type=types[(Math.random()*types.length)|0];
  const d=runeDefByKey(runeKey(type,rarity));
  if(!d)return false;
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
    y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
    kind:'statRune',
    runeKey:d.key,name:d.name,icon:d.icon,img:d.img,
    rarity:rarity,bob:Math.random()*6
  });
  return true;
}

// === V211 CHARACTER XP CURVE ===============================================
// XP needed to go from the CURRENT level to the next one.
// Early levels are deliberately slower than before; from level 10 onward
// the requirement grows by 20% per level so progression stays meaningful
// without the old runaway x1.4 curve.
const XP_REQ_EARLY={1:200,2:300,3:450,4:650,5:900,6:1200,7:1600,8:2100,9:2700,10:3400};
function xpRequiredForLevel(level){
  const L=Math.max(1,Math.floor(Number(level)||1));
  if(L<=10)return XP_REQ_EARLY[L];
  return Math.max(3400,Math.round((3400*Math.pow(1.20,L-10))/100)*100);
}
function syncXpRequirement(){P.xn=xpRequiredForLevel(P.lvl);return P.xn;}

const EN=[],PR=[],PT=[],LOOT=[];
const PLAYER_CANNONBALLS=[]; // V126: dwarf shots; separate from hostile boss projectiles

function gnomeFireCannonball(){
  // Select ONCE at the moment of the shot. No target search is done in the
  // projectile update loop.
  let target=null;
  if(P.tid!=null){
    target=EN.find(function(e){return e&&e.id==P.tid&&e.hp>0&&targetIsValid(e)})||null;
    if(target){
      const edge=(target.sz&&target.sz>30)?Math.max(0,(target.sz-30)*.4):0;
      if(Math.hypot(target.x-P.x,target.y-P.y)>playerBasicRange()+edge)target=null;
    }
  }
  if(!target)target=findNearBasic();
  P.tid=target?target.id:null;
  if(!target)return false;

  const dx=target.x-P.x,dy=target.y-P.y;
  const dist=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));
  const ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  const speed=7;

  P.face=dx<0?-1:1;
  P.meleeAng=ang;
  P.shootT=1;
  P.recoil=0;

  const muzzleX=P.x+dx/dist*24;
  const muzzleY=P.y-7+dy/dist*10;
  PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.push({
    x:muzzleX,
    y:muzzleY,
    vx:dx/dist*speed,
    vy:dy/dist*speed,
    remaining:dist,
    target:target
  });

  // Very small game-layer muzzle kick so firing while running still reads
  // clearly without adding effects into the sprite sheet.
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    PT.push({
      x:muzzleX,y:muzzleY,
      vx:dx/dist*(1.2+i*.45)+(Math.random()-.5)*.6,
      vy:dy/dist*(1.2+i*.45)+(Math.random()-.5)*.6,
      life:6,ml:6,sz:1.5+i*.45,
      col:i===0?'#ffd36a':'#c47a32'
    });
  }
  return true;
}
function updatePlayerCannonballs(){
  // Extremely small loop: move each ball toward the coordinates captured at
  // fire time. At arrival, use the game's already proven damage routine.
  for(let i=PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=PLAYER_CANNONBALLS[i];
    b.x+=b.vx;
    b.y+=b.vy;
    b.remaining-=Math.hypot(b.vx,b.vy);

    if(b.remaining<=0){
      const t=b.target;
      if(t&&t.hp>0){
        try{
          applyBasicAttackHit(t);
        }catch(_){
          const raw=Math.max(1,Math.floor(P.atk||12)-(t.def||0));
          t.hp=Math.max(0,t.hp-raw);
          t.flash=6;t.aggro=true;
        }
      }
      PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
}
function drawPlayerCannonballs(){
  const _vw=cv.width/cameraZoom(),_vh=cv.height/cameraZoom();
  for(const b of PLAYER_CANNONBALLS){
    const x=b.x-cam.x,y=b.y-cam.y;
    if(x<-24||y<-24||x>_vw+24||y>_vh+24)continue;
    cx.save();

    // Small but clearly readable cannonball on a phone screen.
    cx.fillStyle='rgba(214,125,42,.30)';
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x,y,10,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

    cx.fillStyle='#24272b';
    cx.strokeStyle='#d68a3d';
    cx.lineWidth=2;
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x,y,7,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();cx.stroke();

    cx.fillStyle='rgba(255,221,155,.75)';
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x-2,y-2,2,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

    cx.restore();
  }
}

// === V141 ARCHER BASIC ARROW ==============================================
const PLAYER_ARROWS=[];

function archerFireArrow(){
  let target=null;

  // Prefer the target already locked by Smart Attack.
  if(P.tid!=null){
    target=EN.find(function(e){
      return e&&e.id==P.tid&&e.hp>0&&targetIsValid(e);
    })||null;

    if(target){
      const range=playerBasicRange();
      if(P.scene==='clanboss1'&&target.isClanBoss){
        if(clanBossDistanceFromBody(target,P.x,P.y)>range)target=null;
      }else{
        const edge=(target.sz&&target.sz>30)?Math.max(0,(target.sz-30)*.4):0;
        if(Math.hypot(target.x-P.x,target.y-P.y)>range+edge)target=null;
      }
    }
  }

  if(!target)target=findNearBasic();
  P.tid=target?target.id:null;
  if(!target)return false;

  const dx=target.x-P.x,dy=target.y-P.y;
  const dist=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));
  const ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  const speed=12;

  P.face=dx<0?-1:1;
  P.meleeAng=ang;
  P.shootT=1;
  P.recoil=0;

  // Start near the bow hand / chest rather than from the character's feet.
  const startX=P.x+Math.cos(ang)*20;
  const startY=P.y-18+Math.sin(ang)*8;

  PLAYER_ARROWS.push({
    x:startX,y:startY,
    vx:Math.cos(ang)*speed,
    vy:Math.sin(ang)*speed,
    remaining:dist,
    target:target,
    ang:ang
  });

  // Tiny bow release read; deliberately light, no glow spam.
  PT.push({
    x:startX,y:startY,
    vx:-Math.cos(ang)*.7,vy:-Math.sin(ang)*.7,
    life:5,ml:5,sz:1.5,col:'#d8c18b'
  });
  return true;
}

function applyScavengerSlimeVariant(e){

  // 24 distinct visual combinations:
  // 3 colors × 2 mirror directions × 4 silhouettes (width only; height is unchanged).

  e.slimeVariant=v;
  e.sprite=SLIME_SCAVENGER_IMAGES[v%3];
  e.slimeFlip=(Math.floor(v/3)%2)===1;
  e.slimeWidthMul=SLIME_SCAVENGER_WIDTHS[Math.floor(v/6)%4];
  return e;
}

function dungeon1120DefBonus(lv){
  lv=Math.max(1,Math.min(20,Number(lv)||1));
  if(lv<11)return 0;
  if(lv<=12)return 3;
  if(lv<=14)return 4;
  if(lv<=16)return 5;
  if(lv<=18)return 6;
  return 7; // 19–20
}

  {key:'tough',label:'ЖИВУЧИЙ',hp:550,dmg:21},

function dungeon21ReferenceStats(baseLvl,roomOrd){
  const lv=Math.max(21,Math.min(40,Math.max(1,Math.min(20,Number(baseLvl)||1))+20));
  const v=DUNGEON21_ARCHETYPES[(Number(roomOrd)||0)%DUNGEON21_ARCHETYPES.length];

  var minHp,maxHp,t;
  if(lv<=25){minHp=900;maxHp=1300;t=(lv-21)/4;}
  else if(lv<=30){minHp=1300;maxHp=1800;t=(lv-26)/4;}
  else if(lv<=35){minHp=2000;maxHp=3000;t=(lv-31)/4;}
  else {minHp=3000;maxHp=4500;t=(lv-36)/4;}
  t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
  var hpBase=minHp+(maxHp-minHp)*t;
  var archetypeMul=v.key==='tough'?1.10:(v.key==='berserk'?0.92:1.00);
  var hp=Math.round(Math.max(minHp,Math.min(maxHp,hpBase*archetypeMul)));
  hp+=(lv<=30)?250:210;

  var defSteps=Math.max(0,Math.floor((lv-30)/5));
  var baseDef=Math.round(Math.max(20,lv-1)*(1+defSteps*0.05));
  if(lv>=30)baseDef+=6;
  var def=(v.key==='armored')?baseDef*2:baseDef;

  return {lvl:lv,hp:hp,def:def,dmg:v.dmg,v:v};
}

function dungeon21BossUpdate(e,dx,dy,d){
  const now=Date.now();
  e.x=e.hx;e.y=e.hy;
  e.d21Dir=dungeon21BossDir(dx,dy);

  // Lightweight AOE: simple telegraph circle; no heavy sprite/filter effect.
  if(!e.d21AoePending && now>=e.d21NextAoe && d<520){
    e.d21AoePending=true;
    e.d21AoeImpactAt=now+700;
    e.d21ActionUntil=now+900;
    e.d21State='attack';
    e.d21AoeFxUntil=now+1050;
    e.d21NextAoe=now+9000+Math.random()*4000;
  }
  if(e.d21AoePending && now>=e.d21AoeImpactAt){
    e.d21AoePending=false;
    if(d<=DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_RADIUS){
      if(Math.random()*100<effectivePlayerDodge()){
        showPickup('Уворот от скверны!','#aaff88');
      }else{
        P.hp-=playerDmg(DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_DMG,'magic');
        showPickup('AOE Скверны · −'+playerDmg(DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_DMG,'magic'),'#a8ff62');
      }
    }
    for(let j=0;j<6;j++)PT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_RADIUS*1.5,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_RADIUS*.55,
      vx:(Math.random()-.5)*1.5,vy:-Math.random()*1.3,
      life:18,ml:18,sz:2+Math.random()*2,col:Math.random()<.5?'#76b82a':'#9be83d'
    });
  }

  // Physical staff strike.
  const reach=112;
  if(!e.d21AoePending && d<=reach && e.atkCD<=0){
    e.d21State='attack';
    e.d21ActionUntil=now+520;
    e.atkCD=62;
    if(Math.random()*100<effectivePlayerDodge()){
      showPickup('Уворот!','#88ffcc');
    }else{
      const dealt=playerDmg(DUNGEON21_BOSS_STAFF_DMG,'physical');
      P.hp-=dealt;
      showPickup('Посох · −'+dealt,'#e8c6a0');
    }
    for(let j=0;j<4;j++)PT.push({
      x:P.x,y:P.y-12,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*4,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*4,
      life:11,ml:11,sz:2+Math.random()*2,col:'#7aa43a'
    });
  }

  if(now>=e.d21ActionUntil&&!e.d21AoePending)e.d21State='idle';
}
function drawDungeon21BossAoe(e,sx,sy){
  const now=Date.now();
  if(!e.d21AoeFxUntil||now>=e.d21AoeFxUntil)return;
  const left=Math.max(0,e.d21AoeFxUntil-now);
  const total=1050;
  const k=1-left/total;
  const rr=DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_RADIUS*(e.d21AoePending?1:(.72+.28*k));
  cx.save();
  // V218: ONLY a thin floor ring. No fill = no green "inflating belly".
  cx.lineWidth=e.d21AoePending?2.2:1.6;
  cx.strokeStyle=e.d21AoePending?'rgba(137,255,82,.82)':'rgba(110,220,55,.55)';
  if(e.d21AoePending)cx.setLineDash([8,6]);
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.ellipse(sx,sy+72,rr,Math.max(18,rr*.20),0,0,Math.PI*2);
  cx.stroke();
  cx.setLineDash([]);
  cx.restore();
}

  if(Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy))return dx<0?'left':'right';
  return dy<0?'up':'down';
}

  return dir==='down'?0:dir==='left'?1:dir==='right'?2:3;

function dungeon21BossUpdate(e,dx,dy,d){
  const now=Date.now();
  e.x=e.hx;e.y=e.hy;
  e.d21Dir=dungeon21BossDir(dx,dy);

  // Lightweight AOE: simple telegraph circle; no heavy sprite/filter effect.
  if(!e.d21AoePending && now>=e.d21NextAoe && d<520){
    e.d21AoePending=true;
    e.d21AoeImpactAt=now+700;
    e.d21ActionUntil=now+900;
    e.d21State='attack';
    e.d21AoeFxUntil=now+1050;
    e.d21NextAoe=now+9000+Math.random()*4000;
  }
  if(e.d21AoePending && now>=e.d21AoeImpactAt){
    e.d21AoePending=false;
    if(d<=DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_RADIUS){
      if(Math.random()*100<effectivePlayerDodge()){
        showPickup('Уворот от скверны!','#aaff88');
      }else{
        P.hp-=playerDmg(DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_DMG,'magic');
        showPickup('AOE Скверны · −'+playerDmg(DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_DMG,'magic'),'#a8ff62');
      }
    }
    for(let j=0;j<6;j++)PT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_RADIUS*1.5,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_RADIUS*.55,
      vx:(Math.random()-.5)*1.5,vy:-Math.random()*1.3,
      life:18,ml:18,sz:2+Math.random()*2,col:Math.random()<.5?'#76b82a':'#9be83d'
    });
  }

  // Physical staff strike.
  const reach=112;
  if(!e.d21AoePending && d<=reach && e.atkCD<=0){
    e.d21State='attack';
    e.d21ActionUntil=now+520;
    e.atkCD=62;
    if(Math.random()*100<effectivePlayerDodge()){
      showPickup('Уворот!','#88ffcc');
    }else{
      const dealt=playerDmg(DUNGEON21_BOSS_STAFF_DMG,'physical');
      P.hp-=dealt;
      showPickup('Посох · −'+dealt,'#e8c6a0');
    }
    for(let j=0;j<4;j++)PT.push({
      x:P.x,y:P.y-12,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*4,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*4,
      life:11,ml:11,sz:2+Math.random()*2,col:'#7aa43a'
    });
  }

  if(now>=e.d21ActionUntil&&!e.d21AoePending)e.d21State='idle';
}

function spawnMobAtPoint(si,fx){
  const p=DG_ACTIVE_SPAWNS[si];if(!p)return;
  let px=p[0]*DG_SCALE,py=p[1]*DG_SCALE;
  if(!dgCircleWalk(px,py,18)){const q=dgNearestWalk(px,py);px=q.x;py=q.y}
  const t=mobByLvl(DG_SPAWN_LVL[si]);
  let e=mkMob(t,px,py);
  if(DUNGEON_MODE==='21+')e=applyDungeon21MobStats(e,si);
  else if(DUNGEON_MODE==='41-60')e=applyDungeon41MobStats(e,si);
  e.si=si;               // точка спавна (дом моба)
  e.room=p[2];           // номер комнаты
  e.roomLevel=DG_ROOM_LVL[p[2]]||e.lvl;
  e.hx=px;e.hy=py;       // возврат на место после потери агро
  EN.push(e);
  if(fx)for(let j=0;j<7;j++)PT.push({x:px,y:py,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*5,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*5,life:18,ml:18,sz:2+Math.random()*3,col:'#8866ff'});
  return e;
}

function dropLoot(e){
  const _antiFarm=antiFarmRewardMul(e);

  // Gold remains the basic dungeon currency.
  // For heavily overleveled farming it may fall to zero instead of forcing
  // a guaranteed 1 Gold from every trivial mob.
  const base=e.gold||5;
  const gold=Math.max(0,Math.round(base*(0.8+Math.random()*0.4)*clanGoldMul()*premiumGoldMul()*_antiFarm));
  if(gold>0){
    LOOT.push({x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*20,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*20,kind:'gold',amount:gold,bob:Math.random()*6});
  }

  // PPA economy:
  // ordinary dungeon mob = 1% for 1 PPA
  // Phoenix boss = guaranteed 5 PPA
  if(e&&e.isBoss){
    LOOT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*26,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*26,
      kind:'ppa',amount:5,bob:Math.random()*6
    });
  }else if(Math.random()<PPA_DROP_CHANCE*premiumDropMul()*_antiFarm){
    LOOT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*26,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*26,
      kind:'ppa',amount:PPA_DROP_AMOUNT,bob:Math.random()*6
    });
  }

  // Phoenix Feather:
  // Phoenix boss = 2%; the 21+ boss never drops Phoenix feathers.
  // ordinary dungeon mob = 0.01%
  const _featherChance=(e&&e.isDungeon21Boss)?0:((e&&e.isBoss)?PHOENIX_FEATHER_BOSS_CHANCE:PHOENIX_FEATHER_MOB_CHANCE);
  if(Math.random()<_featherChance*rewardDropMul()*_antiFarm){
    LOOT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      kind:'phoenixFeather',amount:1,bob:Math.random()*6
    });
  }

  maybeDropStatRune(e,_antiFarm);

  const lv=Math.max(1,Math.min(20,e.roomLevel||e.lvl||1));

  if(e.isBoss){
    // Phoenix: one guaranteed random-class gear item; 40% gray / 50% green / 10% blue.

    pushMaterialDrop(e,'common',2+Math.floor(Math.random()*3)); // 2–4

    if(Math.random()<0.02*rewardDropMul()*luckCoinRareDropMul())pushMaterialDrop(e,'rare',1); // blue resource: 2% base; Luck Coin +20% relative

    // The 21+ boss does NOT use this Phoenix-specific roll.
    if(e.isDungeonPhoenixBoss&&Math.random()<0.00019*rewardDropMul())pushStoneDrop(e,'premium',1);

    // V173: ultra-rare Premium rune: Phoenix only.
    // 0.01% = roughly 1 rune per 10 000 Phoenix kills before drop multipliers.
    if(e.isDungeonPhoenixBoss&&Math.random()<0.0001*rewardDropMul())pushStoneDrop(e,'rune',1);

  }

  const stoneChance=(lv>=11?0.0012:0.0015); // V119: 11–20 slightly reduced: 0.12%; 1–10 remains 0.15%.

leportInCombat(){
  if(P.scene!=='dungeon')return false;
  const lim=900*900;
  for(let i=0;i<EN.length;i++){
    const e=EN[i];
    if(!e||e.hp<=0||!e.aggro)continue;
    const dx=e.x-P.x,dy=e.y-P.y;
    if(dx*dx+dy*dy<lim)return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function renderDungeonTeleportMenu(){
  const grid=document.getElementById('dungeonTeleportRoutes');
  const status=document.getElementById('dungeonTeleportStatus');
  if(!grid||!status)return;
  const unlocked=Math.max(0,Math.min(10,Math.floor(Number(INV.dungeonTeleportUnlocked)||0)));
  const count=Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(INV.consumables.portalStone)||0));
  status.textContent='Свитков: '+count+' · Открыто маршрутов: '+unlocked+'/10';
  grid.innerHTML='';
  DUNGEON_TELEPORT_ROUTES.forEach(function(r,i){
    const open=i<unlocked;
    const b=document.createElement('button');
    b.className='dungeonTpBtn'+(open?'':' locked');
    b.disabled=!open;
    b.innerHTML=(open?'КОРИДОР '+r.label:'🔒 КОРИДОР '+r.label)+'<small>'+(open?'Телепортировать':'Сначала пройди этот маршрут')+'</small>';
    if(open)b.addEventListener('click',function(){useDungeonTeleportRoute(i)});
    grid.appendChild(b);
  });
}
function openDungeonTeleportMenu(){
  if(transitioning||P.dead)return;
  if(P.scene!=='safe'&&P.scene!=='dungeon'){showPickup('Свиток работает только в городе и подземелье','#ffb36b');return}
  if((INV.consumables.portalStone||0)<=0){showPickup('Нет свитков телепорта','#ff7777');return}
  if(dungeonTeleportInCombat()){showPickup('Нельзя телепортироваться во время боя','#ff7777');return}
  if(INV.open)closeInventory();
  const icon=document.getElementById('dungeonTeleportIcon');if(icon)icon.src=PPA_TELEPORT_SCROLL_IMG;
  renderDungeonTeleportMenu();

  jA=false;jX=0;jY=0;
}
function useDungeonTeleportRoute(i){
  i=Math.floor(Number(i));
  const unlocked=Math.max(0,Math.min(10,Math.floor(Number(INV.dungeonTeleportUnlocked)||0)));
  if(i<0||i>=DUNGEON_TELEPORT_ROUTES.length||i>=unlocked){showPickup('Этот маршрут ещё не открыт','#ff7777');return}
  if((INV.consumables.portalStone||0)<=0){showPickup('Нет свитков телепорта','#ff7777');closeDungeonTeleportMenu();return}
  if(transitioning||P.dead)return;
  if(P.scene!=='safe'&&P.scene!=='dungeon'){showPickup('Здесь телепорт недоступен','#ff7777');closeDungeonTeleportMenu();return}
  if(dungeonTeleportInCombat()){showPickup('Нельзя телепортироваться во время боя','#ff7777');closeDungeonTeleportMenu();return}
  INV.consumables.portalStone--;
  P.tid=null;P.attacking=false;P.shootT=0;P.recoil=0;PR.length=0;
  closeDungeonTeleportMenu();
  const label=DUNGEON_TELEPORT_ROUTES[i].label;
  if(P.scene==='dungeon'){
    const sp=dungeonTeleportRouteWorld(i);
    if(sp){
      const fade=document.getElementById('fade');
      transitioning=true;fade.classList.add('on');
      setTimeout(function(){
        P.x=sp.x;P.y=sp.y;P.vx=0;P.vy=0;P.portalCD=60;
        fade.classList.remove('on');transitioning=false;updateUI();
        showPickup('📜 Телепорт · коридор '+label,'#8fd3ff');
      },220);
    }
  }else{
    DUNGEON_TELEPORT_PENDING=i;
    changeScene('dungeon');
    setTimeout(function(){showPickup('📜 Телепорт · коридор '+label,'#8fd3ff')},900);
  }
  saveGame();sendInvState();updateConsumableHud(true);
}
function checkDungeonTeleportDiscovery(){
  if(P.scene!=='dungeon'||transitioning||P.dead||typeof INV==='undefined')return;
  let unlocked=Math.max(0,Math.min(10,Math.floor(Number(INV.dungeonTeleportUnlocked)||0)));
  if(unlocked>=DUNGEON_TELEPORT_ROUTES.length)return;
  // Unlock only after physically reaching the corresponding main-corridor waypoint.
  let gained=unlocked;
  for(let i=unlocked;i<DUNGEON_TELEPORT_ROUTES.length;i++){
    const sp=dungeonTeleportRouteWorld(i);if(!sp)break;
    const dx=P.x-sp.x,dy=P.y-sp.y;
    const rr=46*DG_SCALE;
    if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=rr*rr)gained=i+1;
    else break;
  }
  if(gained>unlocked){
    INV.dungeonTeleportUnlocked=gained;
    saveGame();
    showPickup('Открыт маршрут телепорта: '+DUNGEON_TELEPORT_ROUTES[gained-1].label,'#ffd36b');
  }
}

function ppaGetVignetteGradient(){

function resetPetFollower(){
  PET_FOLLOW.x=P.x-(P.face||1)*50;PET_FOLLOW.y=P.y+22;PET_FOLLOW.scene=P.scene;PET_FOLLOW.phase=0;PET_FOLLOW.dir='S';
}
function updatePetFollower(){
  var it=INV&&INV.equipped?INV.equipped.pet:null;if(!it)return;
  if(PET_FOLLOW.scene!==P.scene||Math.hypot(PET_FOLLOW.x-P.x,PET_FOLLOW.y-P.y)>330)resetPetFollower();
  var mv=Math.hypot(P.vx||0,P.vy||0),dxn,dyn;
  if(mv>.15){dxn=(P.vx||0)/mv;dyn=(P.vy||0)/mv}
  else{var pf=playerFacing4();dxn=pf==='E'?1:pf==='W'?-1:0;dyn=pf==='S'?1:pf==='N'?-1:0}
  var tx=P.x-dxn*52-dyn*16,ty=P.y-dyn*52+dxn*16+10;
  var dx=tx-PET_FOLLOW.x,dy=ty-PET_FOLLOW.y,dd=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  var step=Math.min(dd,Math.max(1.7,Math.min(6.3,dd*.11)));
  if(dd>1){PET_FOLLOW.x+=dx/dd*step;PET_FOLLOW.y+=dy/dd*step;
    if(Math.abs(dy)>Math.abs(dx))PET_FOLLOW.dir=dy>0?'S':'N';else PET_FOLLOW.dir=dx>0?'E':'W'}
  PET_FOLLOW.phase+=(dd>1.2?.34:.09);
}

function pushMaterialDrop(e,rarity,amount){

  var name=randFrom(pool),def=MATERIAL_DB[name];

  });
}

function pushMaterialDrop(e,rarity,amount){

  });
}

let loadedCount=0;
const totalRes=RESOURCES.length;
let gameStarted=false;
const loadBarFill=document.getElementById('loadBarFill');
const loadText=document.getElementById('loadText');
const loadDetail=document.getElementById('loadDetail');
const loadPct=document.getElementById('loadPct');
const loadingScreen=document.getElementById('loadingScreen');

function onResLoad(name){
  loadedCount++;
  const pct=Math.round((loadedCount/totalRes)*100);
  loadBarFill.style.width=pct+'%';
  if(loadPct)loadPct.textContent=pct+'%';
  loadText.textContent='\u0417\u0430\u0433\u0440\u0443\u0437\u043a\u0430... '+loadedCount+'/'+totalRes+' ('+pct+'%)';
  loadDetail.textContent='\u2713 '+name;
  if(loadedCount>=totalRes && !gameStarted){
    startGame();
  }
}

function onResError(name){
  console.warn('Failed to load: '+name+' — using fallback');
  loadedCount++;
  const pct=Math.round((loadedCount/totalRes)*100);
  loadBarFill.style.width=pct+'%';
  if(loadPct)loadPct.textContent=pct+'%';
  loadText.textContent='\u0417\u0430\u0433\u0440\u0443\u0437\u043a\u0430... '+loadedCount+'/'+totalRes+' ('+pct+'%)';
  loadDetail.textContent='\u26a0 '+name+' (fallback)';
  if(loadedCount>=totalRes && !gameStarted){
    startGame();
  }
}

// Start loading each resource
RESOURCES.forEach(function(r){
  r.img.onload=function(){onResLoad(r.name)};
  r.img.onerror=function(){onResError(r.name)};
  // Set src AFTER attaching handlers to ensure we catch the event
  r.img.src=r.src;
});

// Safety timeout: start game after 8 seconds even if some resources fail
setTimeout(function(){
  if(!gameStarted){
    console.warn('Resource load timeout — starting with fallbacks');
    startGame();
  }
},8000);

var __gameLoopStarted=false;
function startGame(){
  if(gameStarted)return;
  gameStarted=true;
  try{loadBarFill.style.width='100%';if(loadPct)loadPct.textContent='100%';loadText.textContent='Готово';loadDetail.textContent='Мир готов';}catch(_){}
  loadingScreen.style.transition='opacity 0.5s';
  loadingScreen.style.opacity='0';
  setTimeout(function(){
    loadingScreen.style.display='none';
    Promise.resolve(typeof ppaReleaseGatewayBootstrap==='function'?ppaReleaseGatewayBootstrap():false)
      .then(function(handled){
        if(handled)return;
        var fresh=ppaConsumeFreshStandaloneCharacter();
        if(fresh){
          INV.playerName=fresh.nickname;window.PPA_PLAYER_NAME=fresh.nickname;
          try{localStorage.setItem('ppaPlayerNameV205',fresh.nickname)}catch(_){}
          applyClass({name:fresh.className});beginGame();
          return;
        }
        document.getElementById('classSelectFrame').style.display='block';
      })
      .catch(function(){
        document.getElementById('classSelectFrame').style.display='block';
      });
  },500);
}

const PPA_CLOUD={
  ready:false,loading:false,version:null,timer:0,lastErrorAt:0,profile:null
};
function ppaCloudBridgeAvailable(){
  try{return !!(window.PPA&&typeof PPA.isAvailable==='function'&&PPA.isAvailable())}catch(_){return false}
}
function ppaCloudExtract(load){
  var root=load&&typeof load==='object'?load:{};
  var version=root.version;
  if(version==null&&root.save&&typeof root.save==='object')version=root.save.version;
  if(version==null&&root.data&&typeof root.data==='object')version=root.data.version;
  var state=root.state;
  if(state==null&&root.save&&typeof root.save==='object')state=root.save.state!=null?root.save.state:root.save.save;
  if(state==null&&root.data&&typeof root.data==='object')state=root.data.state!=null?root.data.state:root.data.save;
  if(state==null&&root.gameSave&&typeof root.gameSave==='object')state=root.gameSave.state||root.gameSave.save;
  if(typeof state==='string'){try{state=JSON.parse(state)}catch(_){state=null}}
  if(!state&&root&&typeof root==='object'&&(Array.isArray(root.bag)||root.equipped))state=root;
  return {version:version==null?null:Number(version),state:state&&typeof state==='object'?state:null};
}
function ppaCloudScheduleSave(state){
  if(!PPA_CLOUD.ready||!ppaCloudBridgeAvailable())return;
  clearTimeout(PPA_CLOUD.timer);
  var snapshot=state&&typeof state==='object'?state:ppaBuildSaveObject();
  PPA_CLOUD.timer=setTimeout(function(){ppaCloudPush(snapshot)},2500);
}
async function ppaCloudPush(state){
  if(!PPA_CLOUD.ready||!ppaCloudBridgeAvailable()||typeof PPA.ppaSaveGame!=='function')return false;
  try{
    var res=await PPA.ppaSaveGame(state||ppaBuildSaveObject(),PPA_CLOUD.version);
    if(res&&Number.isFinite(Number(res.version)))PPA_CLOUD.version=Number(res.version);
    else if(res&&res.save&&Number.isFinite(Number(res.save.version)))PPA_CLOUD.version=Number(res.save.version);
    return true;
  }catch(err){
    var now=Date.now();
    if(now-PPA_CLOUD.lastErrorAt>10000){
      PPA_CLOUD.lastErrorAt=now;
      console.warn('PPA cloud save:',err);
    }
    return false;
  }
}

function ppaMigrationSaveObject(){
  var out=ppaBuildSaveObject();
  var old=(P&&P._saved&&typeof P._saved==='object')?P._saved:null;
  if(old){
    ['lvl','xp','xn','kil','rebirths','statPts','talentPts','cls'].forEach(function(k){
      if(old[k]!=null)out[k]=old[k];
    });
    if(old.statAlloc&&typeof old.statAlloc==='object')out.statAlloc=Object.assign({},old.statAlloc);
    if(old.playerName&&!out.playerName)out.playerName=old.playerName;
  }
  return out;
}

function premiumRemainingText(){
  if(GAME_STATE.premiumPermanent&amp;&amp;GAME_STATE.premiumActive)return &#x27;НАВСЕГДА&#x27;;
  const ms=Math.max(0,Number(GAME_STATE.premiumUntil||0)-Date.now());
  if(!GAME_STATE.premiumActive||ms&lt;=0)return &#x27;НЕ АКТИВЕН&#x27;;
  const d=Math.floor(ms/86400000);
  const h=Math.floor((ms%86400000)/3600000);
  const min=Math.floor((ms%3600000)/60000);
  if(d&gt;0)return d+&#x27; дн. &#x27;+h+&#x27; ч.&#x27;;
  if(h&gt;0)return h+&#x27; ч. &#x27;+min+&#x27; мин.&#x27;;
  return Math.max(1,min)+&#x27; мин.&#x27;;
}

function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ARCHER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesAssassinSprites() && ASSASSIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=BERSERKER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return BERSERKER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPriestSprites() && PRIEST_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PRIEST_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesMageSprites() && MAGE_ANIM[name]){
    const a=MAGE_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return MAGE_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPaladinSprites() && PALADIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PALADIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PALADIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  return ANIM[name]||ANIM.idle;
}
// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function classKeyFromName(name){
  var n=String(name||'').trim().toUpperCase();
  var aliases={
    'СТРАЖ':'tank','ТАНК':'tank',
    'ВАРВАР':'barbarian','БЕРСЕРК':'barbarian',
    'ПАЛАДИН':'paladin',
    'ГНОМ':'gnome','ГНОМ-КАНОНИР':'gnome',
    'ЛУЧНИК':'archer',
    'МАГ':'mage',
    'УБИЙЦА':'assassin','АССАСИН':'assassin',
    'ЖРЕЦ':'priest'
  };
  if(aliases[n])return aliases[n];
  for(var k in CLASS_SKILLS){
    if(String(CLASS_SKILLS[k].name||'').trim().toUpperCase()===n)return k;
  }
  return null;
}

function classKeyFromName(name){
  var n=String(name||'').trim().toUpperCase();
  var aliases={
    'СТРАЖ':'tank','ТАНК':'tank',
    'ВАРВАР':'barbarian','БЕРСЕРК':'barbarian',
    'ПАЛАДИН':'paladin',
    'ГНОМ':'gnome','ГНОМ-КАНОНИР':'gnome',
    'ЛУЧНИК':'archer',
    'МАГ':'mage',
    'УБИЙЦА':'assassin','АССАСИН':'assassin',
    'ЖРЕЦ':'priest'
  };
  if(aliases[n])return aliases[n];
  for(var k in CLASS_SKILLS){
    if(String(CLASS_SKILLS[k].name||'').trim().toUpperCase()===n)return k;
  }
  return null;
}

function updatePlayerCannonballs(){
  // Extremely small loop: move each ball toward the coordinates captured at
  // fire time. At arrival, use the game's already proven damage routine.
  for(let i=PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=PLAYER_CANNONBALLS[i];
    b.x+=b.vx;
    b.y+=b.vy;
    b.remaining-=Math.hypot(b.vx,b.vy);

    if(b.remaining<=0){
      const t=b.target;
      if(t&&t.hp>0){
        try{
          applyBasicAttackHit(t);
        }catch(_){
          const raw=Math.max(1,Math.floor(P.atk||12)-(t.def||0));
          t.hp=Math.max(0,t.hp-raw);
          t.flash=6;t.aggro=true;
        }
      }
      PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
}
function drawPlayerCannonballs(){
  const _vw=cv.width/cameraZoom(),_vh=cv.height/cameraZoom();
  for(const b of PLAYER_CANNONBALLS){
    const x=b.x-cam.x,y=b.y-cam.y;
    if(x<-24||y<-24||x>_vw+24||y>_vh+24)continue;
    cx.save();

    // Small but clearly readable cannonball on a phone screen.
    cx.fillStyle='rgba(214,125,42,.30)';
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x,y,10,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

    cx.fillStyle='#24272b';
    cx.strokeStyle='#d68a3d';
    cx.lineWidth=2;
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x,y,7,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();cx.stroke();

    cx.fillStyle='rgba(255,221,155,.75)';
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x-2,y-2,2,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

    cx.restore();
  }
}

// === V141 ARCHER BASIC ARROW ==============================================
const PLAYER_ARROWS=[];

function archerFireArrow(){
  let target=null;

  // Prefer the target already locked by Smart Attack.
  if(P.tid!=null){
    target=EN.find(function(e){
      return e&&e.id==P.tid&&e.hp>0&&targetIsValid(e);
    })||null;

    if(target){
      const range=playerBasicRange();
      if(P.scene==='clanboss1'&&target.isClanBoss){
        if(clanBossDistanceFromBody(target,P.x,P.y)>range)target=null;
      }else{
        const edge=(target.sz&&target.sz>30)?Math.max(0,(target.sz-30)*.4):0;
        if(Math.hypot(target.x-P.x,target.y-P.y)>range+edge)target=null;
      }
    }
  }

  if(!target)target=findNearBasic();
  P.tid=target?target.id:null;
  if(!target)return false;

  const dx=target.x-P.x,dy=target.y-P.y;
  const dist=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));
  const ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  const speed=12;

  P.face=dx<0?-1:1;
  P.meleeAng=ang;
  P.shootT=1;
  P.recoil=0;

  // Start near the bow hand / chest rather than from the character's feet.
  const startX=P.x+Math.cos(ang)*20;
  const startY=P.y-18+Math.sin(ang)*8;

  PLAYER_ARROWS.push({
    x:startX,y:startY,
    vx:Math.cos(ang)*speed,
    vy:Math.sin(ang)*speed,
    remaining:dist,
    target:target,
    ang:ang
  });

  // Tiny bow release read; deliberately light, no glow spam.
  PT.push({
    x:startX,y:startY,
    vx:-Math.cos(ang)*.7,vy:-Math.sin(ang)*.7,
    life:5,ml:5,sz:1.5,col:'#d8c18b'
  });
  return true;
}

function updatePlayerArrows(){
  for(let i=PLAYER_ARROWS.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const a=PLAYER_ARROWS[i];
    a.x+=a.vx;
    a.y+=a.vy;
    a.remaining-=Math.hypot(a.vx,a.vy);

    if(a.remaining<=0){
      const t=a.target;
      if(t&&t.hp>0){
        try{
          applyBasicAttackHit(t);
        }catch(_){
          const raw=Math.max(1,Math.floor(P.atk||12)-(t.def||0));
          t.hp=Math.max(0,t.hp-raw);
          t.flash=6;t.aggro=true;
        }

        // Small pixel impact only.
        for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
          PT.push({
            x:t.x+(Math.random()-.5)*5,
            y:t.y-8+(Math.random()-.5)*5,
            vx:(Math.random()-.5)*1.8,
            vy:(Math.random()-.5)*1.8,
            life:7,ml:7,sz:1.3+Math.random(),
            col:j===0?'#e9e1c6':'#8a6b42'
          });
        }
      }
      PLAYER_ARROWS.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
}

function drawPlayerArrows(){
  const _vw=cv.width/cameraZoom(),_vh=cv.height/cameraZoom();
  for(const a of PLAYER_ARROWS){
    const x=a.x-cam.x,y=a.y-cam.y;
    if(x<-28||y<-28||x>_vw+28||y>_vh+28)continue;

    cx.save();
    cx.translate(x,y);
    cx.rotate(a.ang);

    // Pixel-like wooden shaft.
    cx.fillStyle='#b98b55';
    cx.fillRect(-10,-1,16,2);

    // Pale metal arrow head.
    cx.fillStyle='#d9dde0';
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(10,0);
    cx.lineTo(5,-3);
    cx.lineTo(5,3);
    cx.closePath();
    cx.fill();

    // Small dark-green fletching matching the ranger palette.
    cx.fillStyle='#556b3b';
    cx.fillRect(-11,-3,4,2);
    cx.fillRect(-11,1,4,2);

    cx.restore();
  }
}
