function ppaOnlineCleanup(){
  const now=(typeof performance!=='undefined'&&performance.now)?performance.now():Date.now();
  if(now-PPA_ONLINE.lastCleanup<2000)return;PPA_ONLINE.lastCleanup=now;
  for(const [id,r] of PPA_ONLINE.remotes){if(!r||now-r.lastNetAt>12000)PPA_ONLINE.remotes.delete(id)}
}
function PPAOnlineTick(){
  const __ppaOnlineTickNow=(typeof performance!=='undefined'&&performance.now)?performance.now():Date.now();
  if(__ppaOnlineTickNow-(PPA_ONLINE._lastTickAt||0)<(PPA_ONLINE.tickMs||100))return;
  PPA_ONLINE._lastTickAt=__ppaOnlineTickNow;

  if(!PPA_ONLINE.supabase){
    if(!PPA_ONLINE.connecting&&PPA_ONLINE.retryAt&&Date.now()>=PPA_ONLINE.retryAt){PPA_ONLINE.retryAt=0;PPAOnlineInit()}
    return;
  }
  const wanted=ppaOnlineRoomKey();
  if((!PPA_ONLINE.connected||PPA_ONLINE.roomKey!==wanted)&&PPA_ONLINE.joiningKey!==wanted){
    if(!PPA_ONLINE.retryAt||Date.now()>=PPA_ONLINE.retryAt)ppaOnlineJoinRoom(wanted);
    return;
  }
  if(PPA_ONLINE.connected)ppaOnlineTrack(false);
  ppaOnlineCleanup();
}
function ppaOnlineClassColor(cls){
  cls=String(cls||'').toLowerCase();
  if(cls.includes('маг'))return'#7fa7ff';if(cls.includes('жр')||cls.includes('priest'))return'#f0d88a';
  if(cls.includes('асс')||cls.includes('assassin'))return'#a883d9';if(cls.includes('луч')||cls.includes('archer'))return'#79ba76';
  if(cls.includes('гном')||cls.includes('cannon'))return'#d38b4b';if(cls.includes('бер')||cls.includes('barb'))return'#d5685f';
  if(cls.includes('пал'))return'#e4c45b';if(cls.includes('страж')||cls.includes('tank'))return'#93a5b8';return'#6fb8ff';
}
function ppaOnlineDrawRemote(r,now,nearCount){
  if(!r||!r.hasPos)return false;
  let dt=Math.max(0,Math.min(100,now-(r.lastDrawAt||now)));r.lastDrawAt=now;
  const alpha=1-Math.exp(-dt/105);r.x+=(r.tx-r.x)*alpha;r.y+=(r.ty-r.y)*alpha;
  const sx=r.x-cam.x,sy=r.y-cam.y;
  const vw=cv.width/cameraZoom(),vh=cv.height/cameraZoom();
  if(sx<-90||sy<-120||sx>vw+90||sy>vh+120)return false;
  const phoneScale=(typeof PHONE_REMOTE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE==='number'?PHONE_REMOTE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE:1);
  const siegeScale=(P.scene==='clansiege'&&typeof CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE==='number'?CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE:1);
  const sc=phoneScale*siegeScale;
  cx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.34)';cx.beginPath();cx.ellipse(sx,sy+16*sc,17*sc,5.5*sc,0,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();
  const body=ppaOnlineClassColor(r.cls);cx.fillStyle=body;cx.beginPath();cx.arc(sx,sy-8*sc,16*sc,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();
  cx.fillStyle='#e9f4ff';cx.beginPath();cx.arc(sx,sy-18*sc,7.5*sc,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();
  const dist=Math.hypot(r.x-P.x,r.y-P.y);
  if(nearCount<=14||dist<360){
    cx.fillStyle='#fff';cx.font='bold 10px monospace';cx.textAlign='center';cx.fillText(String(r.name||'Игрок').slice(0,18),sx,sy-34*sc);
  }
  if(r.mhp>0&&dist<650){
    const bw=36*sc;cx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.65)';cx.fillRect(sx-bw/2,sy-29*sc,bw,4);
    cx.fillStyle='#47dd78';cx.fillRect(sx-bw/2,sy-29*sc,bw*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(r.hp||0)/r.mhp)),4);
  }
  cx.textAlign='left';return true;
}
function drawOnlinePlayers(){
  const hasLive=PPA_ONLINE.connected&&PPA_ONLINE.remotes.size;const hasDebug=PPA_ONLINE.debugRemotes.size;
  if(!hasLive&&!hasDebug){PPA_ONLINE.drawnLast=0;return}
  const now=(typeof performance!=='undefined'&&performance.now)?performance.now():Date.now();
  const all=[];
  if(hasLive)for(const r of PPA_ONLINE.remotes.values())all.push(r);
  if(hasDebug){
    let k=0;for(const r of PPA_ONLINE.debugRemotes.values()){
      const a=now*.00035+r.seed*1.77,rad=105+(r.seed%9)*34;
      r.tx=P.x+Math.cos(a)*rad;r.ty=P.y+Math.sin(a*.93)*rad;r.hasPos=true;r.hp=r.mhp=100;r.lastNetAt=now;k++;all.push(r);
    }
  }
  const vw=cv.width/cameraZoom(),vh=cv.height/cameraZoom();
  const visible=[];
  for(const r of all){
    if(!r||!r.hasPos)continue;
    const tx=r.tx-cam.x,ty=r.ty-cam.y;
    if(tx<-120||ty<-150||tx>vw+120||ty>vh+150)continue;
    visible.push(r);
  }
  const small=(Math.min(window.innerWidth||cv.width,window.innerHeight||cv.height)<720);
  const cap=small?18:32;
  if(visible.length>cap){visible.sort(function(a,b){return Math.hypot(a.tx-P.x,a.ty-P.y)-Math.hypot(b.tx-P.x,b.ty-P.y)});visible.length=cap}
  let drawn=0;for(const r of visible)if(ppaOnlineDrawRemote(r,now,visible.length))drawn++;
  PPA_ONLINE.drawnLast=drawn;
}

function v174AiPlayerDamage(e,mul,type,pen,forceCrit){
  if(!pvpCombatEnabled||P.dead||P.hp<=0)return 0;
  if(Math.random()*100<effectivePlayerDodge())return 0;
  let raw=Math.max(1,e.aiAtk*mul*v174AiRankMul(e));
  if(e.aiClass==='barbarian'){
    const missing=1-Math.max(0,e.hp)/Math.max(1,e.mhp);
    raw*=1+Math.min(.30,missing*.30); // Ярость берсерка.
  }
  if(e.aiClass==='assassin'&&P.hp/P.mhp<.40)raw*=1.25; // Смертельная хватка.
  if(e.aiClass==='archer'){
    const dd=Math.hypot(P.x-e.x,P.y-e.y);
    if(dd>260)raw*=1.30; // Снайпер.
  }
  if(e.aiClass==='mage')raw*=1.15;
  if(Date.now()<e.aiAtkBuffUntil)raw*=1.35;
  let crit=!!forceCrit||Math.random()<((e.aiClass==='assassin'?0.20:e.aiClass==='barbarian'?0.14:0.08));
  if(crit)raw*=e.aiCritDmg||1.8;
  pen=Math.max(0,Math.min(60,Number(pen)||Number(e.aiPen)||0));
  let real;
  if(type==='magic'){
    const res=Math.max(0,Math.min(80,(Number(P.magicResist)||0)*(1-pen/100)));
    const dr=Math.max(0,Math.min(75,(Number(P.damageReduction)||0)+(typeof v189TempDR==='function'?v189TempDR():0)));
    real=raw*(1-res/100)*(1-dr/100);
  }else{
    const df=Math.max(0,(Number(P.def)||0)*(1-pen/100));
    const dr=Math.max(0,Math.min(75,(Number(P.damageReduction)||0)+(typeof v189TempDR==='function'?v189TempDR():0)));
    real=raw*(1-df/(df+70))*(1-dr/100);
  }
  real=Math.max(1,Math.round(real));
  P.hp=Math.max(0,P.hp-real);P.lastCombatAt=Date.now();
  e.aiHitFxUntil=Date.now()+170;
  e.aiHitFxType=type||'physical';
  e.aiHitFxCrit=!!crit;
  if(e.aiClass==='barbarian')e.hp=Math.min(e.mhp,e.hp+real*.05); // Кровавая жажда.
  return real;
}

function v174AiDashToward(e,amount,away){
  let dx=P.x-e.x,dy=P.y-e.y,d=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));
  let k=(away?-1:1)*amount;
  let tx=dx/d*k,ty=dy/d*k;
  const rad=Math.max(12,e.sz*.30);
  const total=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(tx,ty));
  const steps=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(total/8));
  const sx=tx/steps,sy=ty/steps;
  let x=e.x,y=e.y;
  for(let i=0;i<steps;i++){
    const mv=pvpSlide('pvp1',x,y,sx,sy,rad);
    if(Math.hypot(mv.x-x,mv.y-y)<.05)break;
    x=mv.x;y=mv.y;
  }
  e.x=x;e.y=y;
}

function v174AiThink(e,d){
  if(!pvpCombatEnabled||P.dead)return;
  const now=Date.now();
  if(now<e.aiThinkAt)return;
  const dif=V174_AI_DIFF[e.aiDiff]||V174_AI_DIFF.normal;
  e.aiThinkAt=now+dif.think+Math.random()*dif.think*.55;
  const hp=e.hp/e.mhp,php=P.hp/P.mhp;
  let order=[];
  switch(e.aiClass){
    case 'tank': order=hp<.55?[2,0,3,1]:[0,3,1,2];break;
    case 'barbarian': order=d>115?[1,2,0,3]:[3,0,2,1];break;
    case 'paladin': order=hp<.58?[2,1,0,3]:[0,3,1,2];break;
    case 'gnome': order=d<150?[1,2,0,3]:[3,0,2,1];break;
    case 'archer': order=d<150?[2,0,1,3]:[3,0,1,2];break;
    case 'mage': order=d<155?[3,1,2,0]:[0,2,1,3];break;
    case 'assassin': order=php<.42?[3,1,0,2]:(d>100?[0,2,1,3]:[1,2,0,3]);break;
    case 'priest': order=hp<.55?[0,1,3,2]:[2,1,0,3];break;
  }
  // Deliberate human-like imperfection: occasionally try another sensible skill.
  if(Math.random()<(e.aiDiff==='easy'?.38:e.aiDiff==='normal'?.24:.13))order.sort(()=>Math.random()-.5);
  for(let j=0;j<order.length;j++)if(v174AiCast(e,order[j],d))break;
}
function v174AiBasic(e,d){
  if(!pvpCombatEnabled||P.dead)return;
  const now=Date.now(),c=V174_AI_CLASS[e.aiClass];
  const ranged=c.range>150,reach=ranged?Math.max(220,c.range+35):88;
  if(d>reach||now<e.aiBasicAt)return;
  let baseMs=ranged?1050:850;
  if(Date.now()<e.aiHasteUntil)baseMs*=.62;
  if(e.aiClass==='assassin')baseMs*=.82;
  e.aiEveryShot=(e.aiEveryShot||0)+1;
  if(e.aiClass==='gnome'&&e.aiEveryShot%5===0)baseMs*=.35; // Мастер-оружейник.
  e.aiBasicAt=now+baseMs;
  v174AiSetCast(e,'Обычная атака',380);
  v174AiPlayerDamage(e,ranged?.68:.72,c.type,e.aiPen||0,false);
}
function v174AiMove(e,d){
  if(P.dead||!pvpCombatEnabled)return;
  const now=Date.now(),c=V174_AI_CLASS[e.aiClass];
  if(now<(e.aiAttackHoldUntil||0)){
    e.aiMoveX=e.aiMoveY=0;
    e.aiAnim='attack';
    return;
  }
  if(now>e.aiStrafeUntil){
    e.aiStrafe=Math.random()<.5?-1:1;
    e.aiStrafeUntil=now+850+Math.random()*1150;
  }
  let dx=P.x-e.x,dy=P.y-e.y,dd=Math.max(1,d),ux=dx/dd,uy=dy/dd;
  let mx=0,my=0,pref=c.range;
  const hp=e.hp/e.mhp;
  const ranged=pref>150;
  if(ranged){
    if(d<pref-80){mx-=ux;my-=uy}
    else if(d>pref+85){mx+=ux;my+=uy}
    mx+=(-uy)*e.aiStrafe*.55;my+=(ux)*e.aiStrafe*.55;
    if(hp<.25){mx-=ux*.45;my-=uy*.45}
  }else{
    // Melee keeps a small body gap: chase, fight/strafe, or step back.
    // This removes the "running into and pushing the player" look.
    const inner=Math.max(58,pref-2),outer=Math.max(80,pref+18);
    if(d>outer){mx+=ux;my+=uy}
    else if(d<inner){mx-=ux*.78;my-=uy*.78}
    mx+=(-uy)*e.aiStrafe*(d<=outer?.26:.14);
    my+=(ux)*e.aiStrafe*(d<=outer?.26:.14);
  }
  if(e.aiClass==='assassin'&&now<e.aiHiddenUntil){mx+=ux*.45;my+=uy*.45}
  let ml=Math.hypot(mx,my);
  if(ml>.01){
    let sp=e.sp*(now<e.aiHasteUntil?1.18:1)*(typeof v189EnemyMoveMul==='function'?v189EnemyMoveMul(e):1);
    mx=mx/ml*sp;my=my/ml*sp;
    const mv=pvpSlide('pvp1',e.x,e.y,mx,my,Math.max(12,e.sz*.30));
    e.aiMoveX=mv.x-e.x;e.aiMoveY=mv.y-e.y;e.x=mv.x;e.y=mv.y;
    if(now>=e.aiAnimUntil)e.aiAnim='run';
  }else{
    e.aiMoveX=e.aiMoveY=0;
    if(now>=e.aiAnimUntil)e.aiAnim='idle';
  }
}

function v174UpdateAiTrainingFighter(e,d){
  const now=Date.now();
  if(PVP_MATCH.active){e.hp=0;e.aiRespawnAt=Infinity;return}
  if(e.hp<=0){
    if(e.aiRebirthReady&&!e.aiRebirthUsed){
      e.aiRebirthUsed=true;e.aiRebirthReady=false;
      e.hp=Math.round(e.mhp*(.35+.10*(e.aiRank||1)));
      e.aiCastName='ВОЗРОЖДЕНИЕ';e.aiCastUntil=now+1000;e.aiHiddenUntil=now+650;
      return;
    }
    if(!e.aiRespawnAt)e.aiRespawnAt=now+2200;
    if(now>=e.aiRespawnAt){
      const sp=PVP_DUEL_SPAWNS.red[0];e.x=sp.x;e.y=sp.y;e.hp=e.mhp;e.aiRespawnAt=0;e.aiRebirthReady=false;
      P.hp=P.mhp;P.mp=P.mmp;P.aiRootUntil=0;P.aiSlowUntil=0;P.aiDotUntil=0;
    }
    e.aiAnim='idle';return;
  }
  // Reactive passives when the AI has just taken damage.
  if(e.hp<e.aiLastHp){
    if(e.aiClass==='mage'&&Math.random()<.35)e.aiDefBuffUntil=Math.max(e.aiDefBuffUntil,now+4200); // Ледяная броня.
    if(e.aiClass==='tank'&&e.hp/e.mhp<.20)e.aiDefBuffUntil=Math.max(e.aiDefBuffUntil,now+5000); // Железная воля.
    if(e.aiClass==='barbarian'&&Math.random()<.30)e.aiAtkBuffUntil=Math.max(e.aiAtkBuffUntil,now+3500);
  }
  e.aiLastHp=e.hp;
  e.def=e.baseDef*(now<e.aiDefBuffUntil?(e.aiClass==='tank'?1.85:1.55):1);
  if(e.aiClass==='tank'&&e.hp/e.mhp<.20)e.def*=1.30;
  if(e.aiClass==='paladin'&&e.hp/e.mhp<.30)e.def*=1.25;

  if(e.aiDelayed&&now>=e.aiDelayed.at){
    const q=e.aiDelayed;e.aiDelayed=null;
    if(Math.hypot(P.x-q.x,P.y-q.y)<=q.rad)v174AiPlayerDamage(e,q.mul,q.type,Number(q.pen)||15,false);
  }
  v174AiMove(e,d);
  v174AiThink(e,d);
  v174AiBasic(e,d);
  if(now>=e.aiAnimUntil&&Math.abs(e.aiMoveX)+Math.abs(e.aiMoveY)<.05)e.aiAnim='idle';
  e.bob+=e.aiAnim==='run'?.25:.05;
  if(e.flash>0)e.flash--;
}
function v174AiDirIndex(e){
  let dx=P.x-e.x,dy=P.y-e.y;
  if(Math.abs(e.aiMoveX)+Math.abs(e.aiMoveY)>.15){dx=e.aiMoveX;dy=e.aiMoveY}
  const a=Math.atan2(dy,dx),oct=Math.round(a/(Math.PI/4));
  // atan2: E0, SE1, S2, SW3, W4, NW-3, N-2, NE-1 -> canonical N..NW.
  return ((oct+2)+8)%8;
}
function v174AiSpriteCfg(e){
  let a=e.aiAnim||'idle',cfg=null,rowMap=null,scale=1.8,foot=.91;
  if(e.aiClass==='gnome'){cfg=GNOME_ANIM[a];rowMap=GNOME_SOURCE_ROW;scale=GNOME_DRAW_SCALE;foot=113/128}
  else if(e.aiClass==='archer'){cfg=ARCHER_ANIM[a];rowMap=ARCHER_SOURCE_ROW;scale=ARCHER_DRAW_SCALE;foot=184/224}
  else if(e.aiClass==='assassin'){cfg=ASSASSIN_ANIM[a];rowMap=(a==='run'?ASSASSIN_RUN_SOURCE_ROW:ASSASSIN_4DIR_ROW);scale=(a==='idle'?ASSASSIN_IDLE_DRAW_SCALE:(a==='attack'?ASSASSIN_ATTACK_DRAW_SCALE:ASSASSIN_RUN_DRAW_SCALE));foot=156/192}
  else if(e.aiClass==='tank'){cfg=TANK_ANIM[a];rowMap=TANK_4DIR_ROW;scale=TANK_DRAW_SCALE;foot=232/256}
  else if(e.aiClass==='barbarian'){cfg=BERSERKER_ANIM[a];rowMap=BERSERKER_4DIR_ROW;scale=BERSERKER_DRAW_SCALE;foot=232/256}
  else if(e.aiClass==='priest'){cfg=PRIEST_ANIM[a];rowMap=PRIEST_4DIR_ROW;scale=PRIEST_DRAW_SCALE;foot=236/256}
  else if(e.aiClass==='mage'){cfg=MAGE_ANIM[a];rowMap=MAGE_4DIR_ROW;scale=MAGE_DRAW_SCALE;foot=236/256}
  else if(e.aiClass==='paladin'){cfg=PALADIN_ANIM[a];rowMap=PALADIN_4DIR_ROW;scale=PALADIN_DRAW_SCALE;foot=234/256}
  return {anim:cfg,rowMap:rowMap,scale:scale,foot:foot};
}

function v174DrawAiTrainingFighter(e,sx,sy){
  const now=Date.now(),c=V174_AI_CLASS[e.aiClass]||V174_AI_CLASS.assassin;
  const cfg=v174AiSpriteCfg(e),a=cfg.anim,di=v174AiDirIndex(e);
  const bob=Math.sin(e.bob)*2;
  const _aiHidden=(e.aiClass==='assassin'&&now<(e.aiHiddenUntil||0));
  cx.save();
  if(_aiHidden)cx.globalAlpha=.12;
  const aiVisualSize=phoneCharacterBodySize(e.sz,1);
  cx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.42)';cx.beginPath();cx.ellipse(sx,sy+aiVisualSize*.45,aiVisualSize*.38,aiVisualSize*.14,0,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();
  if(a&&a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0){
    const frame=Math.floor(now/(1000/Math.max(1,a.fps)))%a.frames;
    const row=cfg.rowMap?cfg.rowMap[di]:0;
    const dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(e.sz*cfg.scale,1),dw=dh;
    cx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
    if(e.flash>0)cx.filter='brightness(1.65)';
    cx.drawImage(a.img,frame*a.fw,row*a.fh,a.fw,a.fh,sx-dw/2,sy+e.sz*.40-cfg.foot*dh+bob,dw,dh);
    cx.filter='none';
  }else{
    cx.fillStyle='#9d63db';cx.beginPath();cx.arc(sx,sy-10,aiVisualSize*.35,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();
  }
  cx.globalAlpha=1;
  if(_aiHidden&&now>(e.aiSmokeLabelUntil||0)){
    cx.globalAlpha=.22;cx.strokeStyle='#8d8d9a';cx.setLineDash([4,5]);
    cx.beginPath();cx.ellipse(sx,sy+e.sz*.35,e.sz*.48,e.sz*.18,0,0,Math.PI*2);cx.stroke();
    cx.setLineDash([]);cx.restore();return;
  }
  const bw=Math.max(78,e.sz*1.25),by=sy-e.sz*.86;
  cx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.72)';cx.fillRect(sx-bw/2,by,bw,5);
  cx.fillStyle='#d04fff';cx.fillRect(sx-bw/2,by,bw*Math.max(0,e.hp/e.mhp),5);
  cx.font='bold 10px monospace';cx.textAlign='center';cx.fillStyle='#e7c8ff';
  cx.fillText('ИИ · '+c.name+' · '+['','I','II','III'][e.aiRank],sx,by-6);

  // Compact skill indicator: small "skill button" + its real name.
  if(now<(e.aiSkillBadgeUntil||0)&&e.aiCastName){
    const idx=Number.isInteger(e.aiSkillIndex)?e.aiSkillIndex:-1;
    const tag=idx>=0?String(idx+1):'A';
    const txt=e.aiCastName==='Обычная атака'?'АТАКА':e.aiCastName;
    const tw=Math.min(150,Math.max(64,cx.measureText(txt).width+35));
    const bx=sx-tw/2,yy=by-31;
    cx.fillStyle='rgba(8,8,10,.86)';cx.fillRect(bx,yy,tw,18);
    cx.strokeStyle=idx>=0?'rgba(255,197,88,.95)':'rgba(215,215,215,.75)';
    cx.lineWidth=1;cx.strokeRect(bx+.5,yy+.5,tw-1,17);
    cx.fillStyle=idx>=0?'#8b4f18':'#454545';cx.fillRect(bx+3,yy+3,13,12);
    cx.fillStyle='#fff2c9';cx.font='bold 8px monospace';cx.fillText(tag,bx+9.5,yy+12);
    cx.fillStyle='#ffd783';cx.font='bold 8px monospace';
    cx.fillText(txt.slice(0,22),bx+19+(tw-22)/2,yy+12);
  }

  // Tiny, cheap hit stroke: ranged attacks visibly connect to the target;
  // melee attacks produce a short slash at the player's feet.
  if(now<(e.aiHitFxUntil||0)){
    const px=P.x-cam.x,py=P.y-cam.y;
    const alpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((e.aiHitFxUntil||0)-now)/170));
    cx.save();cx.globalAlpha=alpha;
    cx.strokeStyle=e.aiHitFxType==='magic'?'#b98cff':'#ffbd62';
    cx.lineWidth=e.aiHitFxCrit?3:2;
    if(c.range>150){
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(sx,sy-e.sz*.12);cx.lineTo(px,py-e.sz*.18);cx.stroke();
    }else{
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(px-13,py-18);cx.lineTo(px+14,py+2);
      cx.moveTo(px+11,py-19);cx.lineTo(px-9,py+3);cx.stroke();
    }
    cx.restore();
  }

  cx.textAlign='left';cx.restore();
}

let __ppaHudNextAt=0;
function update(){
  PPAOnlineTick();
  ppaCleanupDeathRemnants();
  updateConsumableHud(false);
  updatePremiumRegen();
  if(P.dead)return;
  v174AiTickPlayerDebuffs();

  const _smartMove=updateSmartAttackInput();
  // V139: Smart Attack only supplies movement when joystick is neutral.
  // Any live joystick input keeps full manual movement while target lock stays active.
  const _moveX=_smartMove?_smartMove.x:jX;
  const _moveY=_smartMove?_smartMove.y:jY;

  // V174: class-AI crowd control is numeric only (no particle FX).
  const _aiMoveMul=Date.now()<(P.aiRootUntil||0)?0:(Date.now()<(P.aiSlowUntil||0)?Math.max(.30,Number(P.aiSlowMul)||.55):1);
  P.vx=_moveX*P.sp*shopSpeedMul()*_aiMoveMul;
  P.vy=_moveY*P.sp*shopSpeedMul()*_aiMoveMul;
  let nx=P.x+P.vx, ny=P.y+P.vy;

  // Keep in bounds (per scene)
  const sc=SCENES[P.scene];
  nx=Math.max(sc.bounds.minX,Math.min(sc.bounds.maxX,nx));
  ny=Math.max(sc.bounds.minY,Math.min(sc.bounds.maxY,ny));

  if(P.scene==='arena'){
    // Stay on the circular arena floor — no wandering into the black void
    const c=sc.center,rad=460;
    const dx=nx-c.x,dy=ny-c.y,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
    if(dist>rad){nx=c.x+dx/dist*rad;ny=c.y+dy/dist*rad}
  }else if(P.scene==='pvp1'||P.scene==='pvpteam'){
    const mv=pvpSlide(P.scene,P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='dungeon'){
    // Dungeon walls — slide along corridors, never clip through
    const mv=dgSlide(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='clansiege'){
    const mv=clanSiegeSlide(P.x,P.y,nx-P.x,ny-P.y,P.sz*0.24);
    nx=mv.x;ny=mv.y;
  }else if(P.scene==='clanboss1'){
    const 

===== archer 19 @97832001 =====
y;
  }
  P.x=nx;P.y=ny;
  if(P.scene==='clansiege')clanSiegeUpdateCapture();

  // Portal collision
  if(P.portalCD>0)P.portalCD--;
  if(P.portalCD<=0&&!transitioning&&sc.portal){
    const p=sc.portal;
    if(Math.hypot(P.x-p.x,P.y-p.y)<p.r+20){
      changeScene(p.target);
    }
  }
  // Town teleport -> dungeon (walk into the rune circle)
  if(P.portalCD<=0&&!transitioning&&P.scene==='safe'&&sc.teleport&&sc.teleport.target){
    const tp=sc.teleport;
    if(Math.hypot(P.x-tp.x,P.y-tp.y)<tp.r){
      changeScene(tp.target);
    }
  }
  // 1x1 duel preparation: both players may move, but PvP damage stays locked for 10 seconds.
  updatePvpDuelWarmup();

  // Arena ladder: only a fully cleared stage advances.
  if(P.scene==='arena'){
    if(waveActive&&arenaWaveKilled>=arenaWaveTotal&&arenaActiveCount()===0){
      arenaRecordWave(arenaStageProgress());
      waveActive=false;
      waveTimer=180; // 3 sec break: enough to read the HUD, short enough to keep pace
    }
    if(!waveActive&&waveTimer>0){
      waveTimer--;
      if(waveTimer<=0)startWave();
    }
  }

  if(Math.abs(P.vx)>0.1||Math.abs(P.vy)>0.1)P.bob+=0.28;
  else P.bob+=0.04;

  if(P.shootT<=0){
    // Update facing based on horizontal movement for side sprite flip
    if(P.vx > 0.1) P.face = 1;
    else if(P.vx < -0.1) P.face = -1;
    // When moving vertically, keep last horizontal facing
  }

  if(P.shootCD>0)P.shootCD--;
  if(P.shootT>0)P.shootT-=0.12;
  if(P.recoil>0)P.recoil-=0.1;

  if(attackQueued&&P.shootCD<=0){
    attackQueued=false;

    // Preserve the joystick state. Combat must never cancel movement.
    const movingNow=playerIsMoving();

    if(playerUsesGnomeSprites()){
      try{gnomeFireCannonball()}catch(_){PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.length=0}
    }else if(playerUsesArcherSprites()){
      try{archerFireArrow()}catch(_){PLAYER_ARROWS.length=0}
    }else{
      melee();
    }

    P.shootCD=Math.max(1,Math.round(60/((P.atkSpd||1)*shopAtkSpeedMul())));

    if(movingNow && P.attackMode!=='melee' && !playerUsesArcherSprites() && !playerUsesPriestSprites() && !playerUsesMageSprites()){
      // Gnome/ranged legacy behavior stays unchanged:
      // projectile can fire while the running animation continues.
      P.attacking=false;
      P.anim='run';
      P.animTimer=Math.min(P.animTimer||0,6);
      P.runAttackT=14;
    }else{
      // Assassin AND Archer now use their real ATTACK sprites while moving.
      // Movement itself is NOT cancelled; joystick/Smart Attack still moves P.x/P.y.
      P.attacking=true;
      P.anim='attack';
      P.animFrame=0;
      P.animTimer=0;
      P.runAttackT=movingNow?14:0;
    }
  }

  if(P.runAttackT>0)P.runAttackT--;

  // Sprite animation state machine:
  // attack > run > idle.
  // Assassin and Archer keep their real ATTACK animation while moving.
  // Gnome keeps its approved run+separate-projectile behavior.
  const movingForAnim=playerIsMoving();
  if(P.attacking&&movingForAnim&&P.attackMode!=='melee'&&!playerUsesArcherSprites()&&!playerUsesPriestSprites()&&!playerUsesMageSprites()){
    P.attacking=false;
    P.anim='run';
    P.animTimer=0;
    P.animFrame=P.animFrame%Math.max(1,playerAnimDef('run').frames);
  }

  if(P.attacking){
    P.animTimer++;
    const a=playerAnimDef('attack');
    const frameDur = Math.max(1, Math.round(60/a.fps));
    if(P.animTimer >= frameDur){
      P.animTimer = 0;
      P.animFrame++;
      if(P.animFrame >= a.frames){
        P.attacking = false;
        P.animFrame = 0;
        P.animTimer = 0;
      }
    }
  } else {
    const moving = movingForAnim;
    const nextAnim = moving ? 'run' : 'idle';
    if(P.anim !== nextAnim){
      // Smooth transition: don't reset to frame 0 if coming from similar pose
      P.anim = nextAnim;
      P.animFrame = 0;
      P.animTimer = 0;
    }
    const a = playerAnimDef(nextAnim);
    P.animTimer++;
    const frameDur = Math.max(1, Math.round(60 / a.fps));
    if(P.animTimer >= frameDur){
      P.animTimer = 0;
      P.animFrame = (P.animFrame + 1) % a.frames;
    }
  }

  // Сброс зависшей цели:
  // если моб умер, ушёл слишком далеко, скрылся за стеной
  // или игрок покинул его комнату — красная метка исчезает.
  if(P.tid!=null){
    const locked=EN.find(x=>x.id===P.tid);
    if(!targetIsValid(locked))P.tid=null;
  }

  // Fart Zone mine production + 30-minute guard respawns.
  updateFartZoneSystem();

  // Enemies
  for(let i=EN.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const e=EN[i];
    const dx=P.x-e.x,dy=P.y-e.y,d2=dx*dx+dy*dy;
    const reach=42+(e.sz-30)*0.35;
    // В подземелье одновременно размещено более 500 мобов.
    // Далёкие нетронутые мобы "спят" уже после 500px. Проверяем квадрат расстояния,
    // чтобы не делать сотни Math.hypot() на мобильном каждый кадр.
    if(P.scene==='dungeon'&&!e.isBoss&&!e.aggro&&e.hp===e.mhp&&d2>250000){
      if(e.atkCD>0)e.atkCD--;
      e.bob+=0.025;
      continue;
    }
    // V276 FPS: Fart Zone can hold 39–65 guards. Untouched guards far away
    // do not need movement/path/attack AI until the player approaches.
    if(P.scene==='fartzone'&&e.isFartGuard&&!e.aggro&&e.hp===e.mhp&&d2>360000){
      if(e.atkCD>0)e.atkCD--;
      e.bob+=0.025;
      continue;
    }
    const d=Math.sqrt(d2);
    if(e.isAiFighter){
      v174UpdateAiTrainingFighter(e,d);
      continue;
    }
    if(e.isBoss){
      // Boss/static siege objects never leave their anchor.
      if(e.hx!==undefined){e.x=e.hx;e.y=e.hy}

      if(e.isClanSiegeCrystal){
        // Destructible objective: does not move and never attacks.
      }else if(e.isWorldCrystalBoss){
        worldCrystalBossUpdate(e,dx,dy,d);
      }else if(e.isDungeon21Boss){
        dungeon21BossUpdate(e,dx,dy,d);
      }else if(e.isClanBoss){
        if(clanBossIsCerberus(e)){
          cerberusUpdateVisual(e,dx,dy,d);
        }else{
          clanBossUpdateAoe(e,d);
          if(e.aoeState==='idle')clanBossUpdateWhip(e,dx,dy,d);
        }
      }else if(d<=reach&&e.atkCD<=0){
        if(Math.random()*100<effectivePlayerDodge()){
          showPickup('Уворот!','#88ffcc');
        }else{
          P.hp-=playerDmg(e.dmg,e.dmgType||'physical');
        }

var RPREF={common:'',uncommon:'',rare:'',epic:'',legendary:''};
function cleanItemName(name){
  return String(name||'')
    .replace(/^(Обычный|Обычная|Обычное|Обычные)\s+/i,'')
    .replace(/^(Необычный|Необычная|Необычное|Необычные)\s+/i,'')
    .replace(/^(Улучшенный|Улучшенная|Улучшенное|Улучшенные)\s+/i,'')
    .replace(/^(Редкий|Редкая|Редкое|Редкие)\s+/i,'')
    .replace(/^(Эпический|Эпическая|Эпическое|Эпические)\s+/i,'')
    .replace(/^(Легендарный|Легендарная|Легендарное|Легендарные)\s+/i,'');
}
const GEAR_CLASS_KEYS=['tank','paladin','barbarian','mage','priest','archer','assassin','gnome'];

function rarityDef(k){
  if(k==='uncommon')return {k:'uncommon',mult:1.15};
  if(k==='rare')return {k:'rare',mult:1.35};
  if(k==='epic')return {k:'epic',mult:1.60};
  return {k:'common',mult:1};
}
function randomGearClassKey(){
  return GEAR_CLASS_KEYS[Math.floor(Math.random()*GEAR_CLASS_KEYS.length)];
}
function normalGearDropChances(lvl){
  lvl=Math.max(1,Math.min(20,(lvl|0)||1));
  // V174 progression: levels 1–10 are the gray tutorial tier only.
  // Green gear starts at level 11, and gray placeholder spam is heavily cut.
  if(lvl<=5)return {common:0.006,uncommon:0,rare:0,epic:0};
  if(lvl<=10)return {common:0.0025,uncommon:0,rare:0,epic:0};
  if(lvl<=15)return {common:0.001,uncommon:0.006,rare:0,epic:0};
  return {common:0,uncommon:0.009,rare:0,epic:0};
}
// === V134 SIMPLE LEVEL ANTIFARM ============================================
// Ordinary mobs give full rewards while the player is at most 7 levels above.
// Bosses are intentionally exempt: boss rewards should remain worth doing.
function antiFarmRewardMul(e){
  if(!e||e.isBoss||e.isWorldCrystalBoss||e.isDungeon21Boss||e.isClanBoss)return 1;
  const mobLvl=Math.max(1,Number(e.lvl||e.roomLevel)||1);
  const diff=Math.max(0,(Number(P.lvl)||1)-mobLvl);

  if(diff<=7)return 1.00;  // full rewards
  if(diff<=10)return 0.70; // 8–10 levels above
  if(diff<=14)return 0.40; // 11–14
  if(diff<=19)return 0.20; // 15–19
  return 0.05;             // 20+ levels above
}
function rollNormalGearRarity(lvl,rewardMul){
  var c=normalGearDropChances(lvl),x=Math.random(),dm=rewardDropMul();
  var af=(rewardMul==null?1:Math.max(0,Number(rewardMul)||0));
  if(x<c.uncommon*dm*af)return 'uncommon';
  if(x<(c.uncommon+c.common)*dm*af)return 'common';
  return null;
}
function pickRarity(boss,lvl){
  if(boss){
    // V173: bosses should not flood the bag with the gray placeholder.
    var x=Math.random();
    if(x<0.30)return rarityDef('rare');
    if(x<0.90)return rarityDef('uncommon');
    return rarityDef('common');
  }
  return rarityDef('common');
}
function itemBM(s){
  s=s||{};
  var v=(Number(s.atk)||0)*3+(Number(s.def)||0)*2.5+(Number(s.hp)||0)*0.25+(Number(s.mp)||0)*0.15+
    (Number(s.crit)||0)*4+(Number(s.spd)||0)*6+(Number(s.spdFlat)||0)*35+(Number(s.critDmg)||0)*1.2+
    (Number(s.dodge)||0)*4+(Number(s.controlResist)||0)*1.5+(Number(s.slowResist)||0)*1.2+
    (Number(s.hpPct)||0)*4+(Number(s.mpPct)||0)*3+(Number(s.magicResist)||0)*1.5+
    (Number(s.hpRegen)||0)*22+(Number(s.mpRegen)||0)*22+
    (Number(s.damagePct)||0)*14+(Number(s.physDamagePct)||0)*12+(Number(s.magicDamagePct)||0)*12+
    (Number(s.armorPen)||0)*12+(Number(s.magicPen)||0)*12+(Number(s.damageReduction)||0)*18+
    (Number(s.critDamageResist)||0)*6+(Number(s.atkSpeedPct)||0)*10+(Number(s.moveSpeedPct)||0)*8+(Number(s.defPct)||0)*10;
  // Safety for future/new stat keys: an item with real numeric stats must never display BM 0.
  if(v<=0){
    var fallback=0;
    for(var k in s){
      var n=Number(s[k]);
      if(Number.isFinite(n)&&n!==0)fallback+=Math.abs(n)*2;
    }
    v=fallback;
  }
  return Math.max(0,Math.round(v));
}
function syncItemBM(it){
  if(!it||!it.stats)return 0;
  var hasStats=false;
  for(var k in it.stats){
    var n=Number(it.stats[k]);
    if(Number.isFinite(n)&&n!==0){hasStats=true;break}
  }
  it.bm=hasStats?Math.max(1,itemBM(it.stats)):0;
  return it.bm;
}
function syncAllItemBM(){
  function v170Sync(it){if(!it)return;if(typeof refreshGearArt==='function')refreshGearArt(it);syncItemBM(it)}
  (INV.bag||[]).forEach(v170Sync);
  if(INV.equipped)for(var k in INV.equipped)v170Sync(INV.equipped[k]);
  if(INV.storage){
    ['personal','clan','premium'].forEach(function(k){(INV.storage[k]||[]).forEach(v170Sync)});
  }
  (INV.auctionLots||[]).forEach(function(l){
    if(!l||!l.item)return;
    if(l.item.gear)v170Sync(l.item.gear);
    else v170Sync(l.item);
  });
}

// === V173 REAL SHARPENING POWER ===
// V227: necklace / cloak / wings / pet use the same +1..+7 base-stat scaling.
// Necklace awakens crit damage at +6/+7; cloak dodge; wings move speed.
// Pets keep their special +5 bonus stat, scaled further at +6/+7.
// +1/+2/+3/+4/+5/+6/+7 = +6/+14/+24/+36/+50/+68/+90% of BASE item stats.
// +6 unlocks a slot awakening stat; +7 upgrades it. No particle/visual FX.
const ENH_STAT_BONUS={0:0,1:0.06,2:0.14,3:0.24,4:0.36,5:0.50,6:0.68,7:0.90};
function cloneNumericStats(st){
  var o={};st=st||{};
  for(var k in st){var n=Number(st[k]);if(Number.isFinite(n))o[k]=n;}
  return o;
}
function ensureEnhBaseStats(it){
  if(!it||!it.stats)return {};
  if(!it.enhBaseStats||typeof it.enhBaseStats!=='object'||!Object.keys(it.enhBaseStats).length){it.enhBaseStats=cloneNumericStats(it.stats);}
  return it.enhBaseStats;
}
function sharpenRoundStat(k,v){
  if(['atk','def','hp','mp','spdFlat'].includes(k))return Math.round(v);
  return Math.round(v*100)/100;
}
function awakeningBonusForItem(it,lvl){
  if(!it||lvl<6)return {};
  var hi=lvl>=7,slot=it.slot||'',out={};
  if(slot==='weapon'){
    var ck=String(it.classKey||'');
    if(ck==='mage'||ck==='priest')out.magicPen=hi?10:6;else out.armorPen=hi?10:6;
  }else if(slot==='armor')out.damageReduction=hi?5:3;
  else if(slot==='helmet')out.critDamageResist=hi?8:5;
  else if(slot==='legs')out.controlResist=hi?9:5;
  else if(slot==='gloves')out.atkSpeedPct=hi?7:4;
  else if(slot==='boots')out.moveSpeedPct=hi?5:3;
  else if(slot==='ring')out.crit=hi?3:2;
  else if(slot==='necklace')out.critDmg=hi?13:8;
  else if(slot==='cloak')out.dodge=hi?5:3;
  else if(slot==='wings')out.moveSpeedPct=hi?8:5;
  return out;
}

  return it;
}

function petEnhBonusAtLevel(it,lvl){

  var name=it.petName||it.name||'',rar=it.rarity||'common';
  var def=PET_ENH_PLUS5_BONUS[name],target=def&&(def[rar]||def.uncommon);if(!target)return {};

function genItem(lvl,boss,forcedRarity){
  lvl=Math.max(1,Math.min(20,(lvl|0)||1));
  var slot=SLOTS[Math.floor(Math.random()*SLOTS.length)];
  var r=forcedRarity?rarityDef(forcedRarity):pickRarity(boss,lvl),db=ITEM_DB[slot],stats={};
  var statKeys=SLOT_STATS[slot]||['def'];
  var icon=SLOT_FALLBACK_ICON[slot]||'◆',img='',baseName='',classKey='all';

  if(slot==='necklace'){
    var variants=JEWELRY_VARIANTS.necklace;
    var v=variants[Math.floor(Math.random()*variants.length)];
    statKeys=v.stats;
    img=v.img;
    baseName=v.name;
    classKey='all';
  }else if(slot==='ring'){
    classKey='all';
    var rvars=JEWELRY_VARIANTS.ring||[],rv=rvars.length?rvars[Math.floor(Math.random()*rvars.length)]:null;
    if(rv&&rv.stats)statKeys=rv.stats;
    if(r.k==='epic'&&EPIC_RING_ART&&EPIC_RING_ART.length)img=EPIC_RING_ART[Math.floor(Math.random()*EPIC_RING_ART.length)];
    else img=rv&&rv.img?rv.img:'';
    baseName=rv&&rv.name?rv.name:db.names[0];
  }else if(CLASS_ART_SLOTS[slot]){
    classKey=randomGearClassKey();
    img=classGearArt(r.k,classKey,slot);
    baseName=(CLASS_ITEM_NAMES[classKey]&&CLASS_ITEM_NAMES[classKey][slot])||db.names[0];
  }else{
    baseName=db.names[Math.floor(Math.random()*db.names.length)];
  }

  statKeys.forEach(function(k){
    var base=0;
    if(k==='atk')base=3+lvl*1.4;
    else if(k==='def')base=2+lvl*1.1;
    else if(k==='hp')base=8+lvl*5;
    else if(k==='mp')base=4+lvl*2;
    else if(k==='crit')base=1+lvl*0.25;
    else if(k==='spd')base=0.3+lvl*0.08;
    var v=base*r.mult*(0.85+Math.random()*0.3);
    v=(k==='crit')?Math.round(v):(k==='spd')?Math.round(v*10)/10:Math.round(v);
    if(v>0)stats[k]=v;
  });

  var name=RPREF[r.k]+baseName;
  return {
    uid:'i'+Date.now().toString(36)+Math.floor(Math.random()*99999).toString(36),
    slot:slot,rarity:r.k,enh:0,icon:icon,ic:icon,img:img,
    classKey:classKey,className:classKey==='all'?'Все классы':CLASS_DISPLAY[classKey],
    name:name,stats:stats,bm:itemBM(stats),sell:Math.round((5+lvl*3)*r.mult),

)out.dodge=hi?5:3;
  else if(slot==='wings')out.moveSpeedPct=hi?8:5;
  return out;
}

function premiumClassChangeResult(ok,msg,targetKey){
  try{
    if(premiumShopFrame&&premiumShopFrame.contentWindow){
      premiumShopFrame.contentWindow.postMessage({
        type:'premiumClassChangeResult',

  }catch(_){}
}

function premiumClassChangeItem(it,oldKey,newKey){
  if(!it||it.classKey!==oldKey||it.classKey==='all')return false;
  const slots=['weapon','helmet','armor','gloves','ring','legs','boots'];
  if(!slots.includes(it.slot))return false;

  const newName=(CLASS_ITEM_NAMES[newKey]&&CLASS_ITEM_NAMES[newKey][it.slot])||it.name||'Предмет';
  it.name=cleanItemName(newName);
  it.classKey=newKey;
  it.className=CLASS_DISPLAY[newKey]||newKey;
  it.img=classGearArt(it.rarity||'common',newKey,it.slot)||it.img||'';

  // Preserve everything the player already earned on this exact item:
  // rarity, level, enhancement, rolled stats, BM and UID.
  // Converted gear becomes account-bound to prevent class-change arbitrage.
  it.bound=true;
  it.tradeLocked=true;
  it.classChangeConverted=true;
  syncItemBM(it);
  return true;
}

function premiumConvertOwnedClassGear(oldKey,newKey){
  let converted=0;
  Object.keys(INV.equipped||{}).forEach(function(slot){
    if(premiumClassChangeItem(INV.equipped[slot],oldKey,newKey))converted++;
  });
  (INV.bag||[]).forEach(function(it){
    if(premiumClassChangeItem(it,oldKey,newKey))converted++;
  });

  // Only the player's own storages. Clan storage and auction lots are NEVER
  // transformed, otherwise class change could be abused as a market converter.
  if(INV.storage){
    ['personal','premium'].forEach(function(mode){
      (INV.storage[mode]||[]).forEach(function(it){
        if(premiumClassChangeItem(it,oldKey,newKey))converted++;
      });
    });
  }
  return converted;
}

function premiumApplyTargetClass(targetKey){
  const c=PREMIUM_CLASS_CHANGE_STATS[targetKey];
  if(!c)return false;

  applyClassBaseProfile(targetKey,P.lvl);

  // Keep level / XP / rebirths. Return all earned stat points for a fresh
  // redistribution on the new class.
  const a=P.statAlloc||{};
  const refunded=(Number(P.statPts)||0)+Object.keys(a).reduce(function(sum,k){
    return sum+Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(a[k])||0));
  },0);
  P.statAlloc={hp:0,mp:0,atk:0,def:0,spd:0,atkspd:0,critdmg:0,crit:0,dodge:0};
  P.statPts=refunded;

  // Old class combat state never carries across.
  P.anim='idle';P.animFrame=0;P.animTimer=0;P.attacking=false;
  P.dir8=4;P.tid=null;P.shootT=0;P.recoil=0;
  PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.length=0;
  PLAYER_ARROWS.length=0;
  P.skills=[];
  P.skillCd=[0,0,0,0];
  P.dmgMul=1;P.slowMul=1;P.chain=1;

  recomputeStats();
  P.hp=P.mhp;
  P.mp=P.mmp;
  return true;
}

function ppaCloudScheduleSave(state){
  if(!PPA_CLOUD.ready||!ppaCloudBridgeAvailable())return;
  clearTimeout(PPA_CLOUD.timer);
  var snapshot=state&&typeof state==='object'?state:ppaBuildSaveObject();
  PPA_CLOUD.timer=setTimeout(function(){ppaCloudPush(snapshot)},2500);
}
async function ppaCloudPush(state){
  if(!PPA_CLOUD.ready||!ppaCloudBridgeAvailable()||typeof PPA.ppaSaveGame!=='function')return false;
  try{
    var res=await PPA.ppaSaveGame(state||ppaBuildSaveObject(),PPA_CLOUD.version);
    if(res&&Number.isFinite(Number(res.version)))PPA_CLOUD.version=Number(res.version);
    else if(res&&res.save&&Number.isFinite(Number(res.save.version)))PPA_CLOUD.version=Number(res.save.version);
    return true;
  }catch(err){
    var now=Date.now();
    if(now-PPA_CLOUD.lastErrorAt>10000){
      PPA_CLOUD.lastErrorAt=now;
      console.warn('PPA cloud save:',err);
    }
    return false;
  }
}

function ppaMigrationSaveObject(){
  var out=ppaBuildSaveObject();
  var old=(P&&P._saved&&typeof P._saved==='object')?P._saved:null;
  if(old){
    ['lvl','xp','xn','kil','rebirths','statPts','talentPts','cls'].forEach(function(k){
      if(old[k]!=null)out[k]=old[k];
    });
    if(old.statAlloc&&typeof old.statAlloc==='object')out.statAlloc=Object.assign({},old.statAlloc);
    if(old.playerName&&!out.playerName)out.playerName=old.playerName;
  }
  return out;
}

  if(!ppaCloudBridgeAvailable())return false;
  if(PPA_CLOUD.loading)return true;
  PPA_CLOUD.loading=true;
  try{
    if(typeof PPA.ppaAuthTelegram==='function')await PPA.ppaAuthTelegram();
    var profile=typeof PPA.ppaLoadProfile==='function'?await PPA.ppaLoadProfile():null;
    profile=(profile&&profile.profile)||profile||{};
    PPA_CLOUD.profile=profile;

    var load=typeof PPA.ppaLoadSave==='function'?await PPA.ppaLoadSave():null;
    var cloud=ppaCloudExtract(load);
    PPA_CLOUD.version=cloud.version;

    var forceMigration=localStorage.getItem('ppaCloudForceMigrationV219')==='1';
    var profileNick=ppaProfileNickname(profile);
    var savedNick=ppaLocalSavedNickname();
    var localCachePresent=ppaHasAnyLocalCharacterCache();
    var cloudHasCharacter=ppaSaveHasCharacterState(cloud.state);

    // Explicit portable-save import always wins: the player deliberately chose it.
    if(forceMigration&&typeof PPA.ppaSaveGame==='function'){
      var migrationState=ppaMigrationSaveObject();
      if(ppaSaveHasCharacterState(migrationState)){
        var migrated=await PPA.ppaSaveGame(migrationState,cloud.version);
        if(migrated&&Number.isFinite(Number(migrated.version)))PPA_CLOUD.version=Number(migrated.version);
        else if(migrated&&migrated.save&&Number.isFinite(Number(migrated.save.version)))PPA_CLOUD.version=Number(migrated.save.version);
        localStorage.removeItem('ppaCloudForceMigrationV219');
        cloud={version:PPA_CLOUD.version,state:migrationState};
        cloudHasCharacter=true;
      }
    }

    // Existing cloud character is authoritative for this Telegram account.
    // Apply it directly to memory: no second resource-loading screen.
    if(cloudHasCharacter&&!forceMigration){
      var stamp='v'+String(cloud.version==null?'na':cloud.version);
      if(sessionStorage.getItem('ppaCloudLoadedStamp')!==stamp){
        localStorage.setItem('pxSave',JSON.stringify(cloud.state));
        localStorage.setItem('pxSaveLastGood',JSON.stringify(cloud.state));

        sessionStorage.setItem('ppaCloudLoadedStamp',stamp);
        if(!loadGame())console.warn('PPA: cloud save could not be applied in memory');

      if(savedNickOk0&&profileNickOk0&&ppaNickKey(savedNick)===ppaNickKey(profileNick)&&typeof PPA.ppaSaveGame==='function'){
        var initialState=ppaMigrationSaveObject();
        var first=await PPA.ppaSaveGame(initialState,cloud.version);
        if(first&&Number.isFinite(Number(first.version)))PPA_CLOUD.version=Number(first.version);
        else if(first&&first.save&&Number.isFinite(Number(first.save.version)))PPA_CLOUD.version=Number(first.save.version);
        cloud={version:PPA_CLOUD.version,state:initialState};
        cloudHasCharacter=true;
      }else{
        console.info('PPA: new Telegram account detected; clearing foreign local character cache without reload.');
        ppaClearLocalCharacterCacheForAccountSwitch();
        ppaResetFreshCharacterInMemory(profileNick);
        savedNick=profileNick;
        localCachePresent=false;

function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ARCHER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesAssassinSprites() && ASSASSIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=BERSERKER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return BERSERKER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPriestSprites() && PRIEST_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PRIEST_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesMageSprites() && MAGE_ANIM[name]){
    const a=MAGE_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return MAGE_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPaladinSprites() && PALADIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PALADIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PALADIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  return ANIM[name]||ANIM.idle;
}
// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];

    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;

    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;

  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){

    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;

    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

    if(Math.hypot(P.x-p.x,P.y-p.y)<p.r+20){
      changeScene(p.target);
    }
  }
  // Town teleport -> dungeon (walk into the rune circle)
  if(P.portalCD<=0&&!transitioning&&P.scene==='safe'&&sc.teleport&&sc.teleport.target){
    const tp=sc.teleport;
    if(Math.hypot(P.x-tp.x,P.y-tp.y)<tp.r){
      changeScene(tp.target);
    }
  }
  // 1x1 duel preparation: both players may move, but PvP damage stays locked for 10 seconds.
  updatePvpDuelWarmup();

  // Arena ladder: only a fully cleared stage advances.
  if(P.scene==='arena'){
    if(waveActive&&arenaWaveKilled>=arenaWaveTotal&&arenaActiveCount()===0){
      arenaRecordWave(arenaStageProgress());
      waveActive=false;
      waveTimer=180; // 3 sec break: enough to read the HUD, short enough to keep pace
    }
    if(!waveActive&&waveTimer>0){
      waveTimer--;
      if(waveTimer<=0)startWave();
    }
  }

  if(Math.abs(P.vx)>0.1||Math.abs(P.vy)>0.1)P.bob+=0.28;
  else P.bob+=0.04;

  if(P.shootT<=0){
    // Update facing based on horizontal movement for side sprite flip
    if(P.vx > 0.1) P.face = 1;
    else if(P.vx < -0.1) P.face = -1;
    // When moving vertically, keep last horizontal facing
  }

  if(P.shootT>0)P.shootT-=0.12;
  if(P.recoil>0)P.recoil-=0.1;

    const movingNow=playerIsMoving();

    if(playerUsesGnomeSprites()){
      try{gnomeFireCannonball()}catch(_){PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.length=0}
    }else if(playerUsesArcherSprites()){
      try{archerFireArrow()}catch(_){PLAYER_ARROWS.length=0}
    }else{
      melee();
    }

    P.shootCD=Math.max(1,Math.round(60/((P.atkSpd||1)*shopAtkSpeedMul())));

    if(movingNow && P.attackMode!=='melee' && !playerUsesArcherSprites() && !playerUsesPriestSprites() && !playerUsesMageSprites()){
      // Gnome/ranged legacy behavior stays unchanged:
      // projectile can fire while the running animation continues.
      P.attacking=false;
      P.anim='run';
      P.animTimer=Math.min(P.animTimer||0,6);
      P.runAttackT=14;
    }else{
      // Assassin AND Archer now use their real ATTACK sprites while moving.
      // Movement itself is NOT cancelled; joystick/Smart Attack still moves P.x/P.y.
      P.attacking=true;
      P.anim='attack';
      P.animFrame=0;
      P.animTimer=0;
      P.runAttackT=movingNow?14:0;
    }
  }

  if(P.runAttackT>0)P.runAttackT--;

  // Sprite animation state machine:
  // attack > run > idle.
  // Assassin and Archer keep their real ATTACK animation while moving.
  // Gnome keeps its approved run+separate-projectile behavior.
  const movingForAnim=playerIsMoving();
  if(P.attacking&&movingForAnim&&P.attackMode!=='melee'&&!playerUsesArcherSprites()&&!playerUsesPriestSprites()&&!playerUsesMageSprites()){
    P.attacking=false;
    P.anim='run';
    P.animTimer=0;
    P.animFrame=P.animFrame%Math.max(1,playerAnimDef('run').frames);

  }else if(playerUsesPaladinSprites()&&PALADIN_ANIM[P.anim]){
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*PALADIN_DRAW_SCALE,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-(234/256)*dh;
  }else{
    dh=phoneCharacterDrawHeight(P.sz*1.4,_sv);dy=P.sz*.40-dh;
  }
  return sy+(bob+dy)*_sv;
}
function ppaPlayerClanName(){
  try{
    var c=(typeof CLAN_LOCAL_STATE!=='undefined'&&CLAN_LOCAL_STATE&&CLAN_LOCAL_STATE.clan)
      ?String(CLAN_LOCAL_STATE.clan.name||'').trim():'';
    return c;
  }catch(_){return ''}
}
function drawPlayerNickname(){
  var name=ppaPlayerNickname();
  if(!name)return;
  var clan=ppaPlayerClanName();
  var sx=P.x-cam.x;
  var y=ppaPlayerVisualTopScreenY()-9;

  cx.save();
  cx.textAlign='center';
  cx.textBaseline='bottom';
  cx.lineJoin='round';

  if(clan){
    var clanText='['+clan.slice(0,18)+']';
    cx.font='700 8px Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif';
    cx.lineWidth=2.4;
    cx.strokeStyle='rgba(8,12,20,.94)';
    cx.shadowColor='rgba(0,0,0,.78)';
    cx.shadowBlur=3;
    cx.strokeText(clanText,sx,y-12);
    cx.shadowBlur=0;
    cx.fillStyle='#a9cfff';
    cx.fillText(clanText,sx,y-12);
  }

  cx.font='600 10px Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif';
  cx.lineWidth=2.6;
  cx.strokeStyle='rgba(18,8,5,.92)';
  cx.shadowColor='rgba(0,0,0,.72)';
  cx.shadowBlur=3;
  cx.strokeText(name.slice(0,18),sx,y);
  cx.shadowBlur=0;
  cx.fillStyle='#f2d39a';
  cx.fillText(name.slice(0,18),sx,y);
  cx.restore();
}

  // No collision, camera, NPC, mob, AI or combat values are changed.

  };

  const isTank=playerUsesTankSprites()&&!!TANK_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isBerserker=playerUsesBerserkerSprites()&&!!BERSERKER_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isPriest=playerUsesPriestSprites()&&!!PRIEST_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isMage=playerUsesMageSprites()&&!!MAGE_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isPaladin=playerUsesPaladinSprites()&&!!PALADIN_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isCustomDirectional=isGnome||isArcher||isAssassinCustom||isTank||isBerserker||isPriest||isMage||isPaladin;
  const phoneBodyBase=playerClassBodySize(P.sz);
  const visualBody=(isGnome?phoneBodyBase*0.72:phoneBodyBase)*siegeVisualScale;
  const bob=P.scene==='fartzone'?0:Math.sin(P.bob)*(isGnome?2.0:3);

  // Shadow follows the visible character size.
  // Fart Zone: exact feet-to-ground anchor, no visual hovering.
  const playerShadowY=P.scene==='fartzone'?sy+visualBody*0.40:sy+visualBody*0.45;
  cx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  cx.beginPath();cx.ellipse(sx,playerShadowY,visualBody*0.38,visualBody*0.14,0,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

  // Dust when running
  if((Math.abs(P.vx)>0.5||Math.abs(P.vy)>0.5)&&Math.random()<0.25)
    PT.push({x:P.x+(Math.random()-.5)*(isGnome?6:12)*siegeVisualScale,y:P.y+visualBody*0.35,
      vx:-P.vx*0.4+(Math.random()-.5),vy:-P.vy*0.2+(Math.random()-.5)*0.5,
      life:10,ml:10,sz:(isGnome?1.5:2)*siegeVisualScale,col:'rgba(120,100,70,0.4)'});

  cx.save();
  cx.translate(sx,sy+bob);
  if(P.scene==='clansiege')cx.scale(CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE,CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE);

  // Legacy lean/recoil is disabled for the dwarf because his approved
  // 4-frame attack already contains the physical movement.
  if(!isCustomDirectional){
    let lean=0;
    if(P.shootT>0)lean=P.face>0?0.12:-0.12;
    const rc=P.recoil*6*(P.face>0?-1:1);
    cx.translate(rc,0);
    cx.rotate(lean);
  }

  const cur=playerAnimDef(P.anim);
  const canonicalDir=isCustomDirectional?playerDir8():0;
  const dirRow=isGnome
    ? GNOME_SOURCE_ROW[canonicalDir]
    : (isArcher
        ? ARCHER_SOURCE_ROW[canonicalDir]
        : (isAssassinCustom
            ? (P.anim==='run'
                ? ASSASSIN_RUN_SOURCE_ROW[canonicalDir]
                : ASSASSIN_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir])
            : (isTank
                ? TANK_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                : (isBerserker
                    ? BERSERKER_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                    : (isPriest
                        ? PRIEST_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                        : (isMage
                            ? MAGE_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                            : (isPaladin
                                ? PALADIN_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                                : (cur.rows ? getDirRow() : 0))))))));
  const useFlip=isGnome
    ? GNOME_FLIP_BY_DIR[canonicalDir]
    : (isArcher
        ? ARCHER_FLIP_BY_DIR[canonicalDir]
        : ((isAssassinCustom||isTank||isBerserker||isPriest||isMage||isPaladin) ? false : (dirRow===2 && P.face>0)));
  const frameIndex=((P.animFrame%cur.frames)+cur.frames)%cur.frames;

  if(cur.img.complete && cur.img.naturalWidth > 0){
    const fh_row=cur.fh;
    const fw_frame=cur.fw;
    const footY=P.sz*0.40;
    const srcY=dirRow*fh_row;

    let dh,dw,dx,dy;
    if(isGnome){
      // Approved dwarf size stays unchanged.
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*GNOME_DRAW_SCALE,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(113/128)*dh);
    }else if(isArcher){
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*ARCHER_DRAW_SCALE,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(184/224)*dh);
    }else if(isAssassinCustom){
      const assScale=(P.anim==='idle')
        ? ASSASSIN_IDLE_DRAW_SCALE
        : (P.anim==='attack' ? ASSASSIN_ATTACK_DRAW_SCALE : ASSASSIN_RUN_DRAW_SCALE);
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*assScale,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(156/192)*dh);
    }else if(isTank){
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*TANK_DRAW_SCALE,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(232/256)*dh);
    }else if(isBerserker){
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*BERSERKER_DRAW_SCALE,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(232/256)*dh);

      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(236/256)*dh);
    }else if(isPaladin){
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*PALADIN_DRAW_SCALE,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(234/256)*dh);
    }else{
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*1.4,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh*(fw_frame/fh_row);
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(footY-dh);
    }

    if(useFlip){
      cx.save();
      cx.scale(-1,1);
      cx.drawImage(cur.img,fw_frame*frameIndex,srcY,fw_frame,fh_row,dx,dy,dw,dh);
      cx.restore();
    }else{
      cx.drawImage(cur.img,fw_frame*frameIndex,srcY,fw_frame,fh_row,dx,dy,dw,dh);
    }
  } else {
    // Fallback while sprites load
    cx.fillStyle='#4488ff';
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(0,0,phoneBodyBase*0.4,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();
    cx.fillStyle='#fff';cx.font='10px monospace';cx.textAlign='center';
    cx.fillText('?',0,-2);
  }
  cx.restore();

  if(P.shootT>0&&P.meleeAng!==undefined&&P.attackMode==='melee'&&!playerUsesAssassinSprites()&&!playerUsesTankSprites()&&!playerUsesBerserkerSprites()&&!playerUsesPaladinSprites()){

    cx.save();
    cx.translate(sx,sy-8+bob);
    cx.rotate(P.meleeAng);

  var y=ppaPlayerVisualTopScreenY()-9;

  cx.save();
  cx.textAlign='center';
  cx.textBaseline='bottom';
  cx.lineJoin='round';

  if(clan){
    var clanText='['+clan.slice(0,18)+']';
    cx.font='700 8px Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif';

// ==========================================================================

function drawPlayer(){
  const sx=P.x-cam.x,sy=P.y-cam.y;
  const siegeVisualScale=P.scene==='clansiege'?CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE:1;

  // V277: only the player's 8 classes are drawn 10 px smaller.
  // No collision, camera, NPC, mob, AI or combat values are changed.
  const PLAYER_CLASS_EXTRA_REDUCTION_PX=10;
  const playerClassDrawHeight=(baseHeight)=>{
    const sc=Math.max(.01,Number(siegeVisualScale)||1);
    return Math.max(8,phoneCharacterDrawHeight(baseHeight,siegeVisualScale)-PLAYER_CLASS_EXTRA_REDUCTION_PX/sc);
  };
  const playerClassBodySize=(baseSize)=>{
    const sc=Math.max(.01,Number(siegeVisualScale)||1);
    return Math.max(8,phoneCharacterBodySize(baseSize,siegeVisualScale)-PLAYER_CLASS_EXTRA_REDUCTION_PX/sc);
  };
  const isGnome=playerUsesGnomeSprites();
  const isArcher=playerUsesArcherSprites();
  const isAssassinCustom=playerUsesAssassinSprites()&&!!ASSASSIN_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isTank=playerUsesTankSprites()&&!!TANK_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isBerserker=playerUsesBerserkerSprites()&&!!BERSERKER_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isPriest=playerUsesPriestSprites()&&!!PRIEST_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isMage=playerUsesMageSprites()&&!!MAGE_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isPaladin=playerUsesPaladinSprites()&&!!PALADIN_ANIM[P.anim];
  const isCustomDirectional=isGnome||isArcher||isAssassinCustom||isTank||isBerserker||isPriest||isMage||isPaladin;
  const phoneBodyBase=playerClassBodySize(P.sz);
  const visualBody=(isGnome?phoneBodyBase*0.72:phoneBodyBase)*siegeVisualScale;
  const bob=P.scene==='fartzone'?0:Math.sin(P.bob)*(isGnome?2.0:3);

  // Shadow follows the visible character size.
  // Fart Zone: exact feet-to-ground anchor, no visual hovering.
  const playerShadowY=P.scene==='fartzone'?sy+visualBody*0.40:sy+visualBody*0.45;
  cx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,0.4)';
  cx.beginPath();cx.ellipse(sx,playerShadowY,visualBody*0.38,visualBody*0.14,0,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

  // Dust when running
  if((Math.abs(P.vx)>0.5||Math.abs(P.vy)>0.5)&&Math.random()<0.25)
    PT.push({x:P.x+(Math.random()-.5)*(isGnome?6:12)*siegeVisualScale,y:P.y+visualBody*0.35,
      vx:-P.vx*0.4+(Math.random()-.5),vy:-P.vy*0.2+(Math.random()-.5)*0.5,
      life:10,ml:10,sz:(isGnome?1.5:2)*siegeVisualScale,col:'rgba(120,100,70,0.4)'});

  cx.save();
  cx.translate(sx,sy+bob);
  if(P.scene==='clansiege')cx.scale(CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE,CLAN_SIEGE_PLAYER_VISUAL_SCALE);

  // Legacy lean/recoil is disabled for the dwarf because his approved
  // 4-frame attack already contains the physical movement.
  if(!isCustomDirectional){
    let lean=0;
    if(P.shootT>0)lean=P.face>0?0.12:-0.12;
    const rc=P.recoil*6*(P.face>0?-1:1);
    cx.translate(rc,0);
    cx.rotate(lean);
  }

  const cur=playerAnimDef(P.anim);
  const canonicalDir=isCustomDirectional?playerDir8():0;
  const dirRow=isGnome
    ? GNOME_SOURCE_ROW[canonicalDir]
    : (isArcher
        ? ARCHER_SOURCE_ROW[canonicalDir]
        : (isAssassinCustom
            ? (P.anim==='run'
                ? ASSASSIN_RUN_SOURCE_ROW[canonicalDir]
                : ASSASSIN_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir])
            : (isTank
                ? TANK_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                : (isBerserker
                    ? BERSERKER_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                    : (isPriest
                        ? PRIEST_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                        : (isMage
                            ? MAGE_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                            : (isPaladin
                                ? PALADIN_4DIR_ROW[canonicalDir]
                                : (cur.rows ? getDirRow() : 0))))))));
  const useFlip=isGnome
    ? GNOME_FLIP_BY_DIR[canonicalDir]
    : (isArcher
        ? ARCHER_FLIP_BY_DIR[canonicalDir]
        : ((isAssassinCustom||isTank||isBerserker||isPriest||isMage||isPaladin) ? false : (dirRow===2 && P.face>0)));
  const frameIndex=((P.animFrame%cur.frames)+cur.frames)%cur.frames;

  if(cur.img.complete && cur.img.naturalWidth > 0){
    const fh_row=cur.fh;
    const fw_frame=cur.fw;
    const footY=P.sz*0.40;
    const srcY=dirRow*fh_row;

    let dh,dw,dx,dy;
    if(isGnome){
      // Approved dwarf size stays unchanged.
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*GNOME_DRAW_SCALE,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(113/128)*dh);
    }else if(isArcher){
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*ARCHER_DRAW_SCALE,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(184/224)*dh);
    }else if(isAssassinCustom){
      const assScale=(P.anim==='idle')
        ? ASSASSIN_IDLE_DRAW_SCALE
        : (P.anim==='attack' ? ASSASSIN_ATTACK_DRAW_SCALE : ASSASSIN_RUN_DRAW_SCALE);
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*assScale,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(156/192)*dh);
    }else if(isTank){
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*TANK_DRAW_SCALE,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(232/256)*dh);
    }else if(isBerserker){
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*BERSERKER_DRAW_SCALE,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(232/256)*dh);
    }else if(isPriest){
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*PRIEST_DRAW_SCALE,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(236/256)*dh);
    }else if(isMage){
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*MAGE_DRAW_SCALE,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(236/256)*dh);
    }else if(isPaladin){
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*PALADIN_DRAW_SCALE,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh;
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(visualBody*0.40-(234/256)*dh);
    }else{
      dh=playerClassDrawHeight(P.sz*1.4,siegeVisualScale);
      dw=dh*(fw_frame/fh_row);
      dx=Math.round(-dw/2);
      dy=Math.round(footY-dh);
    }

    if(useFlip){
      cx.save();
      cx.scale(-1,1);
      cx.drawImage(cur.img,fw_frame*frameIndex,srcY,fw_frame,fh_row,dx,dy,dw,dh);
      cx.restore();
    }else{
      cx.drawImage(cur.img,fw_frame*frameIndex,srcY,fw_frame,fh_row,dx,dy,dw,dh);
    }
  } else {
    // Fallback while sprites load
    cx.fillStyle='#4488ff';
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(0,0,phoneBodyBase*0.4,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();
    cx.fillStyle='#fff';cx.font='10px monospace';cx.textAlign='center';
    cx.fillText('?',0,-2);
  }
  cx.restore();


  // Melee slash arc visual
  if(P.shootT>0&&P.meleeAng!==undefined&&P.attackMode==='melee'&&!playerUsesAssassinSprites()&&!playerUsesTankSprites()&&!playerUsesBerserkerSprites()&&!playerUsesPaladinSprites()){
    const slashAlpha=P.shootT*0.6;
    cx.save();
    cx.translate(sx,sy-8+bob);
    cx.rotate(P.meleeAng);
    // Arc slash
    cx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,200,'+slashAlpha+')';
    cx.lineWidth=4;
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.arc(0,0,MELEE_RANGE*0.7,-Math.PI*0.3,Math.PI*0.3);
    cx.stroke();
    cx.strokeStyle='rgba(255,255,255,'+slashAlpha*0.5+')';
    cx.lineWidth=2;
    cx.stroke();
    cx.restore();
  }
}

let __v216DungeonHudLast='';
let __v218DungeonHudAt=0;
function v216DungeonTargetHud(){
  const sm=document.getElementById('sceneMode');
  if(!sm||P.scene!=='dungeon')return;
  const now=(typeof performance!=='undefined'&&performance.now)?performance.now():Date.now();
  if(now-__v218DungeonHudAt<80)return;
  __v218DungeonHudAt=now;
  let t=null;
  if(P.tid!=null)t=EN.find(function(e){return e&&e.id==P.tid&&e.hp>0})||null;
  let out='';
  if(t){
    const hp=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(Number(t.hp)||0));
    const mhp=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(Number(t.mhp)||1));
    let nm=(t.type&&t.type.n)||'ЦЕЛЬ';
    if(t.isDungeon21Boss)nm='ВЛАДЫКА СКВЕРНЫ';
    else if(t.isDungeonPhoenixBoss)nm='ФЕНИКС';
    out='<span style="color:#ffb0a5;font-weight:700">HP '+hp+' / '+mhp+'</span> · '+
        '<span style="color:#ead6a7">['+(t.lvl||'?')+'] '+nm+'</span>';
  }else{
    out='<span style="color:#c6b99f">ПОДЗЕМЕЛЬЕ · ЦЕЛЬ НЕ ВЫБРАНА</span>';
  }
  if(out!==__v216DungeonHudLast){
    __v216DungeonHudLast=out;
    sm.innerHTML=out;
  }
  sm.style.display='block';
}

// Inventory UI handlers
// (old inventory tab/close handlers removed — replaced by character panel)
function bindQuickPotionButton(id,group){
  var el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;
  var lastPointerUse=0;
  el.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
    if(e.pointerType==='mouse'&&e.button!==0)return;
    e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
    lastPointerUse=Date.now();
    // Separate pointer from the joystick: potion use never resets jA/jX/jY.
    useQuickPotion(group);
  },{passive:false});
  el.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
    if(Date.now()-lastPointerUse<500)return;
    useQuickPotion(group);
  },{passive:false});
}
bindQuickPotionButton('quickHp','hp');
bindQuickPotionButton('quickMp','mp');

  if(P.scene==='clanboss1'&&!transitioning){clanBossLeaveRaid();changeScene('safe');return}

  if((P.scene==='worldboss'||P.scene==='pvp1'||P.scene==='pvpteam')&&!transitioning)changeScene('safe');
});

let loadedCount=0;
const totalRes=RESOURCES.length;
let gameStarted=false;
const loadBarFill=document.getElementById('loadBarFill');
const loadText=document.getElementById('loadText');
const loadDetail=document.getElementById('loadDetail');
const loadPct=document.getElementById('loadPct');
const loadingScreen=document.getElementById('loadingScreen');

function onResLoad(name){
  loadedCount++;
  const pct=Math.round((loadedCount/totalRes)*100);
  loadBarFill.style.width=pct+'%';
  if(loadPct)loadPct.textContent=pct+'%';
  loadText.textContent='\u0417\u0430\u0433\u0440\u0443\u0437\u043a\u0430... '+loadedCount+'/'+totalRes+' ('+pct+'%)';
  loadDetail.textContent='\u2713 '+name;
  if(loadedCount>=totalRes && !gameStarted){
    startGame();
  }
}

function onResError(name){
  console.warn('Failed to load: '+name+' — using fallback');
  loadedCount++;
  const pct=Math.round((loadedCount/totalRes)*100);
  loadBarFill.style.width=pct+'%';
  if(loadPct)loadPct.textContent=pct+'%';
  loadText.textContent='\u0417\u0430\u0433\u0440\u0443\u0437\u043a\u0430... '+loadedCount+'/'+totalRes+' ('+pct+'%)';
  loadDetail.textContent='\u26a0 '+name+' (fallback)';
  if(loadedCount>=totalRes && !gameStarted){
    startGame();
  }
}

// (old inventory tab/close handlers removed — replaced by character panel)
function bindQuickPotionButton(id,group){
  var el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;
  var lastPointerUse=0;
  el.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){
    if(e.pointerType==='mouse'&&e.button!==0)return;
    e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
    lastPointerUse=Date.now();
    // Separate pointer from the joystick: potion use never resets jA/jX/jY.
    useQuickPotion(group);
  },{passive:false});
  el.addEventListener('click',function(e){
    e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
    if(Date.now()-lastPointerUse<500)return;
    useQuickPotion(group);
  },{passive:false});
}

let loadedCount=0;
const totalRes=RESOURCES.length;
let gameStarted=false;
const loadBarFill=document.getElementById('loadBarFill');
const loadText=document.getElementById('loadText');
const loadDetail=document.getElementById('loadDetail');
const loadPct=document.getElementById('loadPct');
const loadingScreen=document.getElementById('loadingScreen');

function onResLoad(name){
  loadedCount++;
  const pct=Math.round((loadedCount/totalRes)*100);
  loadBarFill.style.width=pct+'%';
  if(loadPct)loadPct.textContent=pct+'%';
  loadText.textContent='\u0417\u0430\u0433\u0440\u0443\u0437\u043a\u0430... '+loadedCount+'/'+totalRes+' ('+pct+'%)';
  loadDetail.textContent='\u2713 '+name;
  if(loadedCount>=totalRes && !gameStarted){
    startGame();
  }
}

function onResError(name){
  console.warn('Failed to load: '+name+' — using fallback');
  loadedCount++;
  const pct=Math.round((loadedCount/totalRes)*100);
  loadBarFill.style.width=pct+'%';
  if(loadPct)loadPct.textContent=pct+'%';
  loadText.textContent='\u0417\u0430\u0433\u0440\u0443\u0437\u043a\u0430... '+loadedCount+'/'+totalRes+' ('+pct+'%)';
  loadDetail.textContent='\u26a0 '+name+' (fallback)';
  if(loadedCount>=totalRes && !gameStarted){
    startGame();
  }
}

  r.img.src=r.src;
});

function onResLoad(name){
  loadedCount++;
  const pct=Math.round((loadedCount/totalRes)*100);
  loadBarFill.style.width=pct+'%';
  if(loadPct)loadPct.textContent=pct+'%';
  loadText.textContent='\u0417\u0430\u0433\u0440\u0443\u0437\u043a\u0430... '+loadedCount+'/'+totalRes+' ('+pct+'%)';
  loadDetail.textContent='\u2713 '+name;
  if(loadedCount>=totalRes && !gameStarted){
    startGame();
  }
}

function onResError(name){
  console.warn('Failed to load: '+name+' — using fallback');
  loadedCount++;
  const pct=Math.round((loadedCount/totalRes)*100);
  loadBarFill.style.width=pct+'%';
  if(loadPct)loadPct.textContent=pct+'%';
  loadText.textContent='\u0417\u0430\u0433\u0440\u0443\u0437\u043a\u0430... '+loadedCount+'/'+totalRes+' ('+pct+'%)';
  loadDetail.textContent='\u26a0 '+name+' (fallback)';
  if(loadedCount>=totalRes && !gameStarted){
    startGame();
  }
}

// Start loading each resource
RESOURCES.forEach(function(r){
  r.img.onload=function(){onResLoad(r.name)};
  r.img.onerror=function(){onResError(r.name)};
  // Set src AFTER attaching handlers to ensure we catch the event
  r.img.src=r.src;
});

// Safety timeout: start game after 8 seconds even if some resources fail
setTimeout(function(){
  if(!gameStarted){
    console.warn('Resource load timeout — starting with fallbacks');
    startGame();
  }
},8000);

function skillRank(id){return Math.max(0,Math.min(3,(INV.skillRanks&&INV.skillRanks[id])||0));}
function skillRule(rank){
  if(rank<=0)return {cost:1,chance:1,next:1};
  if(rank===1)return {cost:2,chance:.45,next:2};
  if(rank===2)return {cost:4,chance:.40,next:3};
  return null;
}

}

function tryGrimoireUpgrade(skillId){
  var sk=findGrimoireSkill(skillId);if(!sk)return;
  var ck=classKeyFromName(P.cls);
  if(sk.classKey!==ck){showPickup('Гримуар другого класса: '+sk.className,'#ff8888');return;}
  var rank=skillRank(skillId),rule=skillRule(rank);
  if(!rule){showPickup(sk.n+' уже III ранга','#ffd168');return;}
  var have=(INV.grimoires&&INV.grimoires[skillId])||0;
  if(have<rule.cost){showPickup('Нужно '+rule.cost+' гримуар(а) · есть '+have,'#ffb36a');return;}
  INV.grimoires[skillId]=have-rule.cost;
  var ok=Math.random()<rule.chance;
  if(ok){
    INV.skillRanks[skillId]=rule.next;
    var roman=['','I','II','III'][rule.next];
    showPickup(sk.n+' · ранг '+roman+' открыт!','#8dff9a');
  }else{
    showPickup('Неудача · '+rule.cost+' гримуар(а) сгорели','#ff6868');
  }
  recomputeStats();
}
// Determine which sprite row to use based on facing direction
// 0=back/up, 1=front/down, 2=side
function getDirRow(){
  // During standing attack OR run-and-attack, face the target/shot while
  // movement itself remains controlled by the joystick.
  if((P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0) && P.meleeAng !== undefined){
    const ax = Math.cos(P.meleeAng);
    const ay = Math.sin(P.meleeAng);
    if(Math.abs(ay) > Math.abs(ax) * 0.8){
      return ay > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    }
    return 2;
  }
  // During movement, use velocity with smooth direction switching
  const sp = Math.sqrt(P.vx*P.vx + P.vy*P.vy);
  if(sp > 0.5){
    // Use a threshold that favors vertical for more natural 4-dir movement
    if(Math.abs(P.vy) > Math.abs(P.vx) * 0.8){
      P.lastDir = P.vy > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    } else if(Math.abs(P.vx) > Math.abs(P.vy) * 0.8) {
      P.lastDir = 2;
    } else {
      // Diagonal: pick based on dominant axis
      if(Math.abs(P.vy) >= Math.abs(P.vx)) {
        P.lastDir = P.vy > 0 ? 1 : 0;
      } else {
        P.lastDir = 2;
      }
    }
  }
  return P.lastDir;
}

function fartShuffle(a){
  a=a.slice();
  for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){
    const j=(Math.random()*(i+1))|0;
    const t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;
  }
  return a;
}

function fartMineTypePool(){
  // Random placement every visit, while preserving a useful mix:
  // 3 gold, 2 PPA and 8 resource mines.
  return fartShuffle([
    'gold','gold','gold',
    'ppa','ppa',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource'
  ]);
}

function fartGuardSpriteIndex(){
  // Only complete, readable, non-tiny full-body assets.
  // Excludes partial FX / eyes / weapons / tiny sprites.
  const pool=[9,10,13,15,16];
  return pool[(Math.random()*pool.length)|0];
}

function fartGuardCooldownKey(mineId,index){
  return String(mineId||'')+':'+Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(index)||0));
}

function fartGuardCooldownAt(mineId,index){
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns=(INV.fartGuardCooldowns&&typeof INV.fartGuardCooldowns==='object')?INV.fartGuardCooldowns:{};
  return Math.max(0,Number(INV.fartGuardCooldowns[fartGuardCooldownKey(mineId,index)])||0);
}

function fartSpawnGuardGroup(mine){
  mine.guardCount=3+((Math.random()*3)|0);
  const now=Date.now();
  for(let i=0;i<mine.guardCount;i++){
    const at=fartGuardCooldownAt(mine.id,i);
    if(at>now){
      FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.push({mineId:mine.id,index:i,at:at});
    }else{
      if(at){
        delete INV.fartGuardCooldowns[fartGuardCooldownKey(mine.id,i)];
      }
      fartSpawnGuard(mine,i);
    }
  }
}

function fartInitZone(){
  FART_ZONE_STATE.ready=true;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.length=0;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.activeMineId=null;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMining=false;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMineId=null;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.lastTick=Date.now();

  const types=fartMineTypePool();
  FART_ZONE_STATE.mines=FART_ZONE_MINE_SPOTS.map(function(p,i){
    const type=types[i]||'resource';
    return {
      id:'fart_mine_'+(i+1),
      x:p.x,y:p.y,type:type,
      art:type==='gold'?'gold':(type==='ppa'?'ppa':(Math.random()<.48?'ore':'blue')),
      goldCarry:0,ppaCarry:0,resMs:0,
      guardCount:0
    };
  });

  FART_ZONE_STATE.mines.forEach(fartSpawnGuardGroup);
}

function fartMineById(id){
  return FART_ZONE_STATE.mines.find(function(m){return m.id===id})||null;
}

function fartQueueGuardRespawn(e){
  if(!e||!e.isFartGuard)return;
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns=(INV.fartGuardCooldowns&&typeof INV.fartGuardCooldowns==='object')?INV.fartGuardCooldowns:{};
  const idx=e.fartGuardIndex||0;
  const at=Date.now()+FART_GUARD_RESPAWN_MIN;
  const key=fartGuardCooldownKey(e.fartMineId,idx);
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns[key]=at;

  // Replace any stale duplicate queue entry for the same guard.
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns=FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.filter(function(q){
    return !(q&&q.mineId===e.fartMineId&&Number(q.index||0)===Number(idx));
  });
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.push({mineId:e.fartMineId,index:idx,at:at});
  try{saveGame()}catch(_){}
}

function fartGuardRareDrops(e){
  if(!e||!e.isFartGuard)return;

  // Epic equipment — 0.001%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_EPIC_GEAR_CHANCE){
    const it=genItem(20,false,'epic');
    if(it){
      LOOT.push({
        x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
        y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
        kind:'gear',item:it,gear:it,bob:Math.random()*6
      });
    }
  }

  // Epic universal stat rune — 0.00012%.
  // Legendary stat runes remain non-drop here; V272 mini-boss 41–60 is the explicit exception.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_EPIC_RUNE_CHANCE){
    fartPushUniversalRune(e,'epic');
  }

  // Ordinary/common universal stat rune — 10%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_COMMON_RUNE_CHANCE){
    fartPushUniversalRune(e,'common');
  }

  // Premium sharpening rune — 6%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_PREMIUM_RUNE_CHANCE){
    LOOT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      kind:'stone',stone:'rune',amount:1,bob:Math.random()*6,
      rarity:'rare',
      name:'Премиум руна заточки',
      img:PPA_V172_ART.premiumRune
    });
  }

  // Legendary crafting materials — independent ultra-rare rolls.
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_EMERALD_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Изумруд Вечности');
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_ORE_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Адская руда');
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_ABYSS_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Кристалл Бездны');
}
