// Premium sharpening rune 6% = 0.06
const FART_GUARD_EPIC_GEAR_CHANCE=0.00001;
const FART_GUARD_EPIC_RUNE_CHANCE=0.0000012;
const FART_GUARD_COMMON_RUNE_CHANCE=0.10;
const FART_GUARD_PREMIUM_RUNE_CHANCE=0.06;
// Three legendary crafting resources — Fart Zone guards only.
const FART_LEGEND_EMERALD_CHANCE=0.0000020; // 0.00020%
const FART_LEGEND_ORE_CHANCE=0.0000017;     // 0.00017%
const FART_LEGEND_ABYSS_CHANCE=0.0000012;   // 0.00012%

const FART_GUARD_RESPAWN_MIN=1800000;
const FART_GUARD_RESPAWN_MAX=1800000;
const FART_MINE_RADIUS=82;

const FART_ZONE_STATE={
  ready:false,
  mines:[],
  respawns:[],
  lastTick:Date.now(),
  lastUiAt:0,
  activeMineId:null,
  autoMining:false,
  autoMineId:null
};

function fartShuffle(a){
  a=a.slice();
  for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){
    const j=(Math.random()*(i+1))|0;
    const t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;
  }
  return a;
}

function fartMineTypePool(){
  // Random placement every visit, while preserving a useful mix:
  // 3 gold, 2 PPA and 8 resource mines.
  return fartShuffle([
    'gold','gold','gold',
    'ppa','ppa',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource'
  ]);
}

function fartGuardSpriteIndex(){
  // Only complete, readable, non-tiny full-body assets.
  // Excludes partial FX / eyes / weapons / tiny sprites.
  const pool=[9,10,13,15,16];
  return pool[(Math.random()*pool.length)|0];
}

function fartSpawnGuard(mine,index,forcedAngle){
  if(P.scene!=='fartzone')return null;
  const count=Math.max(3,Math.min(5,mine.guardCount||4));
  const a=(forcedAngle!==undefined?forcedAngle:(Math.PI*2*index/count))+((Math.random()-.5)*0.32);
  const r=72+Math.random()*34;
  const x=mine.x+Math.cos(a)*r;
  const y=mine.y+Math.sin(a)*r*.72;
  const spriteIndex=fartGuardSpriteIndex();
  const names=['Каменный громила','Пещерный воин','Дикий страж','Горный хищник','Рудный берсерк'];
  const e={
    id:eid++,
    type:{n:names[(Math.random()*names.length)|0]},
    x:x,y:y,hx:x,hy:y,lvl:40,
    hp:FART_GUARD_HP,mhp:FART_GUARD_HP,mp:0,mmp:0,
    sp:2.05+Math.random()*.30,sz:38,col:'#9c7150',
    dmg:43+((Math.random()*14)|0),dmgType:'physical',def:FART_GUARD_DEF,
    xp:0,gold:0,
    sprite:DUNGEON_MOB_IMAGES[spriteIndex],
    atkCD:0,flash:0,bob:Math.random()*6,aggro:false,
    edgeChase:false,edgeWait:0,
    fartMoving:false,fartWalkPhase:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,face:(Math.random()<.5?-1:1),
    isFartGuard:true,fartMineId:mine.id,fartGuardIndex:index,
    // Elite label/HP presentation; Fart Zone gets its own controlled visual scale.
    isDungeonElite:true,
    noFartReward:true
  };
  EN.push(e);
  return e;
}

function fartGuardCooldownKey(mineId,index){
  return String(mineId||'')+':'+Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(index)||0));
}

function fartGuardCooldownAt(mineId,index){
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns=(INV.fartGuardCooldowns&&typeof INV.fartGuardCooldowns==='object')?INV.fartGuardCooldowns:{};
  return Math.max(0,Number(INV.fartGuardCooldowns[fartGuardCooldownKey(mineId,index)])||0);
}

function fartSpawnGuardGroup(mine){
  mine.guardCount=3+((Math.random()*3)|0);
  const now=Date.now();
  for(let i=0;i<mine.guardCount;i++){
    const at=fartGuardCooldownAt(mine.id,i);
    if(at>now){
      FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.push({mineId:mine.id,index:i,at:at});
    }else{
      if(at){
        delete INV.fartGuardCooldowns[fartGuardCooldownKey(mine.id,i)];
      }
      fartSpawnGuard(mine,i);
    }
  }
}

function fartInitZone(){
  FART_ZONE_STATE.ready=true;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.length=0;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.activeMineId=null;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMining=false;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMineId=null;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.lastTick=Date.now();

  const types=fartMineTypePool();
  FART_ZONE_STATE.mines=FART_ZONE_MINE_SPOTS.map(function(p,i){
    const type=types[i]||'resource';
    return {
      id:'fart_mine_'+(i+1),
      x:p.x,y:p.y,type:type,
      art:type==='gold'?'gold':(type==='ppa'?'ppa':(Math.random()<.48?'ore':'blue')),
      goldCarry:0,ppaCarry:0,resMs:0,
      guardCount:0
    };
  });

  FART_ZONE_STATE.mines.forEach(fartSpawnGuardGroup);
}

function fartMineById(id){
  return FART_ZONE_STATE.mines.find(function(m){return m.id===id})||null;
}

function fartMineHasLivingGuard(mine){
  return EN.some(function(e){return e&&e.isFartGuard&&e.fartMineId===mine.id&&e.hp>0});
}

function fartQueueGuardRespawn(e){
  if(!e||!e.isFartGuard)return;
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns=(INV.fartGuardCooldowns&&typeof INV.fartGuardCooldowns==='object')?INV.fartGuardCooldowns:{};
  const idx=e.fartGuardIndex||0;
  const at=Date.now()+FART_GUARD_RESPAWN_MIN;
  const key=fartGuardCooldownKey(e.fartMineId,idx);
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns[key]=at;

  // Replace any stale duplicate queue entry for the same guard.
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns=FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.filter(function(q){
    return !(q&&q.mineId===e.fartMineId&&Number(q.index||0)===Number(idx));
  });
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.push({mineId:e.fartMineId,index:idx,at:at});
  try{saveGame()}catch(_){}
}

function fartPushUniversalRune(e,rarity){
  const types=Object.keys(RUNE_TYPES||{});
  if(!types.length)return false;
  const type=types[(Math.random()*types.length)|0];
  const d=runeDefByKey(runeKey(type,rarity));
  if(!d)return false;
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
    y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
    kind:'statRune',
    runeKey:d.key,name:d.name,icon:d.icon,img:d.img,
    rarity:rarity,bob:Math.random()*6
  });
  return true;
}

function fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,name){
  const def=MATERIAL_DB[name];
  if(!def)return false;
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*34,
    y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*34,
    kind:'material',
    name:name,
    rarity:'legendary',
    src:def.src,
    amount:1,
    bob:Math.random()*6
  });
  return true;
}

function fartGuardRareDrops(e){
  if(!e||!e.isFartGuard)return;

  // Epic equipment — 0.001%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_EPIC_GEAR_CHANCE){
    const it=genItem(20,false,'epic');
    if(it){
      LOOT.push({
        x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
        y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
        kind:'gear',item:it,gear:it,bob:Math.random()*6
      });
    }
  }

  // Epic universal stat rune — 0.00012%.
  // Legendary stat runes remain non-drop here; V272 mini-boss 41–60 is the explicit exception.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_EPIC_RUNE_CHANCE){
    fartPushUniversalRune(e,'epic');
  }

  // Ordinary/common universal stat rune — 10%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_COMMON_RUNE_CHANCE){
    fartPushUniversalRune(e,'common');
  }

  // Premium sharpening rune — 6%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_PREMIUM_RUNE_CHANCE){
    LOOT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      kind:'stone',stone:'rune',amount:1,bob:Math.random()*6,
      rarity:'rare',
      name:'Премиум руна заточки',
      img:PPA_V172_ART.premiumRune
    });
  }

  // Legendary crafting materials — independent ultra-rare rolls.
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_EMERALD_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Изумруд Вечности');
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_ORE_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Адская руда');
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_ABYSS_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Кристалл Бездны');
}

function fartRandomMaterialFrom(rarity){
  const pool=(typeof MATERIAL_BY_RARITY!=='undefined'&&MATERIAL_BY_RARITY[rarity])||[];
  if(!pool.length)return null;
  return pool[(Math.random()*pool.length)|0];
}

  // Literal rare-to-common checks from the requested chances:
  // blue 25%; if not blue -> green 55%; if not green -> gray 70%;
  // only a roll that fails all three becomes junk.
  let rarity=null;
  if(Math.random()<0.25)rarity='rare';
  else if(Math.random()<0.55)rarity='uncommon';
  else if(Math.random()<0.70)rarit

      fartSpawnGuard(mine,i);
    }
  }
}

function fartInitZone(){
  FART_ZONE_STATE.ready=true;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.length=0;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.activeMineId=null;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMining=false;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMineId=null;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.lastTick=Date.now();

  const types=fartMineTypePool();
  FART_ZONE_STATE.mines=FART_ZONE_MINE_SPOTS.map(function(p,i){
    const type=types[i]||'resource';
    return {
      id:'fart_mine_'+(i+1),
      x:p.x,y:p.y,type:type,
      art:type==='gold'?'gold':(type==='ppa'?'ppa':(Math.random()<.48?'ore':'blue')),
      goldCarry:0,ppaCarry:0,resMs:0,
      guardCount:0
    };
  });

  FART_ZONE_STATE.mines.forEach(fartSpawnGuardGroup);
}

function fartMineById(id){
  return FART_ZONE_STATE.mines.find(function(m){return m.id===id})||null;
}

function fartMineHasLivingGuard(mine){
  return EN.some(function(e){return e&&e.isFartGuard&&e.fartMineId===mine.id&&e.hp>0});
}

function fartQueueGuardRespawn(e){
  if(!e||!e.isFartGuard)return;
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns=(INV.fartGuardCooldowns&&typeof INV.fartGuardCooldowns==='object')?INV.fartGuardCooldowns:{};
  const idx=e.fartGuardIndex||0;
  const at=Date.now()+FART_GUARD_RESPAWN_MIN;
  const key=fartGuardCooldownKey(e.fartMineId,idx);
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns[key]=at;

  // Replace any stale duplicate queue entry for the same guard.
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns=FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.filter(function(q){
    return !(q&&q.mineId===e.fartMineId&&Number(q.index||0)===Number(idx));
  });
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.push({mineId:e.fartMineId,index:idx,at:at});
  try{saveGame()}catch(_){}
}

function fartPushUniversalRune(e,rarity){
  const types=Object.keys(RUNE_TYPES||{});
  if(!types.length)return false;
  const type=types[(Math.random()*types.length)|0];
  const d=runeDefByKey(runeKey(type,rarity));
  if(!d)return false;
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
    y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
    kind:'statRune',
    runeKey:d.key,name:d.name,icon:d.icon,img:d.img,
    rarity:rarity,bob:Math.random()*6
  });
  return true;
}

function fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,name){
  const def=MATERIAL_DB[name];
  if(!def)return false;
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*34,
    y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*34,
    kind:'material',
    name:name,
    rarity:'legendary',
    src:def.src,
    amount:1,
    bob:Math.random()*6
  });
  return true;
}

function fartGuardRareDrops(e){
  if(!e||!e.isFartGuard)return;

  // Epic equipment — 0.001%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_EPIC_GEAR_CHANCE){
    const it=genItem(20,false,'epic');
    if(it){
      LOOT.push({
        x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
        y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
        kind:'gear',item:it,gear:it,bob:Math.random()*6
      });
    }
  }

  // Epic universal stat rune — 0.00012%.
  // Legendary stat runes remain non-drop here; V272 mini-boss 41–60 is the explicit exception.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_EPIC_RUNE_CHANCE){
    fartPushUniversalRune(e,'epic');
  }

  // Ordinary/common universal stat rune — 10%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_COMMON_RUNE_CHANCE){
    fartPushUniversalRune(e,'common');
  }

  // Premium sharpening rune — 6%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_PREMIUM_RUNE_CHANCE){
    LOOT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      kind:'stone',stone:'rune',amount:1,bob:Math.random()*6,
      rarity:'rare',
      name:'Премиум руна заточки',
      img:PPA_V172_ART.premiumRune
    });
  }

  // Legendary crafting materials — independent ultra-rare rolls.
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_EMERALD_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Изумруд Вечности');
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_ORE_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Адская руда');
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_ABYSS_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Кристалл Бездны');
}

function fartRandomMaterialFrom(rarity){
  const pool=(typeof MATERIAL_BY_RARITY!=='undefined'&&MATERIAL_BY_RARITY[rarity])||[];
  if(!pool.length)return null;
  return pool[(Math.random()*pool.length)|0];
}

function fartGiveResourceRoll(){
  // Literal rare-to-common checks from the requested chances:
  // blue 25%; if not blue -> green 55%; if not green -> gray 70%;
  // only a roll that fails all three becomes junk.
  let rarity=null;
  if(Math.random()<0.25)rarity='rare';
  else if(Math.random()<0.55)rarity='uncommon';
  else if(Math.random()<0.70)rarity='common';

  if(rarity){
    const name=fartRandomMaterialFrom(rarity);
    if(name){
      INV.materials[name]=(Number(INV.materials[name])||0)+1;
      showPickup('⛏ '+name+' ×1',RCOL_P[rarity]||'#ddd');
      scheduleCombatSave();sendInvState();sendBlacksmithState();sendMerchantState();
      return;
    }
  }

  INV.fartJunk=(Number(INV.fartJunk)||0)+1;
  showPickup('🪨 Шлак ×1 · продажа 10 золота','#9a948a');
  scheduleCombatSave();
}

// === V211 CHARACTER XP CURVE ===============================================
// XP needed to go from the CURRENT level to the next one.
// Early levels are deliberately slower than before; from level 10 onward
// the requirement grows by 20% per level so progression stays meaningful
// without the old runaway x1.4 curve.
const XP_REQ_EARLY={1:200,2:300,3:450,4:650,5:900,6:1200,7:1600,8:2100,9:2700,10:3400};
function xpRequiredForLevel(level){
  const L=Math.max(1,Math.floor(Number(level)||1));
  if(L<=10)return XP_REQ_EARLY[L];
  return Math.max(3400,Math.round((3400*Math.pow(1.20,L-10))/100)*100);
}
function syncXpRequirement(){P.xn=xpRequiredForLevel(P.lvl);return P.xn;}

const EN=[],PR=[],PT=[],LOOT=[];
const PLAYER_CANNONBALLS=[]; // V126: dwarf shots; separate from hostile boss projectiles

function gnomeFireCannonball(){
  // Select ONCE at the moment of the shot. No target search is done in the
  // projectile update loop.
  let target=null;
  if(P.tid!=null){
    target=EN.find(function(e){return e&&e.id==P.tid&&e.hp>0&&targetIsValid(e)})||null;
    if(target){
      const edge=(target.sz&&target.sz>30)?Math.max(0,(target.sz-30)*.4):0;
      if(Math.hypot(target.x-P.x,target.y-P.y)>playerBasicRange()+edge)target=null;
    }
  }
  if(!target)target=findNearBasic();
  P.tid=target?target.id:null;
  if(!target)return false;

  const dx=target.x-P.x,dy=target.y-P.y;
  const dist=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy));
  const ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  const speed=7;

  P.face=dx<0?-1:1;
  P.meleeAng=ang;
  P.shootT=1;
  P.recoil=0;

  const muzzleX=P.x+dx/dist*24;
  const muzzleY=P.y-7+dy/dist*10;
  PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.push({
    x:muzzleX,
    y:muzzleY,
    vx:dx/dist*speed,
    vy:dy/dist*speed,
    remaining:dist,
    target:target
  });

  // Very small game-layer muzzle kick so firing while running still reads
  // clearly without adding effects into the sprite sheet.
  for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
    PT.push({
      x:muzzleX,y:muzzleY,
      vx:dx/dist*(1.2+i*.45)+(Math.random()-.5)*.6,
      vy:dy/dist*(1.2+i*.45)+(Math.random()-.5)*.6,
      life:6,ml:6,sz:1.5+i*.45,
      col:i===0?'#ffd36a':'#c47a32'
    });
  }
  return true;
}
function updatePlayerCannonballs(){
  // Extremely small loop: move each ball toward the coordinates captured at
  // fire time. At arrival, use the game's already proven damage routine.
  for(let i=PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.length-1;i>=0;i--){
    const b=PLAYER_CANNONBALLS[i];
    b.x+=b.vx;
    b.y+=b.vy;
    b.remaining-=Math.hypot(b.vx,b.vy);

    if(b.remaining<=0){
      const t=b.target;
      if(t&&t.hp>0){
        try{
          applyBasicAttackHit(t);
        }catch(_){
          const raw=Math.max(1,Math.floor(P.atk||12)-(t.def||0));
          t.hp=Math.max(0,t.hp-raw);
          t.flash=6;t.aggro=true;
        }
      }
      PLAYER_CANNONBALLS.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
}
function drawPlayerCannonballs(){
  const _vw=cv.width/cameraZoom(),_vh=cv.height/cameraZoom();
  for(const b of PLAYER_CANNONBALLS){
    const x=b.x-cam.x,y=b.y-cam.y;
    if(x<-24||y<-24||x>_vw+24||y>_vh+24)continue;
    cx.save();

    // Small but clearly readable cannonball on a phone screen.
    cx.fillStyle='rgba(214,125,42,.30)';
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x,y,10,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

    cx.fillStyle='#24272b';
    cx.strokeStyle='#d68a3d';
    cx.lineWidth=2;
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x,y,7,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();cx.stroke();

    cx.fillStyle='rgba(255,221,155,.75)';
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x-2,y-2,2,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();

    cx.restore();
  }
}

          t.hp=Math.max(0,t.hp-raw);
          t.flash=6;t.aggro=true;
        }

        // Small pixel impact only.
        for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
          PT.push({
            x:t.x+(Math.random()-.5)*5,
            y:t.y-8+(Math.random()-.5)*5,
            vx:(Math.random()-.5)*1.8,
            vy:(Math.random()-.5)*1.8,
            life:7,ml:7,sz:1.3+Math.random(),
            col:j===0?'#e9e1c6':'#8a6b42'
          });
        }
      }
      PLAYER_ARROWS.splice(i,1);
    }
  }
}

function drawPlayerArrows(){
  const _vw=cv.width/cameraZoom(),_vh=cv.height/cameraZoom();
  for(const a of PLAYER_ARROWS){
    const x=a.x-cam.x,y=a.y-cam.y;
    if(x<-28||y<-28||x>_vw+28||y>_vh+28)continue;

    cx.save();
    cx.translate(x,y);
    cx.rotate(a.ang);

    // Pixel-like wooden shaft.
    cx.fillStyle='#b98b55';
    cx.fillRect(-10,-1,16,2);

    // Pale metal arrow head.
    cx.fillStyle='#d9dde0';
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(10,0);
    cx.lineTo(5,-3);
    cx.lineTo(5,3);
    cx.closePath();
    cx.fill();

    // Small dark-green fletching matching the ranger palette.
    cx.fillStyle='#556b3b';
    cx.fillRect(-11,-3,4,2);
    cx.fillRect(-11,1,4,2);

    cx.restore();
  }
}

  // 3 colors × 2 mirror directions × 4 silhouettes (width only; height is unchanged).

  return e;
}

function dungeon21ReferenceStats(baseLvl,roomOrd){
  const lv=Math.max(21,Math.min(40,Math.max(1,Math.min(20,Number(baseLvl)||1))+20));
  const v=DUNGEON21_ARCHETYPES[(Number(roomOrd)||0)%DUNGEON21_ARCHETYPES.length];

  var minHp,maxHp,t;
  if(lv<=25){minHp=900;maxHp=1300;t=(lv-21)/4;}
  else if(lv<=30){minHp=1300;maxHp=1800;t=(lv-26)/4;}
  else if(lv<=35){minHp=2000;maxHp=3000;t=(lv-31)/4;}
  else {minHp=3000;maxHp=4500;t=(lv-36)/4;}
  t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
  var hpBase=minHp+(maxHp-minHp)*t;
  var archetypeMul=v.key==='tough'?1.10:(v.key==='berserk'?0.92:1.00);
  var hp=Math.round(Math.max(minHp,Math.min(maxHp,hpBase*archetypeMul)));
  hp+=(lv<=30)?250:210;

  var defSteps=Math.max(0,Math.floor((lv-30)/5));
  var baseDef=Math.round(Math.max(20,lv-1)*(1+defSteps*0.05));
  if(lv>=30)baseDef+=6;
  var def=(v.key==='armored')?baseDef*2:baseDef;

  return {lvl:lv,hp:hp,def:def,dmg:v.dmg,v:v};
}

function applyDungeon21MobStats(e,si){
  if(DUNGEON_MODE!=='21+'||!e||e.isBoss)return e;
  const p=DG_ACTIVE_SPAWNS[si]||null;
  const room=p?Number(p[2]||0):0;
  // Keep the old 1–20 sprite identity, but DISPLAY the 21+ dungeon as levels 21–40.
  const baseLvl=Math.max(1,Math.min(20,Number(e.lvl)||1));
  e.baseLvl=baseLvl;
  e.lvl=baseLvl+20;

  // V216: cycle archetypes INSIDE each room so ЖИВУЧИЙ / БРОНИРОВАННЫЙ /
  // БЕРСЕРК обязательно встречаются в каждой нормальной пачке.
  let roomOrd=0;
  for(let j=0;j<(Number(si)||0);j++){
    const pj=DG_ACTIVE_SPAWNS[j];
    if(pj&&Number(pj[2]||0)===room)roomOrd++;
  }
  const v=DUNGEON21_ARCHETYPES[roomOrd%DUNGEON21_ARCHETYPES.length];
  const originalName=(e.type&&e.type.n)||'МОБ';
  e.type=Object.assign({},e.type||{}, {n:v.label+' · '+originalName});

  // V173 progression: post-30 mobs start above 2,000 HP so +5/+7 gear has real content to fight.
  var minHp,maxHp,t;
  if(e.lvl<=25){minHp=900;maxHp=1300;t=(e.lvl-21)/4;}
  else if(e.lvl<=30){minHp=1300;maxHp=1800;t=(e.lvl-26)/4;}
  else if(e.lvl<=35){minHp=2000;maxHp=3000;t=(e.lvl-31)/4;}
  else if(e.lvl<=40){minHp=3000;maxHp=4500;t=(e.lvl-36)/4;}
  else if(e.lvl<=45){minHp=4500;maxHp=6500;t=(e.lvl-41)/4;}
  else {minHp=6500;maxHp=9000;t=Math.min(1,(e.lvl-46)/4);}
  t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t));
  var hpBase=minHp+(maxHp-minHp)*t;
  var archetypeMul=v.key==='tough'?1.10:(v.key==='berserk'?0.92:1.00);
  e.hp=Math.round(Math.max(minHp,Math.min(maxHp,hpBase*archetypeMul)));
  // V212 flat HP rebalance: +250 for levels 21-30, +210 for levels 31-40.
  var hpBonus=(e.lvl<=30)?250:((e.lvl<=40)?210:0);
  e.hp+=hpBonus;
  e.mhp=e.hp;

  // V216 DEF:
  // - levels 30–40 receive +6 DEF over the previous curve;
  // - БРОНИРОВАННЫЙ has exactly x2 DEF versus the normal archetype.
  var defSteps=Math.max(0,Math.floor((e.lvl-30)/5));
  var baseDef=Math.round(Math.max(20,e.lvl-1)*(1+defSteps*0.05));
  if(e.lvl>=30&&e.lvl<=40)baseDef+=6;
  e.def=(v.key==='armored')?baseDef*2:baseDef;
  e.dmg=v.dmg;

  e.dungeon21=true;e.dungeon21Kind=v.key;e.dungeon21HpBonus=hpBonus;
  // Visuals/sprites stay EXACTLY the same to avoid increasing game weight.
  return e;
}
function applyDungeon41MobStats(e,si){
  if(DUNGEON_MODE!=='41-60'||!e||e.isBoss)return e;
  const p=DG_ACTIVE_SPAWNS[si]||null;
  const room=p?Number(p[2]||0):0;
  const baseLvl=Math.max(1,Math.min(20,Number(e.lvl)||1));

  let roomOrd=0;
  for(let j=0;j<(Number(si)||0);j++){
    const pj=DG_ACTIVE_SPAWNS[j];
    if(pj&&Number(pj[2]||0)===room)roomOrd++;
  }

  const ref=dungeon21ReferenceStats(baseLvl,roomOrd);
  const originalName=(e.type&&e.type.n)||'МОБ';
  e.type=Object.assign({},e.type||{}, {n:ref.v.label+' · '+originalName});

  e.baseLvl=baseLvl;
  e.lvl=baseLvl+40;              // displayed level 41–60
  e.hp=Math.round(ref.hp*3);
  e.mhp=e.hp;
  e.def=Math.round(ref.def*3);
  e.dmg=Math.round(ref.dmg*3);

  e.dungeon41=true;
  e.dungeon41Kind=ref.v.key;
  e.dungeonReferenceLevel=ref.lvl;
  return e;
}

const DUNGEON21_BOSS_HP=9000;
const DUNGEON21_BOSS_DEF=110;
const DUNGEON21_BOSS_STAFF_DMG=190;  // physical
const DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_DMG=26;     // magic
const DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_RADIUS=180;
const DUNGEON21_BOSS_DRAW=250;
const DUNGEON21_BOSS_ATLAS_SRC='data:image/...;base64,[REMOVED]

===== sprite 19 @95248123 =====
';
const imgDungeon21Boss=new Image();imgDungeon21Boss.src=DUNGEON21_BOSS_ATLAS_SRC;

function dungeon21BossDir(dx,dy){
  if(Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy))return dx<0?'left':'right';
  return dy<0?'up':'down';
}
function dungeon21BossCol(dir){
  return dir==='down'?0:dir==='left'?1:dir==='right'?2:3;
}
function dungeon21BossEntity(){
  return EN.find(function(e){return e&&e.isDungeon21Boss&&e.hp>0})||null;
}
function spawnDungeon21Boss(){
  if(DUNGEON_MODE!=='21+'||EN.some(e=>e.isBoss))return null;
  const bp=dgNearestWalk(DG_BOSS_IMG[0]*DG_SCALE,DG_BOSS_IMG[1]*DG_SCALE);
  const now=Date.now();
  const e={
    id:eid++,type:{n:'ВЛАДЫКА СКВЕРНЫ'},
    x:bp.x,y:bp.y,hx:bp.x,hy:bp.y,
    hp:DUNGEON21_BOSS_HP,mhp:DUNGEON21_BOSS_HP,
    mp:220,mmp:220,sp:0,sz:150,col:'#6f8f3c',
    dmg:DUNGEON21_BOSS_STAFF_DMG,dmgType:'physical',
    def:DUNGEON21_BOSS_DEF,xp:450,gold:320,lvl:40,
    atkCD:0,flash:0,bob:0,isBoss:true,isDungeon21Boss:true,
    d21Dir:'down',d21State:'idle',d21ActionUntil:0,
    d21NextAoe:now+9000+Math.random()*4000,
    d21AoePending:false,d21AoeImpactAt:0,d21AoeFxUntil:0
  };
  EN.push(e);return e;
}
function dungeon21BossUpdate(e,dx,dy,d){
  const now=Date.now();
  e.x=e.hx;e.y=e.hy;
  e.d21Dir=dungeon21BossDir(dx,dy);

  // Lightweight AOE: simple telegraph circle; no heavy sprite/filter effect.
  if(!e.d21AoePending && now>=e.d21NextAoe && d<520){
    e.d21AoePending=true;
    e.d21AoeImpactAt=now+700;
    e.d21ActionUntil=now+900;
    e.d21State='attack';
    e.d21AoeFxUntil=now+1050;
    e.d21NextAoe=now+9000+Math.random()*4000;
  }
  if(e.d21AoePending && now>=e.d21AoeImpactAt){
    e.d21AoePending=false;
    if(d<=DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_RADIUS){
      if(Math.random()*100<effectivePlayerDodge()){
        showPickup('Уворот от скверны!','#aaff88');
      }else{
        P.hp-=playerDmg(DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_DMG,'magic');
        showPickup('AOE Скверны · −'+playerDmg(DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_DMG,'magic'),'#a8ff62');
      }
    }
    for(let j=0;j<6;j++)PT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_RADIUS*1.5,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_RADIUS*.55,
      vx:(Math.random()-.5)*1.5,vy:-Math.random()*1.3,
      life:18,ml:18,sz:2+Math.random()*2,col:Math.random()<.5?'#76b82a':'#9be83d'
    });
  }

  // Physical staff strike.
  const reach=112;
  if(!e.d21AoePending && d<=reach && e.atkCD<=0){
    e.d21State='attack';
    e.d21ActionUntil=now+520;
    e.atkCD=62;
    if(Math.random()*100<effectivePlayerDodge()){
      showPickup('Уворот!','#88ffcc');
    }else{
      const dealt=playerDmg(DUNGEON21_BOSS_STAFF_DMG,'physical');
      P.hp-=dealt;
      showPickup('Посох · −'+dealt,'#e8c6a0');
    }
    for(let j=0;j<4;j++)PT.push({
      x:P.x,y:P.y-12,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*4,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*4,
      life:11,ml:11,sz:2+Math.random()*2,col:'#7aa43a'
    });
  }

  if(now>=e.d21ActionUntil&&!e.d21AoePending)e.d21State='idle';
}
function drawDungeon21BossAoe(e,sx,sy){
  const now=Date.now();
  if(!e.d21AoeFxUntil||now>=e.d21AoeFxUntil)return;
  const left=Math.max(0,e.d21AoeFxUntil-now);
  const total=1050;
  const k=1-left/total;
  const rr=DUNGEON21_BOSS_AOE_RADIUS*(e.d21AoePending?1:(.72+.28*k));
  cx.save();

  cx.restore();

function arenaFillReinforcements(){
  if(P.scene!=='arena'||!waveActive||waveNum===21||waveNum===42)return;
  const level=arenaLevelForStage(waveNum);if(!level)return;
  while(arenaWaveSpawned<arenaWaveTotal&&arenaActiveCount()<ARENA_ACTIVE_CAP)spawnArenaMob(level)
}

// Arena uses the same level 1–40 mob sets and sprites as both dungeons.

// Safe-zone building collision boxes (walls + rooftops are solid — can't walk
// into or across them, matches the art: blacksmith, warehouse, auction house,
// arena entrance structure)
const PLAZA_MASK_POLY=[
[191,293],[977,293],[983,331],[983,608],[977,713],[977,923],[959,947],[887,951],[792,951],[742,943],[697,943],[657,941],[612,941],[567,941],[522,943],[472,948],[397,951],[317,951],[268,950],[259,918],[254,879],[243,838],[231,798],[221,748],[210,693],[202,638],[195,583],[191,518],[188,448],[188,378],[189,328]
];
function plazaPointInPoly(ax,ay){
  let inside=false;
  for(let i=0,j=PLAZA_MASK_POLY.length-1;i<PLAZA_MASK_POLY.length;j=i++){
    const xi=PLAZA_MASK_POLY[i][0], yi=PLAZA_MASK_POLY[i][1];
    const xj=PLAZA_MASK_POLY[j][0], yj=PLAZA_MASK_POLY[j][1];
    const hit=((yi>ay)!=(yj>ay)) && (ax < (xj-xi)*(ay-yi)/((yj-yi)||1e-9)+xi);
    if(hit)inside=!inside;
  }
  return inside;
}
function plazaCircleWalk(wx,wy,r){
  const ax=wx/SCN_SCALE, ay=wy/SCN_SCALE, ar=r/SCN_SCALE;
  const d=ar*0.82;
  return plazaPointInPoly(ax,ay) &&
    plazaPointInPoly(ax+d,ay) && plazaPointInPoly(ax-d,ay) &&
    plazaPointInPoly(ax,ay+d) && plazaPointInPoly(ax,ay-d) &&
    plazaPointInPoly(ax+d*0.7,ay+d*0.7) &&
    plazaPointInPoly(ax-d*0.7,ay+d*0.7) &&
    plazaPointInPoly(ax+d*0.7,ay-d*0.7) &&
    plazaPointInPoly(ax-d*0.7,ay-d*0.7);
}

  {x:Math.round(800*SCN_SCALE),y:Math.round(12*SCN_SCALE),w:Math.round(224*SCN_SCALE),h:Math.round(205*SCN_SCALE)}, // Arena entrance structure

function resolveCollision(nx,ny){
  // Only the safe zone has city/plaza collision
  if(P.scene!=='safe')return {x:nx,y:ny};
  const r=P.sz*0.28; // small foot collision radius
  let x=nx,y=ny;

  // Plaza mask: keep the player's feet on the paved square.
  // Slide along the edge instead of snagging on it.
  if(!plazaCircleWalk(x,y,r)){
    if(plazaCircleWalk(nx,P.y,r)){ x=nx; y=P.y; }
    else if(plazaCircleWalk(P.x,ny,r)){ x=P.x; y=ny; }
    else { x=P.x; y=P.y; }
  }
  for(const b of BUILDINGS){
    const cx0=b.x-r,cy0=b.y-r,cx1=b.x+b.w+r,cy1=b.y+b.h+r;
    if(x>cx0&&x<cx1&&y>cy0&&y<cy1){
      // Push out along the shortest axis (simple AABB resolution)
      const left=x-cx0,right=cx1-x,top=y-cy0,bottom=cy1-y;
      const min=Math.min(left,right,top,bottom);
      if(min===left)x=cx0;
      else if(min===right)x=cx1;
      else if(min===top)y=cy0;
      else y=cy1;
    }
  }
  return {x,y};
}

// Joystick — V38: one dedicated pointer owns movement.
// This prevents a second finger on ATTACK from becoming touches[0]
// and pulling the character toward the right-side attack controls.
let jA=false,jX=0,jY=0,jPointerId=null;
const jB=document.getElementById('joyB'),jS=document.getElementById('joyS');
const joy=document.getElementById('joy');

function resetJoystick(pointerId){
  if(pointerId!==undefined&&pointerId!==null&&jPointerId!==null&&pointerId!==jPointerId)return;
  jA=false;jPointerId=null;jX=0;jY=0;
  jS.style.left='37px';jS.style.top='37px';
}
function updateJoystickFromPointer(e){
  if(!jA||e.pointerId!==jPointerId)return;
  e.preventDefault();
  const r=joy.getBoundingClientRect();
  const cx=r.left+r.width/2,cy=r.top+r.height/2;
  let dx=e.clientX-cx,dy=e.clientY-cy;
  const d=Math.hypot(dx,dy),mx=50;
  if(d>mx){dx=dx/d*mx;dy=dy/d*mx}
  jX=dx/mx;jY=dy/mx;
  jS.style.left=(37+dx)+'px';jS.style.top=(37+dy)+'px';
}
function jPointerDown(e){
  // Ignore extra fingers: only the first pointer that starts on the joystick owns it.
  if(jPointerId!==null)return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
  // V139: joystick no longer cancels Smart Attack.
  // While the player is steering manually, target lock remains active.
  jPointerId=e.pointerId;jA=true;
  try{joy.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}
  updateJoystickFromPointer(e);
}
function jPointerMove(e){
  if(e.pointerId!==jPointerId)return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
  updateJoystickFromPointer(e);
}
function jPointerEnd(e){
  if(e.pointerId!==jPointerId)return;
  e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();
  try{if(joy.hasPointerCapture(e.pointerId))joy.releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}
  resetJoystick(e.pointerId);
}

joy.addEventListener('pointerdown',jPointerDown,{passive:false});
joy.addEventListener('pointermove',jPointerMove,{passive:false});
joy.addEventListener('pointerup',jPointerEnd,{passive:false});
joy.addEventListener('pointercancel',jPointerEnd,{passive:false});
joy.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',e=>{if(e.pointerId===jPointerId)resetJoystick(e.pointerId)});
addEventListener('blur',()=>resetJoystick());
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)resetJoystick()});

function phoenixDungeonAoeUpdate(e,d){
  if(!e||!e.isDungeonPhoenixBoss)return;
  const now=Date.now();
  if(!e.phoenixAoePending&&now>=e.phoenixAoeNextAt){
    e.phoenixAoePending=true;
    e.phoenixAoeImpactAt=now+700;
    e.phoenixAoeFxUntil=now+1050;
    e.phoenixAoeNextAt=now+10000+Math.random()*4000;
  }
  if(e.phoenixAoePending&&now>=e.phoenixAoeImpactAt){
    e.phoenixAoePending=false;
    if(d<=PHOENIX_DUNGEON_AOE_RADIUS){
      if(Math.random()*100<effectivePlayerDodge()){
        showPickup('Уворот от огненного AOE!','#88ffcc');
      }else{
        const _aoe=playerDmg(PHOENIX_DUNGEON_AOE_DMG,'magic');
        P.hp-=_aoe;
        showPickup('Огненный AOE · −'+_aoe,'#ff9b45');
      }
    }
    // Tiny particle burst only; no filters / no heavy sprite effect.
    for(let j=0;j<10;j++)PT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*PHOENIX_DUNGEON_AOE_RADIUS*1.5,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*PHOENIX_DUNGEON_AOE_RADIUS*.55,
      vx:(Math.random()-.5)*1.8,vy:-Math.random()*1.6,
      life:16,ml:16,sz:2+Math.random()*2,
      col:Math.random()<.5?'#ff6a24':'#ffc044'
    });
  }
}
function drawPhoenixDungeonAoe(e,sx,sy){
  if(!e||!e.isDungeonPhoenixBoss||!e.phoenixAoeFxUntil)return;
  const now=Date.now();
  if(now>=e.phoenixAoeFxUntil)return;
  const pending=!!e.phoenixAoePending;
  cx.save();
  cx.lineWidth=3;
  cx.strokeStyle=pending?'rgba(255,120,45,.90)':'rgba(255,175,60,.68)';
  cx.fillStyle=pending?'rgba(255,80,20,.08)':'rgba(255,110,25,.14)';
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(sx,sy+20,PHOENIX_DUNGEON_AOE_RADIUS,0,Math.PI*2);
  cx.fill();cx.stroke();
  cx.restore();
}

  return e;
}

function auctionRarityName(r){return ({common:'Обычный',uncommon:'Необычный',rare:'Редкий',epic:'Эпический',legendary:'Легендарный'})[r]||'Обычный'}
function auctionMinPrices(it){
  it=it||{};
  var gear=it.gear||{},kind=it.kind||'',id=it.refId||'';
  var slot=it.slot||gear.slot||'';
  var rarity=it.rarity||gear.rarity||'common';
  var level=Number(it.level||it.lvl||gear.level||gear.lvl||0)||0;
  var gram=0.10,ppa=1;

  // Pets: user-defined market floor. Craft PPA cost is also the PPA floor.
  if(slot==='pet'){
    gram=({common:2,uncommon:4,rare:10})[rarity]||2;
    ppa=({common:500,uncommon:1200,rare:3000})[rarity]||500;
  }
  // Special craft accessories: floor follows their blacksmith PPA price.
  // Gram uses the simple auction conversion 1000 PPA = 1 Gram.
  else if(slot==='cloak'||slot==='necklace'||slot==='artifact'||slot==='wings'){
    var specialPpa={
      cloak:{common:200,uncommon:600,rare:1800,epic:5000},
      necklace:{common:800,uncommon:1800,rare:4000,epic:8000},
      artifact:{common:1000,uncommon:2200,rare:5000,epic:9000},
      wings:{common:1200,uncommon:2800,rare:6000,epic:10000}
    };
    ppa=(specialPpa[slot]&&specialPpa[slot][rarity])||1;
    gram=Math.max(0.10,ppa/1000);
  }
  // Normal equipment.
  else if(kind==='gear'||slot){
    gram=({common:0.10,uncommon:0.50,rare:3.00,epic:7.00,legendary:15.00})[rarity]||0.10;
    ppa=({common:1,uncommon:30,rare:100,epic:12000,legendary:20000})[rarity]||1;
    // Crafted epic weapon/armor cost 15k PPA; other epic gear costs 12k.
    if(rarity==='epic'&&(slot==='weapon'||slot==='armor'))ppa=15000;
  }
  // Consumables/resources keep the current V31 floor, but can now be priced higher.
  else if(kind==='consumable'){
    var cg={hp_small:0.30,hp_medium:0.35,hp_large:0.45,mp_small:0.30,mp_medium:0.35,mp_large:0.45,magic_small:0.50,atk_speed_small:0.50,run_speed_small:0.50,phys_small:0.50,xp_scroll:0.60};
    var cp={hp_small:1,hp_medium:1,hp_large:1,mp_small:1,mp_medium:1,mp_large:1,magic_small:1,atk_speed_small:1,run_speed_small:1,phys_small:1,xp_scroll:2};
    gram=cg[id]||0.30;ppa=cp[id]||1;
  }else if(kind==='stone'){
    gram=({normal:0.35,premium:0.70,rune:1.20})[id]||0.35;
    ppa=({normal:1,premium:2,rune:3})[id]||1;
  }else if(kind==='feather'){gram=1.50;ppa=4}
  else if(kind==='grimoire'){gram=1.20;ppa=3}
  else if(kind==='material'){
    gram=({common:0.30,uncommon:0.40,rare:0.60,epic:0.90,legendary:1.30})[rarity]||0.30;
    ppa=({common:1,uncommon:1,rare:2,epic:3,legendary:4})[rarity]||1;
  }

  gram=Math.round(Math.max(0.10,gram)*100)/100;
  ppa=Math.max(1,Math.round(ppa));
  return {gram:gram,ppa:ppa};
}
function auctionAttachMinPrices(it){var p=auctionMinPrices(it);it.minGram=p.gram;it.minPpa=p.ppa;return it}

function auctionCategoryForGear(it){
  var s=it&&it.slot||'';
  if(s==='weapon')return 'weapon';
  if(['helmet','armor','gloves','legs','boots'].indexOf(s)>=0)return 'armor';
  if(['ring','necklace','artifact','cloak','wings','pet'].indexOf(s)>=0)return 'accessories';
  return 'misc';
}

function findNearBasic(){
  const e=findNear();
  if(!e)return null;
  const range=playerBasicRange();

  if(P.scene==='clanboss1'&&e.isClanBoss){
    if(clanBossDistanceFromBody(e,P.x,P.y)>range)return null;
    return e;
  }

  const edge=(e.sz&&e.sz>30)?Math.max(0,(e.sz-30)*.4):0;
  if(Math.hypot(e.x-P.x,e.y-P.y)>range+edge)return null;
  return e;
}

// V89: distances are measured from the OUTER EDGE of the boss body/shadow,
// not from the boss's center.
const CLAN_BOSS_MELEE_EDGE_RANGE=85;

function clanBossCombatTarget(){
  if(P.scene!=='clanboss1'||!CLAN_BOSS_RAID.active)return null;
  return EN.find(function(e){return e&&e.isClanBoss&&e.hp>0})||null;
}


function clanBossBodyGeometry(e){
  var sz=(e&&e.sz)||176;
  if(clanBossIsCerberus(e)){
    return{
      cx:e.x,
      cy:e.y+sz*.46,
      rx:sz*.73,
      ry:sz*.27
    };
  }
  return{
    cx:e.x,
    cy:e.y+sz*.55,
    rx:sz*.62,
    ry:sz*.28
  };
}

function clanBossPlayerShadowCenterAt(x,y){
  return{x:x,y:y+(P.sz||60)*.45};
}

function clanBossExpandedBodyGeometry(e){
  var g=clanBossBodyGeometry(e);
  // Expand by the player's own contact shadow, so the sprites do not overlap.
  return{
    cx:g.cx,cy:g.cy,
    rx:g.rx+(P.sz||60)*.38,
    ry:g.ry+(P.sz||60)*.14
  };
}

function clanBossBodyFreeAt(x,y){
  var e=clanBossCombatTarget();
  if(!e)return true;
  var g=clanBossExpandedBodyGeometry(e);
  var p=clanBossPlayerShadowCenterAt(x,y);
  var dx=(p.x-g.cx)/Math.max(1,g.rx);
  var dy=(p.y-g.cy)/Math.max(1,g.ry);
  return dx*dx+dy*dy>=1;
}

// Approximate world-space distance from the player's contact shadow to the
// outside edge of the expanded boss ellipse. 0 = touching the boss.
function clanBossDistanceFromBody(e,x,y){
  if(!e)return Infinity;
  var g=clanBossExpandedBodyGeometry(e);
  var p=clanBossPlayerShadowCenterAt(x,y);
  var dx=p.x-g.cx,dy=p.y-g.cy;
  var q=Math.hypot(dx/Math.max(1,g.rx),dy/Math.max(1,g.ry));
  if(q<=1)return 0;
  var scale=1/q;
  var ex=dx*scale,ey=dy*scale;
  return Math.hypot(dx-ex,dy-ey);
}

// First obey the arena collision mask, then slide around the boss footprint.
function clanBossMoveWithBodyCollision(x,y,dx,dy,r){
  var full=clanBossSlide(x,y,dx,dy,r);
  if(clanBossBodyFreeAt(full.x,full.y))return full;

  var mx=clanBossSlide(x,y,dx,0,r);
  if(clanBossBodyFreeAt(mx.x,mx.y))return mx;

  var my=clanBossSlide(x,y,0,dy,r);
  if(clanBossBodyFreeAt(my.x,my.y))return my;

  return{x:x,y:y};
}

// Used only for rendering depth: when the player's feet are above the boss's
// feet and their sprites overlap, the boss must cover the player.

function clanBossPlayerIsBehind(e){
  if(!e)return false;
  var ds=clanBossVisualDrawSize(e);
  var playerFoot=P.y+(P.sz||60)*.40;
  var bossFoot=e.y+(e.sz||176)*(clanBossIsCerberus(e)?.46:.45);
  var overlapX=Math.abs(P.x-e.x)<ds*.50+(P.sz||60)*.28;
  var overlapY=playerFoot>bossFoot-ds*(clanBossIsCerberus(e)?.72:.78)&&playerFoot<bossFoot;
  return overlapX&&overlapY;
}

function drawClanBossBodyOccluder(e){
  if(!e||!clanBossPlayerIsBehind(e))return;
  var spr=clanBossSpriteImage(e);
  if(!spr||!spr.complete||!spr.naturalWidth)return;

  var sx=e.x-cam.x,sy=e.y-cam.y;
  var bob=(e&&e.isFartGuard)?0:Math.sin(e.bob)*2;
  var fr=clanBossSpriteFrame(e);
  var cell=clanBossSpriteCell(e);
  var ds=clanBossVisualDrawSize(e);
  var footK=clanBossIsCerberus(e)?.46:.45;

  cx.save();
  cx.translate(sx,sy);
  cx.drawImage(
    spr,
    fr.col*cell,fr.row*cell,cell,cell,
    -ds/2,-ds+(e.sz||176)*footK+bob*1.1,
    ds,ds
  );
  cx.restore();
}


// V104: Phoenix + ordinary mob body collision/depth.
// Visuals, sizes, damage, AI and the original V103 Phoenix asset are unchanged.
// Collision follows the same visible contact-shadow principle used by clan bosses.
function ppaPlayerShadowCenterAt(x,y){
  return{x:x,y:y+(P.sz||60)*.45};
}

function ppaWorldBodyGeometry(e){
  if(!e||e.hp<=0||e.isClanBoss)return null;
  var sz=e.sz||30;

  // Original Phoenix shadow geometry from the V103 renderer.
  if(e.isBoss){
    return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+sz*.55,rx:sz*.60,ry:sz*.20};
  }

  if(e.type&&e.type.slimeScavenger){
    return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+6,rx:13,ry:4};
  }
  if(e.type&&e.type.caveSpider){
    return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+10,rx:24,ry:7};
  }
  if(e.animPack){
    var sh=Math.max(8,e.animPack.h*.28);
    return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+7,rx:sh,ry:Math.max(3,sh*.28)};
  }
  return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+sz*.50,rx:sz*.45,ry:sz*.18};
}

function ppaWorldBodyMetric(e,x,y){
  var g=ppaWorldBodyGeometry(e);
  if(!g)return Infinity;
  var p=ppaPlayerShadowCenterAt(x,y);
  // Minkowski-style expansion by the player's own visible shadow radii.
  var rx=g.rx+(P.sz||60)*.38;
  var ry=g.ry+(P.sz||60)*.14;
  var dx=(p.x-g.cx)/Math.max(1,rx);
  var dy=(p.y-g.cy)/Math.max(1,ry);
  return dx*dx+dy*dy;
}

let PPA_NEAR_BODY_CACHE=[];
let PPA_NEAR_BODY_AT=0,PPA_NEAR_BODY_X=1e9,PPA_NEAR_BODY_Y=1e9,PPA_NEAR_BODY_LEN=-1;
function ppaNearWorldBodies(){
  const now=(typeof performance!=='undefined'&&performance.now)?performance.now():Date.now();
  if(now-PPA_NEAR_BODY_AT>55||Math.abs(P.x-PPA_NEAR_BODY_X)>24||Math.abs(P.y-PPA_NEAR_BODY_Y)>24||PPA_NEAR_BODY_LEN!==EN.length){
    PPA_NEAR_BODY_AT=now;PPA_NEAR_BODY_X=P.x;PPA_NEAR_BODY_Y=P.y;PPA_NEAR_BODY_LEN=EN.length;
    const list=[];
    for(let i=0;i<EN.length;i++){
      const e=EN[i];
      if(!e||e.hp<=0||e.isClanBoss)continue;
      if(Math.abs(e.x-P.x)<=300&&Math.abs(e.y-P.y)<=300)list.push(e);
    }
    PPA_NEAR_BODY_CACHE=list;
  }
  return PPA_NEAR_BODY_CACHE;
}

function ppaWorldBodiesFreeAt(x,y,fromX,fromY){
  const near=ppaNearWorldBodies();
  for(var i=0;i<near.length;i++){
    var e=near[i];
    // Small second broad phase around the proposed player position.
    if(Math.abs(e.x-x)>230||Math.abs(e.y-y)>230)continue;
    var q=ppaWorldBodyMetric(e,x,y);
    if(q<1){
      // If an older save/spawn already overlaps a body, always allow movement out.
      if(fromX!==undefined&&fromY!==undefined){
        var q0=ppaWorldBodyMetric(e,fromX,fromY);
        if(q0<1&&q>q0+.0001)continue;
      }
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

function clanBossExpandedBodyGeometry(e){
  var g=clanBossBodyGeometry(e);
  // Expand by the player's own contact shadow, so the sprites do not overlap.
  return{
    cx:g.cx,cy:g.cy,
    rx:g.rx+(P.sz||60)*.38,
    ry:g.ry+(P.sz||60)*.14
  };
}

function clanBossBodyFreeAt(x,y){
  var e=clanBossCombatTarget();
  if(!e)return true;
  var g=clanBossExpandedBodyGeometry(e);
  var p=clanBossPlayerShadowCenterAt(x,y);
  var dx=(p.x-g.cx)/Math.max(1,g.rx);
  var dy=(p.y-g.cy)/Math.max(1,g.ry);
  return dx*dx+dy*dy>=1;
}

// Approximate world-space distance from the player's contact shadow to the
// outside edge of the expanded boss ellipse. 0 = touching the boss.
function clanBossDistanceFromBody(e,x,y){
  if(!e)return Infinity;
  var g=clanBossExpandedBodyGeometry(e);
  var p=clanBossPlayerShadowCenterAt(x,y);
  var dx=p.x-g.cx,dy=p.y-g.cy;
  var q=Math.hypot(dx/Math.max(1,g.rx),dy/Math.max(1,g.ry));
  if(q<=1)return 0;
  var scale=1/q;
  var ex=dx*scale,ey=dy*scale;
  return Math.hypot(dx-ex,dy-ey);
}

// First obey the arena collision mask, then slide around the boss footprint.
function clanBossMoveWithBodyCollision(x,y,dx,dy,r){
  var full=clanBossSlide(x,y,dx,dy,r);
  if(clanBossBodyFreeAt(full.x,full.y))return full;

  var mx=clanBossSlide(x,y,dx,0,r);
  if(clanBossBodyFreeAt(mx.x,mx.y))return mx;

  var my=clanBossSlide(x,y,0,dy,r);
  if(clanBossBodyFreeAt(my.x,my.y))return my;

  return{x:x,y:y};
}

// Used only for rendering depth: when the player's feet are above the boss's
// feet and their sprites overlap, the boss must cover the player.

function clanBossPlayerIsBehind(e){
  if(!e)return false;
  var ds=clanBossVisualDrawSize(e);
  var playerFoot=P.y+(P.sz||60)*.40;
  var bossFoot=e.y+(e.sz||176)*(clanBossIsCerberus(e)?.46:.45);
  var overlapX=Math.abs(P.x-e.x)<ds*.50+(P.sz||60)*.28;
  var overlapY=playerFoot>bossFoot-ds*(clanBossIsCerberus(e)?.72:.78)&&playerFoot<bossFoot;
  return overlapX&&overlapY;
}

function drawClanBossBodyOccluder(e){
  if(!e||!clanBossPlayerIsBehind(e))return;
  var spr=clanBossSpriteImage(e);
  if(!spr||!spr.complete||!spr.naturalWidth)return;

  var sx=e.x-cam.x,sy=e.y-cam.y;
  var bob=(e&&e.isFartGuard)?0:Math.sin(e.bob)*2;
  var fr=clanBossSpriteFrame(e);
  var cell=clanBossSpriteCell(e);
  var ds=clanBossVisualDrawSize(e);
  var footK=clanBossIsCerberus(e)?.46:.45;

  cx.save();
  cx.translate(sx,sy);
  cx.drawImage(
    spr,
    fr.col*cell,fr.row*cell,cell,cell,
    -ds/2,-ds+(e.sz||176)*footK+bob*1.1,
    ds,ds
  );
  cx.restore();
}


// V104: Phoenix + ordinary mob body collision/depth.
// Visuals, sizes, damage, AI and the original V103 Phoenix asset are unchanged.
// Collision follows the same visible contact-shadow principle used by clan bosses.
function ppaPlayerShadowCenterAt(x,y){
  return{x:x,y:y+(P.sz||60)*.45};
}

function ppaWorldBodyGeometry(e){
  if(!e||e.hp<=0||e.isClanBoss)return null;
  var sz=e.sz||30;

  // Original Phoenix shadow geometry from the V103 renderer.
  if(e.isBoss){
    return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+sz*.55,rx:sz*.60,ry:sz*.20};
  }

  if(e.type&&e.type.slimeScavenger){
    return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+6,rx:13,ry:4};
  }
  if(e.type&&e.type.caveSpider){
    return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+10,rx:24,ry:7};
  }
  if(e.animPack){
    var sh=Math.max(8,e.animPack.h*.28);
    return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+7,rx:sh,ry:Math.max(3,sh*.28)};
  }
  return{cx:e.x,cy:e.y+sz*.50,rx:sz*.45,ry:sz*.18};
}

function ppaWorldBodyMetric(e,x,y){
  var g=ppaWorldBodyGeometry(e);
  if(!g)return Infinity;
  var p=ppaPlayerShadowCenterAt(x,y);
  // Minkowski-style expansion by the player's own visible shadow radii.
  var rx=g.rx+(P.sz||60)*.38;
  var ry=g.ry+(P.sz||60)*.14;
  var dx=(p.x-g.cx)/Math.max(1,rx);
  var dy=(p.y-g.cy)/Math.max(1,ry);
  return dx*dx+dy*dy;
}

let PPA_NEAR_BODY_CACHE=[];
let PPA_NEAR_BODY_AT=0,PPA_NEAR_BODY_X=1e9,PPA_NEAR_BODY_Y=1e9,PPA_NEAR_BODY_LEN=-1;
function ppaNearWorldBodies(){
  const now=(typeof performance!=='undefined'&&performance.now)?performance.now():Date.now();
  if(now-PPA_NEAR_BODY_AT>55||Math.abs(P.x-PPA_NEAR_BODY_X)>24||Math.abs(P.y-PPA_NEAR_BODY_Y)>24||PPA_NEAR_BODY_LEN!==EN.length){
    PPA_NEAR_BODY_AT=now;PPA_NEAR_BODY_X=P.x;PPA_NEAR_BODY_Y=P.y;PPA_NEAR_BODY_LEN=EN.length;
    const list=[];
    for(let i=0;i<EN.length;i++){
      const e=EN[i];
      if(!e||e.hp<=0||e.isClanBoss)continue;
      if(Math.abs(e.x-P.x)<=300&&Math.abs(e.y-P.y)<=300)list.push(e);
    }
    PPA_NEAR_BODY_CACHE=list;
  }
  return PPA_NEAR_BODY_CACHE;
}

function ppaWorldBodiesFreeAt(x,y,fromX,fromY){
  const near=ppaNearWorldBodies();
  for(var i=0;i<near.length;i++){
    var e=near[i];
    // Small second broad phase around the proposed player position.
    if(Math.abs(e.x-x)>230||Math.abs(e.y-y)>230)continue;
    var q=ppaWorldBodyMetric(e,x,y);
    if(q<1){
      // If an older save/spawn already overlaps a body, always allow movement out.
      if(fromX!==undefined&&fromY!==undefined){
        var q0=ppaWorldBodyMetric(e,fromX,fromY);
        if(q0<1&&q>q0+.0001)continue;
      }
      return false;
    }
  }
  return true;
}

function ppaDrawWorldBodyOccluders(){
  if(P.scene!=='dungeon'&&P.scene!=='arena')return;
  var list=[];
  const near=ppaNearWorldBodies();
  for(var i=0;i<near.length;i++){
    var e=near[i];
    if(ppaPlayerIsBehindWorldBody(e))list.push(e);
  }
  // Draw farther bodies first and the closest/lower body last.
  list.sort(function(a,b){
    var ga=ppaWorldBodyGeometry(a),gb=ppaWorldBodyGeometry(b);
    return (ga?ga.cy:0)-(gb?gb.cy:0);
  });
  for(var j=0;j<list.length;j++)ppaDrawWorldBodyOnly(list[j]);
}

function ppaScenePointWalkableForBody(x,y,r){
  if(P.scene==='dungeon')return dgCircleWalk(x,y,r);
  if(P.scene==='arena'){
    var c=SCENES.arena.center;
    return Math.hypot(x-c.x,y-c.y)<=460;
  }
  return true;
}

// Apply entity collision after the normal map/wall resolver. If the direct
// step is blocked, try one axis at a time so movement slides naturally around feet.
function ppaMoveWithWorldBodyCollision(x,y,dx,dy,r){
  var full={x:x+dx,y:y+dy};
  if(ppaWorldBodiesFreeAt(full.x,full.y,x,y))return full;

  var mx={x:x+dx,y:y};
  if(ppaScenePointWalkableForBody(mx.x,mx.y,r)&&ppaWorldBodiesFreeAt(mx.x,mx.y,x,y))return mx;

  var my={x:x,y:y+dy};
  if(ppaScenePointWalkableForBody(my.x,my.y,r)&&ppaWorldBodiesFreeAt(my.x,my.y,x,y))return my;

  return{x:x,y:y};
}

function ppaMobVisualMetrics(e){
  if(!e)return{w:0,h:0};
  if(e.isBoss&&!e.isClanBoss&&!e.isWorldCrystalBoss){
    var bi=imgPhoenix;
    var w=(e.sz||150)*2.3;
    var ratio=(bi&&bi.complete&&bi.naturalWidth>0)?(bi.naturalHeight/bi.naturalWidth):1;
    return{w:w,h:w*ratio};
  }
  if(e.type&&e.type.caveSpider)return{w:72,h:42};
  if(e.animPack){
    var ah=e.animPack.h,aw=ah*(MOB_ANIM_FW/MOB_ANIM_FH);
    return{w:aw,h:ah};
  }
  if(e.sprite&&e.sprite.complete&&e.sprite.naturalWidth>0){
    var scav=!!(e.type&&e.type.slimeScavenger);
    var h=scav?25:Math.max(54,Math.min(92,(e.sz||30)*2));
    var wm=scav?(e.slimeWidthMul||1):1;
    return{w:h*(e.sprite.naturalWidth/e.sprite.naturalHeight)*wm,h:h};
  }
  var d=(e.sz||30)*.84;
  return{w:d,h:d};
}

function ppaPlayerIsBehindWorldBody(e){
  if(!e||e.hp<=0||e.isClanBoss)return false;
  var g=ppaWorldBodyGeometry(e),m=ppaMobVisualMetrics(e);
  if(!g||m.w<=0||m.h<=0)return false;
  var playerFoot=P.y+(P.sz||60)*.45;
  var bodyFoot=g.cy;
  var overlapX=Math.abs(P.x-e.x)<m.w*.50+(P.sz||60)*.38;
  // Behind = player's ground point is above the mob/boss ground point while
  // the two visible sprites still overlap vertically.
  var overlapY=playerFoot<bodyFoot&&playerFoot>bodyFoot-m.h*.86-(P.sz||60)*.10;
  return overlapX&&overlapY;
}

// Repaint only the sprite body over the player. Shadows, names, HP bars and
// attack effects stay in their original render pass, so gameplay visuals do not change.
function ppaDrawWorldBodyOnly(e){
  if(!e||e.hp<=0)return;
  var sx=e.x-cam.x,sy=e.y-cam.y;
  var bob=(e&&e.isFartGuard)?0:Math.sin(e.bob)*2;

  if(e.isBoss&&!e.isClanBoss&&!e.isDungeon21Boss){
    var bossImg=imgPhoenix;
    if(bossImg&&bossImg.complete&&bossImg.naturalWidth>0){
      var spitK=e.spit>0?Math.sin((26-e.spit)/26*Math.PI):0;
      var bw2=e.sz*2.3*(1+spitK*.12);
      var bh2=bw2*(bossImg.naturalHeight/bossImg.naturalWidth);
      var flap=Math.sin(e.bob*.55)*6;
      cx.save();
      cx.translate(sx+(e.face||1)*spitK*14,sy);
      cx.scale(e.face===-1?-1:1,1);
      cx.drawImage(bossImg,-bw2/2,-bh2/2+bob*1.5+flap-14,bw2,bh2);
      cx.restore();
      if(e.flash>0){
        cx.globalAlpha=.4;cx.fillStyle='#fff';cx.beginPath();cx.arc(sx,sy+bob,e.sz*.7,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();cx.globalAlpha=1;
      }
    }else{
      cx.fillStyle=e.flash>0?'#ffffff':e.col;
      cx.beginPath();cx.arc(sx,sy+bob,e.sz*.45,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();
    }
    return;
  }

  var isScavengerSlime=!!(e.type&&e.type.slimeScavenger);
  var isCaveSpider=!!(e.type&&e.type.caveSpider);
  var isApprovedAnimated=!!e.animPack;

  if(isCaveSpider&&CAVE_SPIDER_ATLAS.complete&&CAVE_SPIDER_ATLAS.naturalWidth>0){
    var sf=e.spiderMoving?((Math.floor((Date.now()+(e.spiderPhase||0)*55)/125))%4):0;
    var sr=(e.spiderDir===undefined?1:e.spiderDir),dh=42,dw=72;
    cx.save();cx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
    if(e.flash>0){cx.globalAlpha=.72;cx.filter='brightness(1.8)';}
    cx.drawImage(CAVE_SPIDER_ATLAS,sf*CAVE_SPIDER_FW,sr*CAVE_SPIDER_FH,CAVE_SPIDER_FW,CAVE_SPIDER_FH,sx-dw/2,sy-dh*.72+bob,dw,dh);
    cx.filter='none';cx.globalAlpha=1;cx.restore();
  }else if(isApprovedAnimated&&e.animPack.img.complete&&e.animPack.img.naturalWidth>0){
    var af=e.animMoving?((Math.floor((Date.now()+(e.animPhase||0)*43)/e.animPack.ms))%4):0;
    var ar=(e.animDir===undefined?1:e.animDir),adh=e.animPack.h,adw=adh*(MOB_ANIM_FW/MOB_ANIM_FH);
    cx.save();cx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
    if(e.flash>0){cx.globalAlpha=.72;cx.filter='brightness(1.8)';}
    cx.drawImage(e.animPack.img,af*MOB_ANIM_FW,ar*MOB_ANIM_FH,MOB_ANIM_FW,MOB_ANIM_FH,sx-adw/2,sy-adh*.78+bob,adw,adh);
    cx.filter='none';cx.globalAlpha=1;cx.restore();
  }else if(e.sprite&&e.sprite.complete&&e.sprite.naturalWidth>0){
    var sdh=isScavengerSlime?25:Math.max(54,Math.min(92,e.sz*2));
    var widthMul=isScavengerSlime?(e.slimeWidthMul||1):1;
    var sdw=sdh*(e.sprite.naturalWidth/e.sprite.naturalHeight)*widthMul;
    cx.save();cx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
    if(e.flash>0){cx.globalAlpha=.72;cx.filter='brightness(1.8)';}
    if(isScavengerSlime&&e.slimeFlip){
      cx.translate(sx,0);cx.scale(-1,1);cx.drawImage(e.sprite,-sdw/2,(e.isFartGuard?(sy+(e.sz||38)*.50-sdh*.859375):(sy-sdh*.78+bob)),sdw,sdh);
    }else cx.drawImage(e.sprite,sx-sdw/2,(e.isFartGuard?(sy+(e.sz||38)*.50-sdh*.859375):(sy-sdh*.78+bob)),sdw,sdh);
    cx.filter='none';cx.globalAlpha=1;cx.restore();
  }else{
    cx.fillStyle=e.flash>0?'#ffffff':e.col;
    cx.beginPath();cx.arc(sx,sy+bob,e.sz*.42,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();
  }
}

function ppaDrawWorldBodyOccluders(){
  if(P.scene!=='dungeon'&&P.scene!=='arena')return;
  var list=[];
  const near=ppaNearWorldBodies();
  for(var i=0;i<near.length;i++){
    var e=near[i];
    if(ppaPlayerIsBehindWorldBody(e))list.push(e);
  }
  // Draw farther bodies first and the closest/lower body last.
  list.sort(function(a,b){
    var ga=ppaWorldBodyGeometry(a),gb=ppaWorldBodyGeometry(b);
    return (ga?ga.cy:0)-(gb?gb.cy:0);
  });
  for(var j=0;j<list.length;j++)ppaDrawWorldBodyOnly(list[j]);
}

    showPickup('ПОДОЙДИ БЛИЖЕ','#d8c09d');
    return false;
  }

  P.tid=e.id;

  var crit=Math.random()*100<(P.crit||0);
  var atkBase=10+(Number(P.atk)||12);
  var dmgMul=Number(P.dmgMul);
  if(!Number.isFinite(dmgMul)||dmgMul<=0)dmgMul=1;

  var raw=atkBase*dmgMul*shopDamageMul()*clanBossDamageMul()*(crit?((P.critDmg||180)/100):1);
  var _pen=Math.max(0,Math.min(.60,((classBaseKey()==='mage'||classBaseKey()==='priest')?(P.magicPen||0):(P.armorPen||0))/100));

  P.shootT=1;P.recoil=1;P.meleeAng=ang;
  P.attacking=true;P.anim='attack';P.animFrame=0;P.animTimer=0;

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ARCHER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesAssassinSprites() && ASSASSIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=BERSERKER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return BERSERKER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPriestSprites() && PRIEST_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PRIEST_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesMageSprites() && MAGE_ANIM[name]){
    const a=MAGE_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return MAGE_ANIM.idle;

  if(playerUsesPaladinSprites() && PALADIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PALADIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ARCHER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesAssassinSprites() && ASSASSIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){

    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesMageSprites() && MAGE_ANIM[name]){

    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;

    const a=PALADIN_ANIM[name];

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function playerUsesGnomeSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='gnome';
}
function playerUsesArcherSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='archer';
}
function playerUsesAssassinSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='assassin';
}
function playerUsesTankSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='tank';
}
function playerUsesBerserkerSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='barbarian';
}
function playerUsesPriestSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='priest';
}
function playerUsesMageSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='mage';
}
function playerUsesPaladinSprites(){
  return typeof classKeyFromName==='function' && classKeyFromName(P.cls)==='paladin';
}
function playerUsesEightDirSprites(){
  return playerUsesGnomeSprites()||playerUsesArcherSprites()||
    (playerUsesAssassinSprites()&&P.anim==='run');
}
function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ARCHER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesAssassinSprites() && ASSASSIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=BERSERKER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return BERSERKER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPriestSprites() && PRIEST_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PRIEST_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesMageSprites() && MAGE_ANIM[name]){
    const a=MAGE_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return MAGE_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesPaladinSprites() && PALADIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PALADIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PALADIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  return ANIM[name]||ANIM.idle;
}
// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){

    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesAssassinSprites() && ASSASSIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=BERSERKER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return BERSERKER_ANIM.idle;

  if(playerUsesPriestSprites() && PRIEST_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PRIEST_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesMageSprites() && MAGE_ANIM[name]){
    const a=MAGE_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return MAGE_ANIM.idle;

    const a=PALADIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;

  return ANIM[name]||ANIM.idle;

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){

  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){

  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];

    return TANK_ANIM.idle;

  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=BERSERKER_ANIM[name];

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){

    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ARCHER_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesAssassinSprites() && ASSASSIN_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return ASSASSIN_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=BERSERKER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;

  if(playerUsesPriestSprites() && PRIEST_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PRIEST_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;

  if(playerUsesMageSprites() && MAGE_ANIM[name]){

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function playerAnimDef(name){
  if(playerUsesGnomeSprites() && GNOME_ANIM[name]){
    const a=GNOME_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return GNOME_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesArcherSprites() && ARCHER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=ARCHER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;

    const a=ASSASSIN_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;

  }
  if(playerUsesTankSprites() && TANK_ANIM[name]){
    const a=TANK_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return TANK_ANIM.idle;

  if(playerUsesBerserkerSprites() && BERSERKER_ANIM[name]){
    const a=BERSERKER_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;

  }
  if(playerUsesPriestSprites() && PRIEST_ANIM[name]){
    const a=PRIEST_ANIM[name];
    if(a.img&&a.img.complete&&a.img.naturalWidth>0)return a;
    return PRIEST_ANIM.idle;
  }
  if(playerUsesMageSprites() && MAGE_ANIM[name]){
    const a=MAGE_ANIM[name];

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

function fartShuffle(a){
  a=a.slice();
  for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){
    const j=(Math.random()*(i+1))|0;
    const t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;
  }
  return a;
}

function fartMineTypePool(){
  // Random placement every visit, while preserving a useful mix:
  // 3 gold, 2 PPA and 8 resource mines.
  return fartShuffle([
    'gold','gold','gold',
    'ppa','ppa',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource'
  ]);
}

  // Only complete, readable, non-tiny full-body assets.
  // Excludes partial FX / eyes / weapons / tiny sprites.
  const pool=[9,10,13,15,16];
  return pool[(Math.random()*pool.length)|0];
}

function fartGuardCooldownKey(mineId,index){
  return String(mineId||'')+':'+Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(index)||0));
}

function fartGuardCooldownAt(mineId,index){
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns=(INV.fartGuardCooldowns&&typeof INV.fartGuardCooldowns==='object')?INV.fartGuardCooldowns:{};
  return Math.max(0,Number(INV.fartGuardCooldowns[fartGuardCooldownKey(mineId,index)])||0);
}

function fartSpawnGuardGroup(mine){
  mine.guardCount=3+((Math.random()*3)|0);
  const now=Date.now();
  for(let i=0;i<mine.guardCount;i++){
    const at=fartGuardCooldownAt(mine.id,i);
    if(at>now){
      FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.push({mineId:mine.id,index:i,at:at});
    }else{
      if(at){
        delete INV.fartGuardCooldowns[fartGuardCooldownKey(mine.id,i)];
      }
      fartSpawnGuard(mine,i);
    }
  }
}

function fartInitZone(){
  FART_ZONE_STATE.ready=true;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.length=0;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.activeMineId=null;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMining=false;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMineId=null;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.lastTick=Date.now();

  const types=fartMineTypePool();
  FART_ZONE_STATE.mines=FART_ZONE_MINE_SPOTS.map(function(p,i){
    const type=types[i]||'resource';
    return {
      id:'fart_mine_'+(i+1),
      x:p.x,y:p.y,type:type,
      art:type==='gold'?'gold':(type==='ppa'?'ppa':(Math.random()<.48?'ore':'blue')),
      goldCarry:0,ppaCarry:0,resMs:0,
      guardCount:0
    };
  });

  FART_ZONE_STATE.mines.forEach(fartSpawnGuardGroup);
}

function fartMineById(id){
  return FART_ZONE_STATE.mines.find(function(m){return m.id===id})||null;
}

function fartMineHasLivingGuard(mine){
  return EN.some(function(e){return e&&e.isFartGuard&&e.fartMineId===mine.id&&e.hp>0});
}

function fartQueueGuardRespawn(e){
  if(!e||!e.isFartGuard)return;
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns=(INV.fartGuardCooldowns&&typeof INV.fartGuardCooldowns==='object')?INV.fartGuardCooldowns:{};
  const idx=e.fartGuardIndex||0;
  const at=Date.now()+FART_GUARD_RESPAWN_MIN;
  const key=fartGuardCooldownKey(e.fartMineId,idx);
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns[key]=at;

  // Replace any stale duplicate queue entry for the same guard.
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns=FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.filter(function(q){
    return !(q&&q.mineId===e.fartMineId&&Number(q.index||0)===Number(idx));
  });
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.push({mineId:e.fartMineId,index:idx,at:at});
  try{saveGame()}catch(_){}
}

function fartPushUniversalRune(e,rarity){
  const types=Object.keys(RUNE_TYPES||{});
  if(!types.length)return false;
  const type=types[(Math.random()*types.length)|0];
  const d=runeDefByKey(runeKey(type,rarity));
  if(!d)return false;
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
    y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
    kind:'statRune',
    runeKey:d.key,name:d.name,icon:d.icon,img:d.img,
    rarity:rarity,bob:Math.random()*6
  });
  return true;
}

function fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,name){
  const def=MATERIAL_DB[name];
  if(!def)return false;
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*34,
    y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*34,
    kind:'material',
    name:name,
    rarity:'legendary',
    src:def.src,
    amount:1,
    bob:Math.random()*6
  });
  return true;
}

function fartGuardRareDrops(e){
  if(!e||!e.isFartGuard)return;

  // Epic equipment — 0.001%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_EPIC_GEAR_CHANCE){
    const it=genItem(20,false,'epic');
    if(it){
      LOOT.push({
        x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
        y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
        kind:'gear',item:it,gear:it,bob:Math.random()*6
      });
    }
  }

  // Epic universal stat rune — 0.00012%.
  // Legendary stat runes remain non-drop here; V272 mini-boss 41–60 is the explicit exception.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_EPIC_RUNE_CHANCE){
    fartPushUniversalRune(e,'epic');
  }

  // Ordinary/common universal stat rune — 10%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_COMMON_RUNE_CHANCE){
    fartPushUniversalRune(e,'common');
  }

  // Premium sharpening rune — 6%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_PREMIUM_RUNE_CHANCE){
    LOOT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,

function fartShuffle(a){
  a=a.slice();
  for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){
    const j=(Math.random()*(i+1))|0;
    const t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;
  }
  return a;
}

function fartMineTypePool(){
  // Random placement every visit, while preserving a useful mix:
  // 3 gold, 2 PPA and 8 resource mines.
  return fartShuffle([
    'gold','gold','gold',
    'ppa','ppa',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource'
  ]);
}

function fartGuardCooldownKey(mineId,index){
  return String(mineId||'')+':'+Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(index)||0));
}

function fartGuardCooldownAt(mineId,index){
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns=(INV.fartGuardCooldowns&&typeof INV.fartGuardCooldowns==='object')?INV.fartGuardCooldowns:{};
  return Math.max(0,Number(INV.fartGuardCooldowns[fartGuardCooldownKey(mineId,index)])||0);
}

function fartSpawnGuardGroup(mine){
  mine.guardCount=3+((Math.random()*3)|0);
  const now=Date.now();
  for(let i=0;i<mine.guardCount;i++){
    const at=fartGuardCooldownAt(mine.id,i);
    if(at>now){
      FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.push({mineId:mine.id,index:i,at:at});
    }else{
      if(at){
        delete INV.fartGuardCooldowns[fartGuardCooldownKey(mine.id,i)];
      }
      fartSpawnGuard(mine,i);
    }
  }
}

function fartInitZone(){

  FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMineId=null;

      goldCarry:0,ppaCarry:0,resMs:0,

}

function fartGuardRareDrops(e){
  if(!e||!e.isFartGuard)return;

  // Epic equipment — 0.001%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_EPIC_GEAR_CHANCE){
    const it=genItem(20,false,'epic');

      LOOT.push({
        x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,

        kind:'gear',item:it,gear:it,bob:Math.random()*6
      });
    }
  }

  // Legendary stat runes remain non-drop here; V272 mini-boss 41–60 is the explicit exception.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_EPIC_RUNE_CHANCE){
    fartPushUniversalRune(e,'epic');
  }

  // Ordinary/common universal stat rune — 10%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_COMMON_RUNE_CHANCE){
    fartPushUniversalRune(e,'common');
  }

  // Premium sharpening rune — 6%.
  if(Math.random()<FART_GUARD_PREMIUM_RUNE_CHANCE){
    LOOT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      kind:'stone',stone:'rune',amount:1,bob:Math.random()*6,
      rarity:'rare',
      name:'Премиум руна заточки',
      img:PPA_V172_ART.premiumRune
    });
  }

  // Legendary crafting materials — independent ultra-rare rolls.
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_EMERALD_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Изумруд Вечности');
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_ORE_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Адская руда');
  if(Math.random()<FART_LEGEND_ABYSS_CHANCE)fartPushLegendaryMaterial(e,'Кристалл Бездны');
}

      if(ar==='legendary'&&LEGENDARY_ARTIFACT_ART&&LEGENDARY_ARTIFACT_ART.length)
        ai=LEGENDARY_ARTIFACT_ART[stableItemArtIndex(d||{},LEGENDARY_ARTIFACT_ART.length)];

      ai=LEGENDARY_NECKLACE_ART[stableItemArtIndex(d||{},LEGENDARY_NECKLACE_ART.length)];

    it={uid:'craft_'+ak+'_'+Date.now(),name:(RPREF[ar]||'')+(d.name||ak),slot:ak,rarity:ar,enh:0,

  }else return;

  if(realCraft)payCraft(recipe,craftPpa);

  var bf=document.getElementById('blacksmithFrame');
  if(bf&&bf.contentWindow)bf.contentWindow.postMessage({type:'craftDone',name:it.name,slot:it.slot,rarity:it.rarity},'*');

}

    if((INV.stones.rune||0)<1){smithNotify('Нет Премиум руны заточки','#ff7777');return}

  if(usesNormal)INV.stones.normal--;

  ensureEnhBaseStats(it);
