function clanBossUpdateWhip(e,dx,dy,d){
  if(!e||!e.isClanBoss||P.scene!=='clanboss1'||P.dead)return;

  var now=Date.now();

  // Between attacks the boss turns to the player in 4 cardinal directions.
  if(e.whipState==='idle'){
    e.dir4=clanBossDir4(dx,dy);

    if(e.aoeState==='idle'&&d<=CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_TRIGGER_RANGE&&now>=Number(e.whipNextAt||0)){
      e.whipState='windup';
      e.whipDir=e.dir4;
      e.whipStartedAt=now;
      e.whipHitDone=false;
      e.whipNextAt=now+CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_INTERVAL_MS;
      e.lastAttackText='Плеть '+clanBossDirGlyph(e.whipDir);
    }
    return;
  }

  var elapsed=now-Number(e.whipStartedAt||now);

  // Direction is locked at cast start: player can sidestep the lane.
  e.dir4=e.whipDir||e.dir4||'S';

  if(elapsed>=CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_WINDUP_MS&&!e.whipHitDone){
    e.whipHitDone=true;
    e.whipState='strike';

    if(clanBossWhipHitTest(e,P.x,P.y,e.whipDir)){
      clanBossWhipDamage(e);
    }else{
      showPickup('ПЛЕТЬ МИМО','#d8d0bf');
    }
  }

  if(elapsed>=CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_WINDUP_MS+CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_STRIKE_MS){
    e.whipState='idle';
    e.whipStartedAt=0;
    e.whipHitDone=false;
  }
}

const CLAN_BOSS_SPRITE_CELL=192;
const CLAN_BOSS_SPRITE_DIR_ROW={N:0,E:1,S:2,W:3};


function clanBossIsCerberus(e){
  return !!(e&&e.clanBossId==='clan_boss_2');
}
function clanBossSpriteImage(e){
  return clanBossIsCerberus(e)?imgClanBoss2Sprites:imgClanBoss1Sprites;
}
function clanBossSpriteCell(e){
  return clanBossIsCerberus(e)?256:CLAN_BOSS_SPRITE_CELL;
}
function clanBossVisualDrawSize(e){
  var sz=(e&&e.sz)||176;
  return sz*(clanBossIsCerberus(e)?1.78:1.666);
}
function clanBossSpriteFrame(e){
  var now=Date.now();
  var row=CLAN_BOSS_SPRITE_DIR_ROW[e.dir4||'S'];
  var col=0;

  if(clanBossIsCerberus(e)){
    if(e.cerbState==='attack'){
      var elapsedC=Math.max(0,now-Number(e.cerbStartedAt||now));
      var tC=Math.max(0,Math.min(.999,elapsedC/CERB_FLAME_TOTAL_MS));
      col=4+Math.min(3,Math.floor(tC*4));
    }else{
      col=Math.floor(now/190)%4;
    }
    return{row:row,col:col};
  }

  if(e.whipState==='windup'||e.whipState==='strike'){
    var total=CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_WINDUP_MS+CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_STRIKE_MS;
    var elapsed=Math.max(0,now-Number(e.whipStartedAt||now));
    var t=Math.max(0,Math.min(.999,elapsed/Math.max(1,total)));
    col=4+Math.min(3,Math.floor(t*4));
  }else{
    col=Math.floor(now/180)%4;
  }
  return{row:row,col:col};
}

const CERB_FLAME_INTERVAL_MS=4000;
const CERB_FLAME_WINDUP_MS=560;
const CERB_FLAME_ACTIVE_MS=520;
const CERB_FLAME_TOTAL_MS=CERB_FLAME_WINDUP_MS+CERB_FLAME_ACTIVE_MS;
const CERB_FLAME_RANGE=560;
const CERB_FLAME_HALF_ANGLE=Math.PI*42/180;
const CERB_FLAME_DAMAGE_MIN=78;
const CERB_FLAME_DAMAGE_MAX=120;

const CERB_AOE_DELAYS_MS=[9000,13000,16000];
const CERB_AOE_WINDUP_MS=900;
const CERB_AOE_BLAST_MS=420;
const CERB_AOE_RADIUS=180;
const CERB_AOE_DAMAGE=140;

function cerberusNextAoeDelay(){
  return CERB_AOE_DELAYS_MS[Math.floor(Math.random()*CERB_AOE_DELAYS_MS.length)];
}
function cerberusFanHitTest(e,px,py,dir){
  var v=clanBossDirVec(dir||e.dir4||'S');
  var rx=px-e.x,ry=py-e.y;
  var forward=rx*v.x+ry*v.y;
  if(forward<60||forward>CERB_FLAME_RANGE)return false;
  var side=rx*(-v.y)+ry*v.x;
  return Math.abs(Math.atan2(side,forward))<=CERB_FLAME_HALF_ANGLE;
}
function cerberusFlameDamage(e){
  var raw=CERB_FLAME_DAMAGE_MIN+Math.floor(Math.random()*(CERB_FLAME_DAMAGE_MAX-CERB_FLAME_DAMAGE_MIN+1));
  var dealt=playerDmg(raw,'magic');
  P.hp-=dealt;
  showPickup('ПЛАМЯ ЦЕРБЕРА · −'+Math.max(1,Math.round(dealt)),'#ffb05a');
  for(var j=0;j<8;j++){
    var a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    PT.push({
      x:P.x+(Math.random()-.5)*24,
      y:P.y-8+(Math.random()-.5)*18,
      vx:Math.cos(a)*(1.5+Math.random()*2.5),
      vy:Math.sin(a)*(1.5+Math.random()*2.5),
      life:13,ml:13,sz:2+Math.random()*2,
      col:Math.random()<.5?'#ffcb69':'#ff6a28'
    });
  }
  return dealt;
}
function cerberusAoeDamage(e){
  var dealt=playerDmg(CERB_AOE_DAMAGE,'magic');
  P.hp-=dealt;
  showPickup('ВЗРЫВ ЦЕРБЕРА · −'+Math.max(1,Math.round(dealt)),'#ffd07c');
  return dealt;
}
function cerberusUpdateVisual(e,dx,dy,d){
  if(!clanBossIsCerberus(e)||e.deathStartedAt)return;
  var now=Date.now();

  if(e.cerbAoeState&&e.cerbAoeState!=='idle'){
    var ae=now-Number(e.cerbAoeStartedAt||now);
    if(ae>=CERB_AOE_WINDUP_MS&&!e.cerbAoeHitDone){
      e.cerbAoeHitDone=true;
      e.cerbAoeState='blast';
      var ad=Math.hypot(P.x-Number(e.cerbAoeX||P.x),P.y-Number(e.cerbAoeY||P.y));
      if(ad<=CERB_AOE_RADIUS)cerberusAoeDamage(e);
      else showPickup('ВЫШЕЛ ИЗ ВЗРЫВА','#bfe4ff');
    }
    if(ae>=CERB_AOE_WINDUP_MS+CERB_AOE_BLAST_MS){
      e.cerbAoeState='idle';
      e.cerbAoeStartedAt=0;
      e.cerbAoeHitDone=false;
      e.cerbAoeNextAt=now+cerberusNextAoeDelay();
    }
    return;
  }

  if(e.cerbState!=='attack'&&now>=Number(e.cerbAoeNextAt||0)){
    e.cerbAoeState='windup';
    e.cerbAoeStartedAt=now;
    e.cerbAoeHitDone=false;
    e.cerbAoeX=P.x;
    e.cerbAoeY=P.y;
    e.lastAttackText='AoE · 140 маг. урона';
    return;
  }

  if(e.cerbState==='attack'){
    var fe=now-Number(e.cerbStartedAt||now);
    e.dir4=e.cerbAttackDir||e.dir4||'S';

    if(fe>=CERB_FLAME_WINDUP_MS&&!e.cerbHitDone){
      e.cerbHitDone=true;
      if(cerberusFanHitTest(e,P.x,P.y,e.cerbAttackDir))cerberusFlameDamage(e);
      else showPickup('ПЛАМЯ МИМО','#d8d0bf');
    }

    if(fe>=CERB_FLAME_TOTAL_MS){
      e.cerbState='idle';
      e.cerbStartedAt=0;
      e.cerbHitDone=false;
    }
    return;
  }

  e.dir4=clanBossDir4(dx,dy);
  if(now>=Number(e.cerbNextAt||0)){
    e.cerbState='attack';
    e.cerbAttackDir=e.dir4;
    e.cerbStartedAt=now;
    e.cerbHitDone=false;
    e.cerbNextAt=now+CERB_FLAME_INTERVAL_MS;
    e.lastAttackText='Огненный веер · 78–120';
  }
}
function cerberusDrawFlame(e,sx,sy){
  if(!clanBossIsCerberus(e)||e.cerbState!=='attack')return;
  var now=Date.now();
  var elapsed=now-Number(e.cerbStartedAt||now);
  var v=clanBossDirVec(e.cerbAttackDir||e.dir4||'S');
  var ang=Math.atan2(v.y,v.x);
  var half=CERB_FLAME_HALF_ANGLE;
  var t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,elapsed/CERB_FLAME_WINDUP_MS));

  cx.save();
  if(elapsed<CERB_FLAME_WINDUP_MS){
    cx.globalAlpha=.11+.11*t;
    cx.fillStyle='#ff6a28';
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(sx+v.x*50,sy+v.y*50);
    cx.arc(sx,sy,CERB_FLAME_RANGE,ang-half,ang+half);
    cx.closePath();
    cx.fill();

    cx.globalAlpha=.62;
    cx.strokeStyle='#ffb14b';
    cx.lineWidth=3;
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.arc(sx,sy,CERB_FLAME_RANGE*(.35+.65*t),ang-half,ang+half);
    cx.stroke();
  }else{
    var bt=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(elapsed-CERB_FLAME_WINDUP_MS)/CERB_FLAME_ACTIVE_MS));
    var fade=1-bt*.72;
    var widths=[1,.72,.43],alphas=[.24,.34,.48],colors=['#ff4b16','#ff7a20','#ffd06a'];

    for(var k=0;k<3;k++){
      cx.globalAlpha=alphas[k]*fade;
      cx.fillStyle=colors[k];
      cx.beginPath();
      cx.moveTo(sx+v.x*54,sy+v.y*54);
      cx.arc(sx,sy,CERB_FLAME_RANGE*(1-k*.12),ang-half*widths[k],ang+half*widths[k]);
      cx.closePath();
      cx.fill();
    }

    cx.lineCap='round';
    for(var j=-2;j<=2;j++){
      var q=j/2;
      var a=ang+q*half*.78+Math.sin(now*.025+j)*.035;
      var len=CERB_FLAME_RANGE*(.76+.12*(2-Math.abs(j))/2);
      cx.globalAlpha=.82*fade;
      cx.strokeStyle=j===0?'#fff0

  if(forward<60||forward>CERB_FLAME_RANGE)return false;
  var side=rx*(-v.y)+ry*v.x;
  return Math.abs(Math.atan2(side,forward))<=CERB_FLAME_HALF_ANGLE;
}
function cerberusFlameDamage(e){
  var raw=CERB_FLAME_DAMAGE_MIN+Math.floor(Math.random()*(CERB_FLAME_DAMAGE_MAX-CERB_FLAME_DAMAGE_MIN+1));
  var dealt=playerDmg(raw,'magic');
  P.hp-=dealt;
  showPickup('ПЛАМЯ ЦЕРБЕРА · −'+Math.max(1,Math.round(dealt)),'#ffb05a');
  for(var j=0;j<8;j++){
    var a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    PT.push({
      x:P.x+(Math.random()-.5)*24,
      y:P.y-8+(Math.random()-.5)*18,
      vx:Math.cos(a)*(1.5+Math.random()*2.5),
      vy:Math.sin(a)*(1.5+Math.random()*2.5),
      life:13,ml:13,sz:2+Math.random()*2,
      col:Math.random()<.5?'#ffcb69':'#ff6a28'
    });
  }
  return dealt;
}
function cerberusAoeDamage(e){
  var dealt=playerDmg(CERB_AOE_DAMAGE,'magic');
  P.hp-=dealt;
  showPickup('ВЗРЫВ ЦЕРБЕРА · −'+Math.max(1,Math.round(dealt)),'#ffd07c');
  return dealt;
}
function cerberusUpdateVisual(e,dx,dy,d){
  if(!clanBossIsCerberus(e)||e.deathStartedAt)return;
  var now=Date.now();

  if(e.cerbAoeState&&e.cerbAoeState!=='idle'){
    var ae=now-Number(e.cerbAoeStartedAt||now);
    if(ae>=CERB_AOE_WINDUP_MS&&!e.cerbAoeHitDone){
      e.cerbAoeHitDone=true;
      e.cerbAoeState='blast';
      var ad=Math.hypot(P.x-Number(e.cerbAoeX||P.x),P.y-Number(e.cerbAoeY||P.y));
      if(ad<=CERB_AOE_RADIUS)cerberusAoeDamage(e);
      else showPickup('ВЫШЕЛ ИЗ ВЗРЫВА','#bfe4ff');
    }
    if(ae>=CERB_AOE_WINDUP_MS+CERB_AOE_BLAST_MS){
      e.cerbAoeState='idle';
      e.cerbAoeStartedAt=0;
      e.cerbAoeHitDone=false;
      e.cerbAoeNextAt=now+cerberusNextAoeDelay();
    }
    return;
  }

  if(e.cerbState!=='attack'&&now>=Number(e.cerbAoeNextAt||0)){
    e.cerbAoeState='windup';
    e.cerbAoeStartedAt=now;
    e.cerbAoeHitDone=false;
    e.cerbAoeX=P.x;
    e.cerbAoeY=P.y;
    e.lastAttackText='AoE · 140 маг. урона';
    return;
  }

  if(e.cerbState==='attack'){
    var fe=now-Number(e.cerbStartedAt||now);
    e.dir4=e.cerbAttackDir||e.dir4||'S';

    if(fe>=CERB_FLAME_WINDUP_MS&&!e.cerbHitDone){
      e.cerbHitDone=true;
      if(cerberusFanHitTest(e,P.x,P.y,e.cerbAttackDir))cerberusFlameDamage(e);
      else showPickup('ПЛАМЯ МИМО','#d8d0bf');
    }

    if(fe>=CERB_FLAME_TOTAL_MS){
      e.cerbState='idle';
      e.cerbStartedAt=0;
      e.cerbHitDone=false;
    }
    return;
  }

  e.dir4=clanBossDir4(dx,dy);
  if(now>=Number(e.cerbNextAt||0)){
    e.cerbState='attack';
    e.cerbAttackDir=e.dir4;
    e.cerbStartedAt=now;
    e.cerbHitDone=false;
    e.cerbNextAt=now+CERB_FLAME_INTERVAL_MS;
    e.lastAttackText='Огненный веер · 78–120';
  }
}

function clanBossUpdateWhip(e,dx,dy,d){
  if(!e||!e.isClanBoss||P.scene!=='clanboss1'||P.dead)return;

  var now=Date.now();

  // Between attacks the boss turns to the player in 4 cardinal directions.
  if(e.whipState==='idle'){
    e.dir4=clanBossDir4(dx,dy);

    if(e.aoeState==='idle'&&d<=CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_TRIGGER_RANGE&&now>=Number(e.whipNextAt||0)){
      e.whipState='windup';
      e.whipDir=e.dir4;
      e.whipStartedAt=now;
      e.whipHitDone=false;
      e.whipNextAt=now+CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_INTERVAL_MS;
      e.lastAttackText='Плеть '+clanBossDirGlyph(e.whipDir);
    }
    return;
  }

  var elapsed=now-Number(e.whipStartedAt||now);

  // Direction is locked at cast start: player can sidestep the lane.
  e.dir4=e.whipDir||e.dir4||'S';

  if(elapsed>=CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_WINDUP_MS&&!e.whipHitDone){
    e.whipHitDone=true;
    e.whipState='strike';

    if(clanBossWhipHitTest(e,P.x,P.y,e.whipDir)){
      clanBossWhipDamage(e);
    }else{
      showPickup('ПЛЕТЬ МИМО','#d8d0bf');
    }
  }

  if(elapsed>=CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_WINDUP_MS+CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_STRIKE_MS){
    e.whipState='idle';
    e.whipStartedAt=0;
    e.whipHitDone=false;
  }
}

const CLAN_BOSS_SPRITE_CELL=192;
const CLAN_BOSS_SPRITE_DIR_ROW={N:0,E:1,S:2,W:3};


function clanBossIsCerberus(e){
  return !!(e&&e.clanBossId==='clan_boss_2');
}
function clanBossSpriteImage(e){
  return clanBossIsCerberus(e)?imgClanBoss2Sprites:imgClanBoss1Sprites;
}
function clanBossSpriteCell(e){
  return clanBossIsCerberus(e)?256:CLAN_BOSS_SPRITE_CELL;
}
function clanBossVisualDrawSize(e){
  var sz=(e&&e.sz)||176;
  return sz*(clanBossIsCerberus(e)?1.78:1.666);
}
function clanBossSpriteFrame(e){
  var now=Date.now();
  var row=CLAN_BOSS_SPRITE_DIR_ROW[e.dir4||'S'];
  var col=0;

  if(clanBossIsCerberus(e)){
    if(e.cerbState==='attack'){
      var elapsedC=Math.max(0,now-Number(e.cerbStartedAt||now));
      var tC=Math.max(0,Math.min(.999,elapsedC/CERB_FLAME_TOTAL_MS));
      col=4+Math.min(3,Math.floor(tC*4));
    }else{
      col=Math.floor(now/190)%4;
    }
    return{row:row,col:col};
  }

  if(e.whipState==='windup'||e.whipState==='strike'){
    var total=CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_WINDUP_MS+CLAN_BOSS_WHIP_STRIKE_MS;
    var elapsed=Math.max(0,now-Number(e.whipStartedAt||now));
    var t=Math.max(0,Math.min(.999,elapsed/Math.max(1,total)));
    col=4+Math.min(3,Math.floor(t*4));
  }else{
    col=Math.floor(now/180)%4;
  }
  return{row:row,col:col};
}

const CERB_FLAME_INTERVAL_MS=4000;
const CERB_FLAME_WINDUP_MS=560;
const CERB_FLAME_ACTIVE_MS=520;
const CERB_FLAME_TOTAL_MS=CERB_FLAME_WINDUP_MS+CERB_FLAME_ACTIVE_MS;
const CERB_FLAME_RANGE=560;
const CERB_FLAME_HALF_ANGLE=Math.PI*42/180;
const CERB_FLAME_DAMAGE_MIN=78;
const CERB_FLAME_DAMAGE_MAX=120;

const CERB_AOE_DELAYS_MS=[9000,13000,16000];
const CERB_AOE_WINDUP_MS=900;
const CERB_AOE_BLAST_MS=420;
const CERB_AOE_RADIUS=180;
const CERB_AOE_DAMAGE=140;

function cerberusNextAoeDelay(){
  return CERB_AOE_DELAYS_MS[Math.floor(Math.random()*CERB_AOE_DELAYS_MS.length)];
}
function cerberusFanHitTest(e,px,py,dir){
  var v=clanBossDirVec(dir||e.dir4||'S');
  var rx=px-e.x,ry=py-e.y;
  var forward=rx*v.x+ry*v.y;
  if(forward<60||forward>CERB_FLAME_RANGE)return false;
  var side=rx*(-v.y)+ry*v.x;
  return Math.abs(Math.atan2(side,forward))<=CERB_FLAME_HALF_ANGLE;
}

// Canonical direction index: 0=N,1=NE,2=E,3=SE,4=S,5=SW,6=W,7=NW.
function dir8Canonical(dx,dy){
  if(Math.hypot(dx,dy)<0.001)return Number.isFinite(P.dir8)?P.dir8:4;
  let a=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
  let n=(a+Math.PI/2)%(Math.PI*2);
  if(n<0)n+=Math.PI*2;
  return Math.round(n/(Math.PI/4))%8;
}
function playerDir8(){
  // Run-and-attack: movement continues in joystick direction, but the
  // character visually turns toward the shot/target for the attack moment.
  const aimingNow=(P.attacking||P.runAttackT>0||P.shootT>0);
  if(aimingNow && Number.isFinite(P.meleeAng)){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(Math.cos(P.meleeAng),Math.sin(P.meleeAng));
    return P.dir8;
  }
  if(Math.hypot(P.vx,P.vy)>0.15){
    P.dir8=dir8Canonical(P.vx,P.vy);
  }
  if(!Number.isFinite(P.dir8))P.dir8=4;
  return P.dir8;
}

// === V120 WORLD BOSS PERSONAL CHESTS =========================================
// Никаких новых тяжёлых картинок: сундуки рисуются простыми canvas-примитивами.
// Сейчас это локальная персональная логика. При подключении сервера сервер должен

const WORLD_BOSS_SHARD_NAME='Осколок Кристального Титана';

const TITAN_SHARD_OFFERS={
  normalStone:{id:'normalStone',name:'Обычная заточка ×3',cost:1,icon:'◆'},
  hpRegen:{id:'hpRegen',name:'Премиум-реген HP ×3',cost:2,icon:'❤'},
  portal:{id:'portal',name:'Свиток телепорта ×2',cost:3,icon:'📜'},
  rareMat:{id:'rareMat',name:'Редкий материал ×1',cost:4,icon:'✦'},
  premiumStone:{id:'premiumStone',name:'Премиум-заточка ×1',cost:6,icon:'💎'},
  rune:{id:'rune',name:'Руна ×1',cost:12,icon:'ᚱ'}
};
function titanShardCount(){
  return Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number((INV.materials||{})[WORLD_BOSS_SHARD_NAME])||0));
}

function worldBossDailyKey(ts){
  const d=new Date(ts==null?Date.now():ts);
  if(d.getHours()<18)d.setDate(d.getDate()-1);
  return d.getFullYear()+'-'+String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
}
function worldBossNextResetAt(ts){
  const now=ts==null?Date.now():Number(ts);
  const d=new Date(now);d.setHours(18,0,0,0);
  if(now>=d.getTime())d.setDate(d.getDate()+1);
  return d.getTime();
}
function worldBossDailyState(){
  if(!INV.worldBossDaily||typeof INV.worldBossDaily!=='object'){
    INV.worldBossDaily={killedCycle:'',killedAt:0};
  }
  return INV.worldBossDaily;
}
function worldBossDailyStatus(ts){
  const now=ts==null?Date.now():Number(ts),st=worldBossDailyState(),cycle=worldBossDailyKey(now);
  const available=String(st.killedCycle||'')!==cycle;
  return {
    available:available,
    killedThisCycle:!available,
    cycle:cycle,
    killedAt:Number(st.killedAt)||0,
    nextResetAt:worldBossNextResetAt(now),
    resetHour:18
  };
}
function worldBossDailyAvailable(){return worldBossDailyStatus().available}
function worldBossMarkKilled(){
  const st=worldBossDailyState(),now=Date.now();
  st.killedCycle=worldBossDailyKey(now);st.killedAt=now;
  try{saveGame()}catch(_){}
  try{sendEventsState()}catch(_){}
  return worldBossDailyStatus(now);
}
function worldBossTimeLeftText(ms){
  let sec=Math.max(0,Math.ceil(Number(ms)||0)/1000);
  const h=Math.floor(sec/3600);sec%=3600;
  const m=Math.floor(sec/60),ss=sec%60;
  return String(h).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(m).padStart(2,'0')+':'+String(ss).padStart(2,'0');
}
window.worldBossDailyStatus=worldBossDailyStatus;
window.worldBossDailyAvailable=worldBossDailyAvailable;

function sendEventsState(){
  try{
    if(eventsMenuFrame&&eventsMenuFrame.contentWindow){
      eventsMenuFrame.contentWindow.postMessage({
        type:'eventsState',
        titanShards:titanShardCount(),
        worldBoss:worldBossDailyStatus(),
        clanSiege:(typeof clanSiegeCycleStatus==='function'?clanSiegeCycleStatus():{ready:true,nextAt:0,remainingMs:0,text:'ОСАДА ДОСТУПНА'})
      },'*');
    }
  }catch(_){}
}

  try{
    if(eventsMenuFrame&&eventsMenuFrame.contentWindow){
      eventsMenuFrame.contentWindow.postMessage({
        type:'titanShardShopResult',ok:!!ok,message:String(msg||''),id:id||'',
        titanShards:titanShardCount()
      },'*');
    }
  }catch(_){}
}

  }

  INV.materials[WORLD_BOSS_SHARD_NAME]=have-offer.cost;

  else if(id==='hpRegen')worldBossAddPre

function fartShuffle(a){
  a=a.slice();
  for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){
    const j=(Math.random()*(i+1))|0;
    const t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;
  }
  return a;
}

function fartMineTypePool(){
  // Random placement every visit, while preserving a useful mix:
  // 3 gold, 2 PPA and 8 resource mines.
  return fartShuffle([
    'gold','gold','gold',
    'ppa','ppa',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource',
    'resource','resource','resource','resource'
  ]);
}

function fartGuardSpriteIndex(){
  // Only complete, readable, non-tiny full-body assets.
  // Excludes partial FX / eyes / weapons / tiny sprites.
  const pool=[9,10,13,15,16];
  return pool[(Math.random()*pool.length)|0];
}

function fartSpawnGuard(mine,index,forcedAngle){
  if(P.scene!=='fartzone')return null;
  const count=Math.max(3,Math.min(5,mine.guardCount||4));
  const a=(forcedAngle!==undefined?forcedAngle:(Math.PI*2*index/count))+((Math.random()-.5)*0.32);
  const r=72+Math.random()*34;
  const x=mine.x+Math.cos(a)*r;
  const y=mine.y+Math.sin(a)*r*.72;
  const spriteIndex=fartGuardSpriteIndex();
  const names=['Каменный громила','Пещерный воин','Дикий страж','Горный хищник','Рудный берсерк'];
  const e={
    id:eid++,
    type:{n:names[(Math.random()*names.length)|0]},
    x:x,y:y,hx:x,hy:y,lvl:40,
    hp:FART_GUARD_HP,mhp:FART_GUARD_HP,mp:0,mmp:0,
    sp:2.05+Math.random()*.30,sz:38,col:'#9c7150',
    dmg:43+((Math.random()*14)|0),dmgType:'physical',def:FART_GUARD_DEF,
    xp:0,gold:0,
    sprite:DUNGEON_MOB_IMAGES[spriteIndex],
    atkCD:0,flash:0,bob:Math.random()*6,aggro:false,
    edgeChase:false,edgeWait:0,
    fartMoving:false,fartWalkPhase:Math.random()*Math.PI*2,face:(Math.random()<.5?-1:1),
    isFartGuard:true,fartMineId:mine.id,fartGuardIndex:index,
    // Elite label/HP presentation; Fart Zone gets its own controlled visual scale.
    isDungeonElite:true,
    noFartReward:true
  };
  EN.push(e);
  return e;
}

function fartGuardCooldownKey(mineId,index){
  return String(mineId||'')+':'+Math.max(0,Math.floor(Number(index)||0));
}

function fartGuardCooldownAt(mineId,index){
  INV.fartGuardCooldowns=(INV.fartGuardCooldowns&&typeof INV.fartGuardCooldowns==='object')?INV.fartGuardCooldowns:{};
  return Math.max(0,Number(INV.fartGuardCooldowns[fartGuardCooldownKey(mineId,index)])||0);
}

function fartSpawnGuardGroup(mine){
  mine.guardCount=3+((Math.random()*3)|0);
  const now=Date.now();
  for(let i=0;i<mine.guardCount;i++){
    const at=fartGuardCooldownAt(mine.id,i);
    if(at>now){
      FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.push({mineId:mine.id,index:i,at:at});
    }else{
      if(at){
        delete INV.fartGuardCooldowns[fartGuardCooldownKey(mine.id,i)];
      }
      fartSpawnGuard(mine,i);
    }
  }
}

function fartInitZone(){
  FART_ZONE_STATE.ready=true;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.respawns.length=0;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.activeMineId=null;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMining=false;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.autoMineId=null;
  FART_ZONE_STATE.lastTick=Date.now();

  const types=fartMineTypePool();
  FART_ZONE_STATE.mines=FART_ZONE_MINE_SPOTS.map(function(p,i){
    const type=types[i]||'resource';
    return {
      id:'fart_mine_'+(i+1),
      x:p.x,y:p.y,type:type,
      art:type==='gold'?'gold':(type==='ppa'?'ppa':(Math.random()<.48?'ore':'blue')),
      goldCarry:0,ppaCarry:0,resMs:0,
      guardCount:0
    };
  });

  FART_ZONE_STATE.mines.forEach(fartSpawnGuardGroup);
}

function fartMineById(id){
  return FART_ZONE_STATE.mines.find(function(m){return m.id===id})||null;
}

function applyScavengerSlimeVariant(e){
  if(!e||!e.type||!e.type.slimeScavenger)return e;
  // 24 distinct visual combinations:
  // 3 colors × 2 mirror directions × 4 silhouettes (width only; height is unchanged).
  const v=Math.abs(e.id||0)%24;
  e.slimeVariant=v;
  e.sprite=SLIME_SCAVENGER_IMAGES[v%3];
  e.slimeFlip=(Math.floor(v/3)%2)===1;
  e.slimeWidthMul=SLIME_SCAVENGER_WIDTHS[Math.floor(v/6)%4];
  return e;
}

function luckCoinRareDropMul(){return Date.now()<Number((INV.activeBoosts||{}).luckCoinUntil||0)?1.20:1}
function dropLoot(e){
  const _antiFarm=antiFarmRewardMul(e);

  // Gold remains the basic dungeon currency.
  // For heavily overleveled farming it may fall to zero instead of forcing
  // a guaranteed 1 Gold from every trivial mob.
  const base=e.gold||5;
  const gold=Math.max(0,Math.round(base*(0.8+Math.random()*0.4)*clanGoldMul()*premiumGoldMul()*_antiFarm));
  if(gold>0){
    LOOT.push({x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*20,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*20,kind:'gold',amount:gold,bob:Math.random()*6});
  }

  // PPA economy:
  // ordinary dungeon mob = 1% for 1 PPA
  // Phoenix boss = guaranteed 5 PPA
  if(e&&e.isBoss){
    LOOT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*26,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*26,
      kind:'ppa',amount:5,bob:Math.random()*6
    });
  }else if(Math.random()<PPA_DROP_CHANCE*premiumDropMul()*_antiFarm){
    LOOT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*26,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*26,
      kind:'ppa',amount:PPA_DROP_AMOUNT,bob:Math.random()*6
    });
  }

  // Phoenix Feather:
  // Phoenix boss = 2%; the 21+ boss never drops Phoenix feathers.
  // ordinary dungeon mob = 0.01%
  const _featherChance=(e&&e.isDungeon21Boss)?0:((e&&e.isBoss)?PHOENIX_FEATHER_BOSS_CHANCE:PHOENIX_FEATHER_MOB_CHANCE);
  if(Math.random()<_featherChance*rewardDropMul()*_antiFarm){
    LOOT.push({
      x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
      kind:'phoenixFeather',amount:1,bob:Math.random()*6
    });
  }

  maybeDropStatRune(e,_antiFarm);

  const lv=Math.max(1,Math.min(20,e.roomLevel||e.lvl||1));

  if(e.isBoss){
    // Phoenix: one guaranteed random-class gear item; 40% gray / 50% green / 10% blue.
    const it=genItem(20,true);
    LOOT.push({x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*40,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*40,kind:'gear',item:it,gear:it,bob:Math.random()*6});

    // Boss resources: common guaranteed, green often, blue only tiny chance.
    pushMaterialDrop(e,'common',2+Math.floor(Math.random()*3)); // 2–4
    if(Math.random()<0.40*rewardDropMul())pushMaterialDrop(e,'uncommon',1+Math.floor(Math.random()*2)); // 1–2
    if(Math.random()<0.02*rewardDropMul()*luckCoinRareDropMul())pushMaterialDrop(e,'rare',1); // blue resource: 2% base; Luck Coin +20% relative

    // Ordinary sharpening stone.
    if(Math.random()<0.15*rewardDropMul())pushStoneDrop(e,'normal',1);

    // V119: Phoenix lvl-20 premium sharpening stone — base 0.019%.
    // The 21+ boss does NOT use this Phoenix-specific roll.
    if(e.isDungeonPhoenixBoss&&Math.random()<0.00019*rewardDropMul())pushStoneDrop(e,'premium',1);

    // V173: ultra-rare Premium rune: Phoenix only.
    // 0.01% = roughly 1 rune per 10 000 Phoenix kills before drop multipliers.
    if(e.isDungeonPhoenixBoss&&Math.random()<0.0001*rewardDropMul())pushStoneDrop

function updatePetFollower(){
  var it=INV&&INV.equipped?INV.equipped.pet:null;if(!it)return;
  if(PET_FOLLOW.scene!==P.scene||Math.hypot(PET_FOLLOW.x-P.x,PET_FOLLOW.y-P.y)>330)resetPetFollower();
  var mv=Math.hypot(P.vx||0,P.vy||0),dxn,dyn;
  if(mv>.15){dxn=(P.vx||0)/mv;dyn=(P.vy||0)/mv}
  else{var pf=playerFacing4();dxn=pf==='E'?1:pf==='W'?-1:0;dyn=pf==='S'?1:pf==='N'?-1:0}
  var tx=P.x-dxn*52-dyn*16,ty=P.y-dyn*52+dxn*16+10;
  var dx=tx-PET_FOLLOW.x,dy=ty-PET_FOLLOW.y,dd=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
  var step=Math.min(dd,Math.max(1.7,Math.min(6.3,dd*.11)));
  if(dd>1){PET_FOLLOW.x+=dx/dd*step;PET_FOLLOW.y+=dy/dd*step;
    if(Math.abs(dy)>Math.abs(dx))PET_FOLLOW.dir=dy>0?'S':'N';else PET_FOLLOW.dir=dx>0?'E':'W'}
  PET_FOLLOW.phase+=(dd>1.2?.34:.09);
}

}

function pushMaterialDrop(e,rarity,amount){

  });

var GEAR_IMG_CACHE={};
function gearImg(src){
  if(!src)return null;
  if(!GEAR_IMG_CACHE[src]){var im=new Image();im.src=src;GEAR_IMG_CACHE[src]=im;}
  return GEAR_IMG_CACHE[src];
}

function randFrom(a){return a[Math.floor(Math.random()*a.length)]}
function pushMaterialDrop(e,rarity,amount){
  var pool=MATERIAL_BY_RARITY[rarity]||[];if(!pool.length)return;
  var name=randFrom(pool),def=MATERIAL_DB[name];
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*34,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*34,
    kind:'material',name:name,rarity:def.rarity,src:def.src,amount:amount||1,bob:Math.random()*6
  });
}
function pushStoneDrop(e,stone,amount){
  LOOT.push({
    x:e.x+(Math.random()-.5)*30,y:e.y+(Math.random()-.5)*30,
    kind:'stone',stone:stone,amount:amount||1,bob:Math.random()*6,
    rarity:stone==='normal'?'common':'rare',
    name:stone==='normal'?'Обычный камень заточки':stone==='premium'?'Премиум камень заточки':'Премиум руна заточки',
    img:stone==='normal'?PPA_V172_ART.normalStone:stone==='premium'?PPA_V172_ART.premiumStone:PPA_V172_ART.premiumRune
  });
}

function drawWorldCrystalBossOccluder(e){
  if(!e||!worldCrystalBossPlayerIsBehind(e))return;
  drawWorldCrystalBossBody(e,true);
}
function drawWorldCrystalProjectiles(){
  if(!imgWorldCrystalProjectile.complete||!imgWorldCrystalProjectile.naturalWidth)return;
  for(const f of WORLD_CRYSTAL_PROJECTILES){
    const sx=f.x-cam.x,sy=f.y-cam.y;
    const fr=Math.floor((Date.now()-f.born)/95)%4;
    const size=54;
    cx.save();
    cx.translate(sx,sy);
    cx.rotate(f.angle+Math.PI/2);
    cx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
    cx.drawImage(imgWorldCrystalProjectile,fr*192,0,192,192,-size/2,-size/2,size,size);
    cx.restore();
  }
}

function drawPhoenixDungeonAoe(e,sx,sy){
  if(!e||!e.isDungeonPhoenixBoss||!e.phoenixAoeFxUntil)return;
  const now=Date.now();
  if(now>=e.phoenixAoeFxUntil)return;
  const pending=!!e.phoenixAoePending;
  cx.save();
  cx.lineWidth=3;
  cx.strokeStyle=pending?'rgba(255,120,45,.90)':'rgba(255,175,60,.68)';
  cx.fillStyle=pending?'rgba(255,80,20,.08)':'rgba(255,110,25,.14)';
  cx.beginPath();
  cx.arc(sx,sy+20,PHOENIX_DUNGEON_AOE_RADIUS,0,Math.PI*2);
  cx.fill();cx.stroke();
  cx.restore();
}

// Возрождение моба ровно на его собственной точке спавна
function spawnMobAtPoint(si,fx){
  const p=DG_ACTIVE_SPAWNS[si];if(!p)return;
  let px=p[0]*DG_SCALE,py=p[1]*DG_SCALE;
  if(!dgCircleWalk(px,py,18)){const q=dgNearestWalk(px,py);px=q.x;py=q.y}
  const t=mobByLvl(DG_SPAWN_LVL[si]);
  let e=mkMob(t,px,py);
  if(DUNGEON_MODE==='21+')e=applyDungeon21MobStats(e,si);
  else if(DUNGEON_MODE==='41-60')e=applyDungeon41MobStats(e,si);
  e.si=si;               // точка спавна (дом моба)
  e.room=p[2];           // номер комнаты
  e.roomLevel=DG_ROOM_LVL[p[2]]||e.lvl;
  e.hx=px;e.hy=py;       // возврат на место после потери агро
  EN.push(e);
  if(fx)for(let j=0;j<7;j++)PT.push({x:px,y:py,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*5,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*5,life:18,ml:18,sz:2+Math.random()*3,col:'#8866ff'});
  return e;
}

function luckCoinRareDropMul(){return Date.now()<Number((INV.activeBoosts||{}).luckCoinUntil||0)?1.20:1}
function dropLoot(e){
  const _antiFarm=antiFarmRewardMul(e);

  // Gold remains the basic dungeon currency.
  // For heavily overleveled farming it may fall to zero instead of forcing
  // a guaranteed 1 Gold from every trivial mob.
  const base=e.gold||5;
  const gold=Math.max(0,Math.round(base*(0.8+Math.random()*0.4)*clanGoldMul()*premiumGoldMul()*_antiFarm));
  if(gold>0){
    LOO
